articleTitle: Stress Detection using Machine Learning Techniques: A review
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In today's fast-paced society, stress is a prevalent issue that can have detrimental effects on one's health. This study aims to investigate machine learning-based techniques for detecting stress in humans. Participants who were engaged in a variety of their daily routine tasks were taken for dataset taking their physiological signs, including breathing rate, skin conductance, and heart rate variability into consideration. Then, in order to detect stress, these signals were utilized to train different models of machine learning like support vector machines, random forest and logistic regression. The accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score were a few of the metrics used to assess performance of these methods. According to the findings, the random forest model had the highest level of stress detection accuracy at 89%. The development of wearable technology and other applications that can aid people in managing their stress levels causes significant impact on state-of-the-art technological advancements in this area.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis using SVM, Twin SVM, and Naïve Bayes
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: There is a variety of information available today on websites like Twitter, blogs, and e-commerce platforms, including evaluations and conversations about events. It takes time to manually analyze these opinions. Sentiment analysis and opinion mining use machine learning techniques to automatically analyze text and determine people’s attitudes towards a topic or product to address this. In one’s free time, watching films can be an engaging experience. There is a huge selection of films accessible to stream online or see in theatres in the modern digital age. Reading movie comments on IMDB, which are many and cover a variety of topics, including star ratings, has grown in popularity. In this work, the IMDB movie review dataset is subjected to sentiment analysis. The goal is to develop a machine learning model that can ascertain if a given scenario is generally thought to be good or negative. Since machines can only understand numbers and not text, the incoming data must first be preprocessed and converted into a numerical vector space. SVM, Twin SVM, and Nave Bayes are three machine learning algorithms that are used, and the outcomes are assessed and contrasted. In this analysis, Twin SVM stands out for performing better.

articleTitle: Android App-Locker for Security and Application Management
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Mobile systems are emerging more and more as we interact with them everyday. Providing security and protection are one of the primary concerns raised by these systems. Android App-Locker systems are applications that allow users to lock specific apps or certain features of their Android devices. These systems provide an additional layer of security and privacy, especially for users who share their devices with others. Furthermore, overuse of certain applications are detrimental to one’s mental health. These systems typically require users to set a password, PIN, pattern, or fingerprint as a security measure to access the locked apps or features. Users can then choose which apps or features to lock and customize the lock settings for each app or feature. Android App-Locker systems also often come with additional security features, such as intruder selfies, which capture a photo of anyone who tries to access a locked app or feature with an incorrect password. Some systems also allow users to remotely lock or unlock their devices. Overall Android App-Locker systems provide an easy and effective way for users to secure their devices and protect their sensitive data from unauthorized access. In this project we aim to make a user-friendly Android Based App-Locker Application using ANDROID STUDIO with features like Fake lock screen and intruder capture etc.,.

articleTitle: Developing and Evaluating a Binary Hate Speech Dataset: A Comparitive Study of Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: This research article presents an investigation into a hate speech dataset that contains 2,478 tweets. The dataset was meticulously annotated by human annotators, and it includes two types of labels: hate (45.56%) and not-hate. We elaborate on the annotation process and the inter-annotator agreement attained. Additionally, we carry out a thorough analysis of the dataset, which encompasses exploratory data analysis, statistical analysis, and machine learning experiments. Our results demonstrate that recognizing hate speech is a difficult task due to its highly subjective nature among annotators. However, our dataset can be an advantageous resource for training and assessing hate speech detection models. We also discuss the ethical considerations that must be addressed while collecting and using hate speech data and provide recommendations for future research in this field.

articleTitle: Diabetes Prediction using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Diabetes is now a frequent condition among people worldwide. The prevalence of diabetes is increasing daily across various age groups due to numerous factors. Factors contributing to the development of diabetes include infections caused by bacteria or viruses, existence of chemical contaminants in food, autoimmune responses, obesity, unhealthy dietary patterns, lifestyle changes, alterations in eating habits, and environmental pollution. Therefore, diagnosis of diabetes in elementary stage is essential for preserving an individual’s life. Diabetes mellitus, commonly referred to as diabetes, is a significant metabolic condition that significantly affects a person’s overall health and wellness. Diabetes causes elevated blood sugar levels. Improper management of diabetes increases the likelihood of heart attack, retinopathy leading to vision loss, skin problems, and other ailments. Presently, there are over a million individuals affected by this condition. Early diabetes detection can help to take necessary measures. In this research, we applied the Support Vector Machine algorithm, a machine learning method, to detect patterns and risk factors in a dataset related to diabetes. This approach aids in effectively categorizing patients as either diabetic or non-diabetic.

articleTitle: Analysis on Fine-Grained Image Recognition Datasets and Techniques: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The straightforward task of working with objects that fall under several intra-class categories inside the same inter-class category group, such as various bird species or various motor vehicle types, is the subject of FGIR (Fine-Grained Image Recognition). FGIR can find applications in crop disease detection, satellite image detection, and several other use cases in biological research. FGIR is made up of instance-level analysis and basic-level category analysis. The objective is to look at visual components from subordinate categories, such as feathered creature species or diverse car demonstration types. We have studied several methodologies and techniques used in image recognition that can also be used in FGIR. We have also studied several datasets for image recognition and some for FGIR use solely. After analysing recent developments in the field, we have isolated and summarised some of the techniques used. These divisions are based on the image recognition models and picture preprocessing methods employed.

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Detection by Canny Edge Algorithm using CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The field of image processing is highly challenging, and one of its most difficult aspects is image segmentation. Biomedical imaging heavily relies on the technique of object-background separation, which has proven to be quite beneficial. This research paper introduces a novel approach to segment brain tumors in medical images by leveraging the power of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and the Canny edge detection algorithm in combination. The proposed method seeks to enhance the effectiveness and efficiency of brain tumor segmentation in medical images by utilizing the strengths of both techniques in a synergistic manner. The current standard method for detecting brain tumor is through Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI). This approach combines image sharpening, double thresholding, and hysteresis with the Sobel operator, and employs Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) as a pre-segmentation pixel classifier to improve the accuracy and efficiency of brain tumor segmentation. Nevertheless, the efficiency of these techniques may not always be satisfactory. Therefore, a hit and trial approach is employed by combining the Canny edge detection algorithm with CNNs, which showed an improvement in efficiency.

articleTitle: A Study of Artificial Intelligence’s Role in Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The domain of object detection has advanced significantly during the past 20 years. Within its 20 -year history, this overview of the literature not only looks at some iconic detectors (like the VJ detection device, the HOG detector, the DPM, Faster-RCNN, YOLO, SSD, and others as well), significant innovations, speed-up strategies, identification uses, records, and statistics, but it also talks about the 28 obstacles the research community faces at present and how these detectors may be enhanced in the coming years. We have custom-made attributes and shallow trainable structures, which are the cornerstones of historical object identification systems. Deep learning technology has evolved on its own, making more efficient tools capable of picking up deeper, higher-level, and semantic traits. In this paper, a deep learning-based object-detecting system has been investigated. Additionally, we practise a few specialized tasks including pedestrian detection, face identification, and noteworthy item detection.

articleTitle: A Survey on Trust Based Approaches Used in Detection of Attacks in Internet of Things (IoT)
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Due to the advancement of information and communication technologies, information security has become a major problem for data transfer and routing. The Internet of Things(IoT) has significantly changed how technology is used in several spheres of life today. Every aspect of human life includes smart devices. Governments, Industries and Agriculture etc are implementing autonomous systems to improve productivity, efficiency and overall economic benefits. The conventional security is one of the key issues for the loT ecosystem. It incorporates requirements for the identification, authentication, confidentiality, integrity, and availability of both individuals and devices. There are various approaches used for detecttion of attacks in loT like cryotography, IDS based, Trust based and Machine learning based. The contribution of this paper is to give overview of the trust evaluation metrics used in detection of attacks in Internet of Things.

articleTitle: Food Crop Disease Identification system using ML
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Agriculture has played a crucial role in domesticating essential crops and livestock for thousands of years. However, food insecurity caused by plant diseases remains a significant global problem. These diseases result in crop damage and reduced yield, leading to food shortages. According to the Food and Agriculture Organization, plant parasites and diseases are responsible for up to 40 percent of the decline in global agricultural production. This has severe consequences, including widespread hunger and substantial damage to the agriculture industry. Smallholder farmers, who contribute over 80 percent of agricultural output in developing countries, are particularly vulnerable to pathogen-related disruptions in food supply. As a result, the development of new techniques for detecting plant diseases can significantly increase food production and mitigate losses.The limited accuracy and efficiency of previous methods in detecting and classifying crop leaf diseases have hindered agricultural productivity. To address these shortcomings, this research proposes the utilization of the Plant Village Kaggle dataset, which presents challenges due to its varying image capture conditions and diverse image samples. Through the development of a 28-layer deep learning model, we achieved an impressive accuracy rate exceeding 97%. Our model not only overcomes the limitations of previous methods but also demonstrates its effectiveness in accurately detecting and classifying crop leaf diseases. By leveraging this model, we aim to enhance agricultural productivity and mitigate losses caused by plant diseases, thereby contributing to global food security.

articleTitle: The role of the Internet of Behaviours (IoB) in enhancing customer service
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Internet of Behaviours (IoB) intends to elucidate how data might be used to design and market innovative products from a psychological perspective. Firms can use the IoB in a variety of ways. The potential for this technology to evolve into an engaging new advertising and sales platform for businesses and organizations worldwide is tremendous. The IoB platform enables the deep client awareness that any business need. For instance, IoB synchronize with all smartphones in the application, enabling consumers to view their flaws and get receive discernible ideas for improving their swing and stroke. The extension of the Internet of things through device connectivity results in many additional data points (IoT). Businesses gather client data by having connected devices “share” information while being physically monitored by a single computer. The IoB and its function to meet client requirements are briefly discussed in this paper. IoB applications for improving customer services are also identified and discussed in this study. A computer networks a term coined to describe the collection of usage and usage-related data from Internet of Things devices provides useful insight into customer behaviour, desires, and tastes. It includes a wide range of things including phones, cars, exercise reloads, credit cards, and anything else that is in fact networked to the web. The goal of IoB is to track, analyze, interpret, and react to all domains of human behaviour in a such a way that allows individuals to be comprehended and tracked using breakthroughs in machine learning algorithms and new technologies.

articleTitle: Video Insights Application, A Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Unsupervised learning has emerged as a potential method for summarizing films without the requirement for human annotations, which is an important study field in computer vision. This thesis provides a novel method for automatically identifying and extracting sample frames from videos using unsupervised learning and deep learning approaches.. The suggested method learns a low-dimensional representation of the video frames using clustering and dimensionality reduction techniques, which is then applied to provide a summary of the film. We compare our method to current cutting-edge unsupervised video summarization techniques using a number of benchmark datasets, and the results demonstrate that it performs better in terms of both objective metrics and subjective quality. Our approach also exhibits good generalization performance across different types of videos, indicating its potential for real-world applications. This thesis represents a significant leap forward in the field of video summarization, introducing innovative viewpoints on leveraging unsupervised learning techniques to tackle this complex task.

articleTitle: Flaura, A Cross Platform Virtual Assistant
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: A virtual assistant is an application program that executes tasks on behalf of the user and can comprehend natural language voice commands. Virtual Assistants are rapidly advancing to provide users with more capabilities and features and to facilitate their day-to-day duties. The virtual assistant’s capacity to interpret and fulfil requests will grow along with speech recognition and natural language processing. However, none of the existing virtual assistants are platform independent. Hence a unique cognitive computing based cross-platform virtual assistant (Flaura) is developed in this research work that can enable users not only to perform all the tasks such as sending email, searching on the web, playing music and browsing the internet etc. across different platforms. The virtual assistant, Flaura has been tested for both Windows and Mac OS operating system such for the aforementioned functionalities

articleTitle: Smart Watering System for Terrace Garden Using LabVIEW

authors.preferredName: L S S Pavan Kumar Chodisetti

By maintaining optimal soil moisture levels and monitoring environmental factors, the prototype aims to achieve maximum plant growth while making efficient use of available irrigation resources. The monitoring software Lab VIEW has been used, and the sensor data will be available online. Given that water is a need for plant existence, it must not be used excessively. It is possible to program the Arduino Uno to examine some signals from sensors, like moisture and rainfall. LabVIEW can be used to regulate and monitor the irrigation of water to plants, and an IoT module can be used to display the soil moisture levels and gases continually on a webpage. The proposed system has various sensors (soil moisture, temperature, pH, and harmful gases) for monitoring the garden plants. Controlling the water supply and keeping an eye on the plants are the key goals of this work which is envisioned through LabView software, where the interfacing between prototype and monitoring environment has been enabled through it. articleTitle: Personality Prediction System using CV
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: This system introduces an enhanced approach to assess candidates returning from a vast applicant pool, offering a consistent and lawful resume ranking policy. Tailored to specific job requirements, the system initially analyzes the experience and skills essential for a given position. It then dynamically adjusts based on the unique demands of each role. This tool facilitates HR in effortlessly screening candidates, emphasizing not just qualifications and experience but also other pivotal job requirements. By aiding HR in identifying suitable candidates, the system contributes to the recruitment of highly skilled professionals for the organization. Candidates submit their CVs to the system, recording comprehensive information for evaluation. Additionally, candidates have the opportunity to undergo an online exam encompassing personality and general culture questions. Following the completion of the test, candidates can conveniently review their results through a graphical display.

articleTitle: Automobile Service and Management System for Vehicles Network
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The automobile service and management system (ASMS) is developed through a web application. This system helps and offers assistance to the user affected by problems in their car. This system provides services to solve the problem in three ways: the first is assistance. It is useful for (A) users who are in trouble with their car during a trip; the user can call using this ASM system, and the user will ask about the state of the problem, direct them to share their CLPAU, and dispatch the AU mechanic based on the problem. Secondly, a user who wants to service their car Third, a user who wants to take a long tour but does not know how to drive can hire a driver for the tour’s specific location. This system will provide not only these things but also car rentals and EV car repairs. Car parts sales within the environment will be provided. The idea behind the proposed system is that the user can use it for all possible services and monitor the overall services, spare parts, and money transactions. articleTitle: Automated Parking System Using Django
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: One of the major challenges we face these days while we travel somewhere is to find a parking spot. This is due to the rapid increase in the usage of vehicles (four-wheeler specifically). We often lose our patience while searching for the right place to park our vehicle, some end up parking on the side of the road which results in traffic jams. During peak hours you can’t even think of travelling unless you already have a dedicated parking spot at the place where you are heading to, which is rare. Even at the places with commercial parking area, it is a hustling task to search for a vacant place this leads to more consumption of fuel and hence contributing to increase pollution rates. This paper aims at resolving the problem by designing an automated parking system. To account for the same, we need to design a Web application, using which a person can prebook a slot in the nearest parking area (hassle-free). It will also navigate the user to the booked slot. Also, the area would be embedded with certain components for monitoring purpose to ensure smooth running of the automated system. Payments can be carried out digitally with ease thanks to services like Google Pay, Paytm, PhonePe and debit/credit card. This will reduce human interaction, traffic jams and no more delay to attend important morning meetings. All the results and algorithm in this paper are developed using HTML, CSS, Bootstrap (Front-end) and Django framework(back-end).

articleTitle: Neural Networks Based Solar Power Forecast in Multi-Area System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: At the higher penetration levels, more work is needed to encourage the use of grid-connected photovoltaic (PV) systems as a key source in electric power networks. Based on the idea that using solar power forecast data might enhance the management and performance of small electric networks, this thesis tackles the variability of PV electric generation. An architecture system utilizing neural networks is employed for the Nonlinear Autoregressive shallow network. To evaluate how input configurations, affect the model’s predicting performance, they are compared and optimized. Forecasts up to several hours ahead of time are tested to confirm the model’s forecasting accuracy for various short-term time horizons and compared with the persistence model once the input configuration with the best network performance is chosen. When it came to Mean Square Error (MSE) number, the suggested model fared better than the real model.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Tracking System using Facial Recognition and Location
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Attendance monitoring has been a widely adopted practice in educational institutions to track student progress. However, conventional methods of attendance tracking are often imprecise and time-consuming. This research proposes an automated tracking system that enables students to submit attendance using their computers/laptops. The system uses facial recognition and real-time location to authenticate the student’s identity. To ensure user privacy and system security, the technology implements service isolation and token-based mechanisms. Tests conducted in a real-world setting demonstrate that the proposed system is highly effective and accurate at tracking attendance.

articleTitle: Hyperlocal marketplace - transforming unorganized localized marketplace with future tech
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The way consumers have purchased goods and services has evolved over time. From physical to digital, there has been a significant shift in buying behavior. With the increased adoption of digital technology in localized areas, the process of buying and selling in unorganized local marketplace is set to undergo a dramatic transformation. The digitized hyperlocal marketplace is the next big trend expected to emerge within the next 5 to 10 years. This paper addresses various considerations surrounding such a marketplace, the necessary use cases needed for its platform, the technology architecture required to implement a solution around this concept, and finally, future possibilities for enabling a never-before-seen user experience in this space using digital technologies.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of DC Microgrid Protection Using AI
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Without being a part of a larger power grid, it can be used to independently produce, distribute, and store electricity. Here Direct current (DC) voltage levels are used to power small-scale DC Microgrid electric power systems. Power generation devices like solar cells, wind turbines, or fuel cells, energy storage devices like batteries or capacitors, power converters, and control systems are the main elements of a DC Microgrid. Due to its capacity to deliver dependable and effective electricity in off-the-grid or distant regions as well as their potential to lower energy prices and carbon emissions, DC Microgrids are growing in popularity. In this paper we are going to discuss about the designing of MATLAB/Simulink model of the DC Microgrid which is to be powered based on renewable sources of energy. The sources of energy are: - Wind Turbine, PV Arrays, Batteries and they are to be connected with the main utility grid. Various types of power electronic devices such as AC to DC converters, power MOSFET, diodes etc. Apart from the designing part of DC Microgrid we will also discuss about the di/dt and ANFIS protection schemes. The di/dt protection scheme focuses on monitoring the rate of change of current to detect abnormal current behaviour and trigger protective measures. Another protection scheme is based upon AI as it is able to figure out the abnormal conditions on its own based on the training data. The scheme is implemented with the help of ANFIS toolbox, The ANFIS protection scheme utilizes an adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system, which learns from real-time data and provides intelligent fault detection, localization, and classification within the microgrid system. This scheme can be the future of more efficient protection of DC system if properly trained with varieties of data.

articleTitle: Application Software for visually disabled, Object Detection using CNN

articleTitle: Exploring the Potential of IoT and Advanced Technologies for Smart and Sustainable Living
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) and other advanced guard technologies have the potential to lead to a more intelligent and sustainable way of life, which is the focus of this paper on sustainable living and IOT Security. We can optimise energy consumption, improve healthcare, reorganise transportation, and boost general well-being by connecting a variety of appliances and devices to the internet. But there is a challenge that must be solved in order to deploy these technologies in a safe and responsible way. The most promising IoT and advanced technology applications currently under development are examined in this paper, along with the obstacles that must be overcome before they can be deployed safely and responsibly. Secure and responsible implementation of IoT is needed. The increased connectivity of devices and appliances creates new cybersecurity risks, therefore this paper discusses the gravity of data privacy and security. Compute the potential economic conclusion is also taken into account.

articleTitle: Bugzilla Bug Tracking System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Bug tracking systems enable developers to log and track bugs in a centralized system, making it easier to manage and prioritize issues, assign tasks to team members, and track progress. They also provide a way for users to report bugs and issues, giving developers valuable feedback and insight into how the application is being used. This collaborative approach to bug tracking reflects a shift towards a more user- centric approach to software development, where developers are encouraged to engage with users and respond to their needs and concerns.

articleTitle: Using BERT with Different Deep Learning Techniques to Classify Reviews
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Every day, the volume of textual information is growing at an accelerated rate. A portion of this data is presented as product, movie, game, and other review content. These reviews fall into two general categories: favourable and unfavourable. Since there are a lot of reviews for popular products, a classifier that can categorise reviewers as positive or negative is necessary. This work compares the performance of BERT with other widely used approaches for review classification. Specifically, we combine BERT with several deep learning algorithms (BiGRU, 1-D CNN, and GRU-CNN). Using a pre-trained BERT model, we first turn the content into numerical vectors. Next, we feed the embeddings into several models and evaluate how well they perform. We evaluate the performance based on f1 macro, accuracy, precision, and recall and find that the BERT+CNN_GRU model outperforms the widely-used models for review classification.

articleTitle: Brain tumor detection using deep learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Brain tumor is most dangerous tumors, A brain tumor could be a multiplication of cells inside or close the brain. Any irregular mass of cells in or close the brain that has the potential to ended up cancerous is alluded to as a brain tumor. Our proposed procedure for identifying and pinpointing the brain tumor is using MRI scans from MRI pictures. Brain cancers are detected in this research using CNNs and deep learning methods. The detection of brain cancer cells will be carried out more efficiently, accurately, and rapidly when these algorithms are applied to the images, which will help to provide the patient with better and more cutting-edge treatment. BTC assists radiologists and health monitors in giving patients prompt medical care. With our methodology we will get more accuracy.

articleTitle: Churn Prediction Model of Telecom Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Mobile technology is included in computing, which is one of the top global trends in technology. There are many different types of private service providers now, thus new, creative business models are necessary to succeed in the present environment. To expand their base of revenue-generating clients, telco businesses must both draw in new ones and prevent contract terminations (=churn). The single biggest reason for income decreasing for telecom providers is telecom churn. Customers’ demographic and behavioral data have been used in both industrial practice and active research to predict churners. Consumers in the telecom industry can actively move between operators and have access to a wide range of service providers. Clients may choose to end a contract for a number of reasons, such as better pricing offers, more alluring packages, unpleasant service encounters, or modifications in their personal circumstances. We will look at customer-level data from a leading telecom business in this study, create prediction models to figure out consumers who are most likely to churn and determine the key churn signals.

articleTitle: Exercise posture rectifier and tracker using MediaPipe and OpenCV
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: This research paper suggests a MediaPipe and OpenCV-based workout posture tracker and rectifier. Various musculoskeletal diseases caused by poor exercise posture can cause discomfort and injury. We created a technology that can instantly identify and fix bad exercise posture in order to solve this problem. When comparing the body’s joint angles to the optimal workout posture angles, the system employs MediaPipe for pose estimation and OpenCV for picture processing. When a mismatch is found, the technology gives the user immediate feedback so they can adjust their posture. We ran studies with a wide range of individuals to gauge how well the system performed, and the outcomes showed that the suggested technique is accurate and effective at spotting and correcting bad exercise posture. The proposed system has the potential to improve the effectiveness of exercise programs and reduce the risk of musculoskeletal disorders.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Network Intrusion Detection with Machine Learning and Deep Learning Using Ensemble Methods on CICIDS-2017 Dataset
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: An intrusion detection system (IDS), also referred to as an IDS, is a type of network security equipment that monitors network communications in real-time and, should any potentially hostile transmissions be identified, either sends out alarms or implements active reaction measures. In this context, numerous researchers have attempted to improve intrusion detection performance by combining traditional machine learning models with alternative optimization techniques. Although the present intrusion detection model has the potential to considerably improve performance, there are still certain persistent problems, such as faulty detection and data preparation operations, which both have the potential to reduce accuracy. Using the CICIDS2017 dataset, we provided an analysis model of various classifiers in our paper, including random forest, stacking set-1 (Naive Bayes, K-Nearest Neighbours, Random Forest), bagging, boosting (XGB), LSTM, CNN, and stacking set-2 (LSTM and CNN). Boosting (XGB) performed better than all models across all feature sets overall.

articleTitle: Using Supervised Learning for Breast Cancer Detection using AI&ML
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Breast cancer is the leading cause of cancer-related deaths among women worldwide. A significant amount of research has been conducted to improve early detection of breast cancer, which is crucial for effective treatment and increased chances of survival. While mammograms have been the most reliable detection method, there is a need to explore alternatives that are cost-effective, safe, and accurate across different datasets. A hybrid paradigm of machine learning methods is presented in this work, proposed for effective breast cancer detection. The model combines several machine learning algorithms, including ANN, SVM, KNN and Decision Tree (DT), and can be applied to various data types, including images and blood tests. The proposed model aims to provide accurate results that are close to perfection.The presence or absence of micro-metastases plays a significant role in determining the fate of breast cancer. The proposed breast cancer detection machine utilizes machine learning and artificial intelligence techniques to identify breast cancer. The machine applies coding and techniques to detect breast cancer and project the results of different techniques. Depending on the need, the appropriate technique can be applied. This research focuses on predicting accuracy, and future research can explore other parameters to categorize breast cancer research further. Breast cancer detection remains a critical area of research, and the proposed hybrid model can be useful in providing accurate and cost-effective results for effective treatment and increased survival rates.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Based Storage and Sharing Scheme of Stem Cell Records
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Blockchain technology has been gaining traction in various industries as a secure and decentralized means of storing and sharing data. Blockchain technology can completely change how stem cell records are exchanged and kept in the stem cell research community. In this study, we suggest a stem cell data storage and sharing system based on blockchain technology that protects the data’s confidentiality and privacy while allowing for authorized access and sharing. In the proposed system, each record of a stem cell is represented by a transaction and is stored on a permissioned blockchain network. Digital signatures and smart contracts are used to limit access to the documents, allowing the safe and permitted exchange of the records among authorized parties. Simulated evaluations of the proposed approach reveal that it is safe, effective, and scalable. Overall, our work demonstrates the potential of blockchain technology to improve the preservation and sharing of stem cell information in the stem cell research sector.

articleTitle: A Study of Advancements in Deep Learning-Based Image Colorization Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: This paper provides an overview of recent advancements in deep learning(DL)-based image colorization techniques. It highlights the importance of image colorization in various domains and the limitations of traditional manual methods. The emergence of deep learning approaches, along with the use of large-scale datasets, has greatly improved colorization performance. Preprocessing techniques, loss functions, and evaluation metrics are discussed. Notable architectures like CEDN, U-Net, and Deep Koalarization are presented, showcasing their unique features. The challenges in image colorization and future research directions are identified. The potential impact of image colorization in fashion, interior design, and advertising is highlighted. Ongoing research in this field is essential for further advancements and its transformative potential in visual content creation.

articleTitle: Marketing Automation Through AI: A Decision Support Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Artificial intelligence has developed and excelled with time since the advent of the Internet and its adaptability. AI has evolved enormously due to the voluminous, in-depth data provided by online servers and search engines. This research paper covers the topic of how artificial intelligence is implemented in marketing automation. It analyzes the utilization of different instruments to adapt to the versatile market in order to cater its service in correspondence with automation and machine learning; the scope of the study will determine the usage of AI by analyzing how companies utilize AI to improve performance with regards to automation and search engine optimization. It also investigates the AI’s intuitive data and sensitive information, which might raise security issues and privacy violations if not misused.

articleTitle: Advancements in Fake News Detection: A Comprehensive Review and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Fake news has become a pervasive issue in the era of information overload, leading to a growing need for effective detection techniques. This review paper presents a comprehensive analysis of various approaches and techniques employed in the detection of fake news. The study explores both traditional and advanced methods used in text-based and multimedia-based fake news detection. Key aspects such as feature extraction, machine learning algorithms, and ensemble methods are discussed in detail. The review critically examines the strengths and limitations of different approaches, highlighting their effectiveness in addressing the challenges posed by fake news. Additionally, emerging trends in deep learning, natural language processing, and social network analysis for fake news detection are explored. The paper also highlights the importance of dataset quality, annotation guidelines, and evaluation metrics in benchmarking the performance of detection models.

articleTitle: Car Parking Technique for Load Balancing in Cloud Data Centres
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Cloud computing a rapidly increasing field has amended how firms acquire, maintain, and analyze their data. It enables the on-demand access to a shared pool of online computing resources such as servers, data storage, and software. Cloud computing has several perks, such as lower costs, higher productivity, greater scalability, and increased flexibility. However, cloud computing has a myriad of challenges that must be overcome. Load balancing is a technique that has gained popularity in recent years due to its ability to reduce system overload, increase performance, reduce latencies, and enable effective use of existing resources. Hardware, software, and cloud-based load balancers are examined in this study. The paper also reviews and compares potential solutions to workload management. This study proposed a parking mechanism to balance loads in cloud data centres. To implement this, parking mechanism temporarily frees up resources for servers with higher demands. Utilizing parking methods in cloud data centres can improve optimize efficiency, reduce expenditures, and efficiently handle incoming network traffic.

articleTitle: Handwritten Character Recognition using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Handwritten character recognition(HCR) is a technique of making handwritten writing understandable by a computer. This research paper offers a thorough review of English-language handwritten character recognition. The banking and healtheare industries, among many other places that deal with handwritten employed in recent research in this field, features, and classifiers to make handwritten text recognition easier. The primary goal of doing this research paper is to build expert system for, “HCR using Machine Learning” that can effectivelly recognize a particular character of type format using the K materials, have used the handwritten character recognition technology in many different uses. Even if it’s the same author the identical character, there are changes in the character’s size, form, and placement since every writer has a different handwriting style. Numerous techniques have been Nearest Neighbours (KNN) algorithm and neural networks. When compared to, the planned recognition system performs fairly well and attains better levels of recognition accuracy. those using the traditional feature extraction techniques of horizontal and vertical.

articleTitle: Transfer Learning Model For Invariant Face Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Face identification mechanisms need to be reappraised as due to the advancement in the security parameters and the technology paradigm shift, such as the extensive use of face verification by the new community. As a result, more modern and efficient systems have been created recently, including feature analysis, low-level analysis, and active shape models. There are several methods for identifying faces, such as appearance- and knowledge-based approaches, feature-invariant algorithms, and template-matching strategies. Current facial recognition models frequently produce low-accuracy results. This study suggests a transfer learning approach that combines CNN and VGG-16 for face recognition.

articleTitle: Age and Gender Prediction using Deep Learning Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Gender and age prediction are two important tasks in diverse fields like marketing, medical care, and security. In the last couple of years, with the advent of DL (framework) and computer vision techniques, these tasks have been tackled with high accuracy using facial image data. The prediction of gender and age from facial images has various applications, such as targeted advertising, personalized medical treatment, and biometric identification. In this research paper, the latest techniques employed for age and gender detection is being scrutinized and discussed the challenges and limitations in this field. The exploration of ethical considerations surrounding the use of facial image data for gender and age estimation and highlight the need for responsible and transparent use of these technologies is done. Finally, the discussion of potential future directions for research in this area is being done by us, such as incorporating multimodal data and addressing issues related to data bias and privacy.Our review aims to provide insights into the current state of research on gender and age prediction and to guide future research in this field.

articleTitle: Driver Somnolence Detection System Using Machine Learning Tools
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: A reliable mode of conveyance is essential in today’s society. Anyone behind the vehicle is susceptible to having an accident. Several circumstances, such as fatigue, illness, or lengthy travel, may contribute to this phenomenon. Getting insufficient sleep or being subjected to other forms of injustice increases the likelihood of being involved in an accident. Accidents on the road are frequently the result of drivers who are drowsy or too exhausted to pay attention. Due to this, the annual global accident toll is significantly higher than it would be otherwise. Multiple automobile collisions have occurred in various areas of the world over the past several years. The road is heavily traveled at all hours of the day and night. Everyone experiences drowsiness after a lengthy voyage, which is a decent indicator of how exhausted one is. Don’t get behind the wheel if you haven’t had sufficient rest. Therefore, it is essential for drivers to be able to recognize the signs of exhaustion so they can take the necessary precautions to safeguard themselves and others on the road. This paper’s major goal is to create a system that can recognize driver weariness. This model employs specialized algorithms to evaluate the driver’s ocular health in realtime based on images captured in-car, eradicating the need for the driver to draw over. The driver could care less if there are alternative ways to attain the same objective; he is unaffected by this particular strategy. If you want to determine whether someone is fatigued, simply observe the “stopping score” of the pupils. If the score exceeds a certain threshold, the individual is considered drowsy.

articleTitle: Accurate and Efficient Brain Tumor Segmentation using transfer learning and residual networks
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Accurate and specific segmentation of brain tumour is essential in medical imaging for accurate diagnosis and planning of treatments. In this research paper, we suggest the use of a Densenet121 model for tumor recognition and a ResUnet model for segmentation. We fine-tune the DenseNet121 model using transfer learning techniques on a new dataset, with pre-trained weights obtained from a large-scale dataset (ImageNet). By leveraging the strengths of transfer learning with Densenet121’s and ResUnet’s robust feature extraction capabilities, our model effectively detects and segments tumors from Brain MRI Images. This approach can speed up the exercise procedure and improve the model’s accuracy, especially for small datasets. We validated our approach on “The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA)” dataset from The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA) and compared it with several classification and segmentation deep learning models. The experimental results on the testing data demonstrate that our approach is more efficient and accurate than other deep learning networks. This approach can substantially accelerate the training process and enhance the accuracy of the model, particularly in scenarios where the new dataset is small. We have validated our proposed approach on “The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA)” dataset from The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA). We have compared our approach with various classification and segmentation deep learning models, and the experimental results on the testing data demonstrate that our method performs better in terms of precision and effectiveness than other deep learning networks.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Bi-LSTM Model for Intrusion Detection in IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In this era of exponential internet boom IoT devices are also increasing with a rapid growth. This rapid growth also increases the risk of intrusion such as phishing at application layer, Dos & spoofing at network layer and node capture, malicious code injection & eavesdropping at physical layer. So, to prevent systems from these attacks it has become the desired need of time to implement an Intrusion Detection system model. In this paper we have briefly compared various global datasets and used most recent CSECICIDS-2018 dataset having 1.04 million of samples. We have implemented a Bi-LSTM model having an Input layer, a reshape layer, two Bi-LSTM layers, a dense layer, a dropout layer and lastly an output layer. Proposed model is used for the prediction of a packet whether it is Benign and Not Benign using 11 important features ‘Timestamp’, ‘Fwd Pkt Len Std’, ‘Fwd Pkt Len Mean’, ‘Fwd Pkt Len Max’, ‘Fwd Seg Size Avg’, ‘Pkt Len Std’, ‘Flow IAT Std’, ‘Bwd Pkt Len Std’, ‘Bwd Seg Size Avg’, ‘Pkt Size Avg’, ‘Subflow Fwd Byts’ for training the model. This Bi-LSTM model have provided an accuracy of 99.554%, precision of 99.227% and F1 score of 99.612%. Further this model can be tested and improved on real-time intrusion scenario to provide improved results.

articleTitle: A Secure Web-Based Android Chat Application Using The AES Encryption Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The major goal is to create an android chat application that allows numerous users to communicate securely. This is a cutting-edge encryption and decryption system that targets SMS for mobile Android users. The user has the ability to transmit encrypted messages and decrypt encrypted messages. The System uses the SMS that are visible in your inbox, but it filters out the encrypted SMS and displays them in your Personal Inbox in the Application. Only the user id, which is automatically encrypted in the message, has to be entered because the Shared Private Key is already established in the application. Therefore, anytime a user sends a message, he or she should be aware of the recipient’s ID since it is added to the message so that, if the intended recipient logs in, the message is already decrypted. The recipient’s id may only be saved in a separate column marked “Favorites” and contains the recipient’s id, name, and mobile number. The id is automatically created and cannot be modified. Given that a single user may have many accounts, logging in is required here’s with different ids so that he can maintain each account for various reasons without combining them. The communications are encrypted and decrypted by this system using the AES encryption algorithm. The front end of this app is Android Studio, while the back end is SQLite.

articleTitle: The Role of Artificial Intelligence in Information Acquisition
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Search engines use artificial intelligence to find potential leads. Early concepts in both fields are introduced in Bush and Turing’s publications, which are also utilized to define artificial intelligence and data mining in this article. The foundation for further exploration of intellectual notions of art and their application to information retrieval is a straightforward model of an information retrieval system. Pattern recognition, representation, problem solving and planning, reasoning, and learning are among the concepts covered. This paper finishes by outlining future directions for artificial intelligence research in data mining systems.

articleTitle: Crop Disease Detection Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Early plant disease diagnosis is becoming more and more important. Plant diseases have an impact on a plant’s development and reduce its output. Diseases in plants can result in significant crop loss. The ability to detect plant diseases has considerably risen with the development of deep learning as compared to machine learning. A number of performance matrices are being used to analyze the various models into consideration. Classification is a fantastic application for deep learning. It speeds up the process, automates it, and improves image classification accuracy. This paper utilizes the techniques of deep learning to diagnose the disease of various plants (pepper, tomato, potato). It has been observed VGG19 gave the highest accuracy due to the presence of more layers. This can be further improved to enhance the accuracy by employing more layers, adjusting the number of epochs and ensembles techniques. The proposed model in this paper attains an accuracy of 93.8 with 5 epochs in VGG-19.

articleTitle: Bird Image Retrieval & Recognition Using a Deep Learning Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Bird watching is a popular hobby among nature enthusiasts that has been enjoyed for centuries. With the advancement of technology, it is now possible to use deep learning platforms to identify and track different species of birds. The use of deep learning platforms in bird watching enables the collection of vast amounts of data on bird behaviour and population trends. This data can be used to gain insights into bird migration patterns, breeding habits, and other important aspects of bird behaviour. A CNN that was trained to locate and identify features in bird images. The network used a region of interest to improve the accuracy of object recognition and balanced the distribution of bird species to avoid bias. Additionally, the outputs of previous and more current layers were mixed using the skip connection method to enhance feature extraction. The learned parameters were then utilised to recognise birds in photos submitted by mobile users after the SoftMax algorithm was used to create a probability distribution of bird feature values. The proposed CNN model performed better in terms of accuracy and average sensitivity and specificity when compared to earlier methods., and accuracy of 93.79%, 96.11%, and 95.37%, respectively, for the test dataset.

articleTitle: Multilayer Security Approach for Internet of Things using Omura Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Many security concerns are collected and organized for presenting the data in internet of things infrastructure by conducting a review of several research articles and journals. According to [1], after examining the numerous facts, it was possible to divide the research project into four distinct layers. We have recommended a composite security framework by incorporating authentication mechanism such as digital signature & MAC with cryptography technique known as MAC-OMURA. In order to provide resilient security for IOT devices, the goal of this scientific study is to build a multilayered security method, which is further addressed in depth using four different levels. The Three Pass Multilayer Security Approach, which uses [E3(E2(E1(P, K) DS) MAC], is advocated in this paper contribution to manage the many security vulnerabilities present at the element layer of the IOT architecture. These dangers include unauthorized access, eavesdropping, and spoofing.

articleTitle: A Survey On Slice Security In 5G Network
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: 5G is an emerging communication medium and becoming forthcoming revolution of cellular technology and fulfill the human beings needs. To cope with explosive growth of network traffic in the future, 5G networks should be able to support diversified service requirements at the same time to meet the requirements of different services for network throughput, delay, quantity, and reliability [1]. To maintain all the requirements, need of M2M, D2D, M2H slice security is required in 5g networks.

articleTitle: Quora Question Pairs using PERT
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Quora is a simple portal for asking questions and linking with experienced people who may provide thoughtful and well-written responses. With millions of users accessing Quora every day, it is not surprising that many individuals post identical or similar-intent queries. Because of their effective text representations developed through extensive corpus training, pre-trained language models (PLMs) have been employed extensively for resolving natural language processing (NLP) challenges. This study examines the task of Natural Language Understanding (NLU) by examining Quora dataset’s duplicate question identification. We employ PERT, an auto-encoding model similar to BERT that trains on the Permutation Language Model (PerLM). The experiment’s findings demonstrate that PERT can outperform a number of related baseline models.

articleTitle: Machine Learning for Fake News Detection A Survey
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: As information is widely disseminated through digital media platforms, it is crucial for people and society to be able to assess its reliability. Although the idea of fake news is not new, it is a typical occurrence in the modern world. Fake news’ effects can range from being merely irritating to influencing and deceiving entire cultures or even entire nations. There are numerous ways to spot fake news. We identify the primary methods currently available to spot fake news and how these methods might be used in various contexts by conducting a systematic literature review. Several research attempts to distinguish between true and fraudulent news on social media websites. Fake news is stopped from spreading via accurate and prompt identification. Therefore, the purpose of this work is to review the fake news detection models that have been developed using various machine learning methods.

articleTitle: Cloud Based Voting System Using Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Cloud-based voting system employing blockchain technology utilizes the decentralized and encrypted characteristics of blockchain to ensure the legitimacy of election process. Using a cloud-based platform, voters can cast ballots which are then stored on a blockchain network. A cryptographic hash of the prior block and a timestamp are included in each block, rendering the chain resilient. This study examines the prospects for creating a cloud-based voting system using blockchain technology. To improve the security and dependability of electronic voting systems, this manuscript highlighted the perks of blockchain technology, such as decentralization, transparency, and immutability. The study also highlights the difficulties and threats of adopting blockchain technology for voting systems, such as scalability assaults, or reliance on dubious mechanisms, and resistance to the coercion. The research emphasizes the necessity for substantial and in-depth investigations to solve these difficulties and hazards. To address the drawbacks of the current electronic voting systems and guarantee the security, dependability, and integrity of the voting process, deeper analysis and development is required. The emerging world with the advancement of technology is moving towards cloud-based digitization rapidly due to which the need of cloud security is rising dramatically. This research demonstrates the immense potential of blockchain technology for online voting. A safe and transparent voting system can be created by utilizing the advantages of blockchain technology, fostering faith and confidence in the democratic process.

articleTitle: Face Recognition System Using Haar Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Face recognition has been the most demanding field over the past two decades. We can analyze the reason stems from the need for automated visual and monitoring systems which have power to replace all human efforts done manually. These researches involve knowledge such as neuroscience, computer vision, pattern recognition, machine learning and many other techniques. Face recognition is better than other diagnostic procedures namely: fingerprint, iris scanning, signature etc. The face recognition system uses two techniques face detection and face recognition and combine both to build a face recognition system. The first face detection process is performed on acquired images and it will find the object. The second face recognition process uses algorithms to find details about a person’s face. Thereafter these distinctive details, such as the distance between the eyes, the distance from the mouth to the nose and eyes or the shape of chin and all the specific details is then converted into statistical representation and compared with the data stored in the facial recognition database.

articleTitle: Real-Time Secure Web-Based Chat Application using Django
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The Internet has brought the entire world within our reach, allowing us to do everything from sharing information to purchasing products online. This has made the world feel smaller, and the current project also relies on the Internet. The objective of the project is to develop a web-based application that enables users to establish immediate and live connections. A chat application is a feature that enables online users to connect with one another directly, and it is critical to prioritize error-free data flow when developing such applications. Chat software allows users to communicate even when they are geographically separated. Encryption is an effective solution for preventing hackers or intruders from stealing data, and the N-TEA algorithm is recommended for securing chat messages in web apps. The N-TEA algorithm is a real-time encryption system that operates independently of the type of data being transmitted and is supported by a reliable encryption method. According to research findings, the N-TEA algorithm can securely transmit messages, with a 36.72% avalanche effect caused by a change in plaintext character and a 42.9% avalanche impact due to the change in the encryption key character. The App is developed using Django Framework in the back end and CSS and HTML in the front end.

articleTitle: The Revolutionary Potential of Blockchain using Smart Contracts: Unlocking the Next Generation of Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Blockchain is a technology that uses decentralized network of nodes (miners), blockchain consists of blocks. Each block has three parts data, hash, hash of previous block. Once data is stored it is very difficult to change the data to temper the data. Miners verify the transaction by calculating its hash function for which they get to keep some commission. In this review paper will provide a deep understanding of Blockchain technology and its applications through a Smart contract used for industries like banking, healthcare, supply chain, security, and numerous others. Blockchain is a growing field of worlds with newer applications throughout the various types of fields in the industry from the use of cryptocurrency to hospital management and various others, these applications are only made possible because of How blockchain works and does things.

articleTitle: Cloud Security: An Innovative Technique for the Enhancement of Cloud Security
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Enterprises can adopt cloud computing without having to make a significant initial investment. Although there may be advantages to cloud computing, model One of the challenges in adopting the cloud model is the persistent concerns about security. This is made more complicated by the introduction of new elements such as model multi-tenancy, architecture, and layered dependency stack, elasticity, which further increase the complexity of security issues. hindering The security of present technology is at risk when the cloud model design is applied. Customers of cloud services should therefore be aware of the dangers involved in putting data into this unusual environment. As a result, this article examines a number of cryptographic domains that threaten cloud computing. The specific security issues of using encryption in a cloud computing system are outlined in this study.

articleTitle: Automatic Train Tracking and Announcement System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In many of the developing countries, the railway passengers are facing the issues during their long-distance train journey such as identifying the arrival station, identifying train platform number. Because of these issues passengers need keep more attention with fear to find whether the train is reached the destination or not. Sometimes, the passengers may get down in the wrong destination. Similarly, during departure of the journey, passengers miss the train or may get the wrong train because they unable find the platform number of their train. Also in many developed countries, the above issues are sorted by using technologies, but the entire system is not fully automatic and manual processes are involved or there will various mobile, or web applications are used. So, this paper focusing on the development an automatic electronic system for train tracking, announcing the platform number of train and alerting the user through audio announcement and sending alert SMS to the passengers when they nearing the station like 3 km away from their arrival station.

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Detection using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: At first, people were unaware of brain tumors, it was believed that there was no cure for the disease, and the main control of the humanoid system was carried out by the human brain. Brain tumors form when brain cells grow and divide abnormally, and brain cancers form when brain tumors continue to grow. Computer purpose is essential in the field of medical because it removes the need for human judgment to produce correct results. The safest MRI techniques are likes of X-ray, CT-Scan and many more useful techniques. Such techniques can even identify small objects. Brain cancer using brain MRI. Abilateral (BF) filter was used in the pre-processing of this study to remove any noise present. For clinical anaysis there is a method termed as Medical imaging is used which basically provides visual representation of the inshore of body and also to show its functioning. Medical imaging is becoming increasingly important as the need for automatic, quick and efficient diagnosis increases, which can provide better image understanding than the human eye. Seeing different trends among young age group it can be said the brain tumor might be the major source of deaths caused by cancer among age group of 20-39. Brain tumors are painful and, if not treated properly, can eventually lead to various diseases.

articleTitle: A Review of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning methods for enhancing cyber security
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The network of smart physical object has a significant impact on the growth of urban civilization. The evidence has been cited from the digital sources such as scientific journals, conferences and publications, etc. Along with other security services, these kinds of structured, sophisticated data have addressed a number of security-related challenges. Here, many forms of cutting-edge machine learning and AI techniques are used to research how merging two or more algorithms with AI and ML might make the internet of things more safe. The main objective of this paper is it explore the applications of how ML and AI that can be used to improve IOT security.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an E-hospital Management system using Django and CSS
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Electronic hospital management system (HMS) has proven to be a boon in recent years, by eliminating the need for maintaining records and booking appointments on paper, almost all the hospitals have shifted to this methodology. A hospital has many footfall and maintaining records and booking appointments can be a difficult task. In this research article, a different system that incorporates various functionality of an efficient hospital has been stated, the functions range from appointment bookings, patient monitoring, and doctor monitoring and illustrate the superiority of the admin over the whole system. The system uses Django, HTML, and CSS as core technologies to develop the website on a local server. This system is efficient and easy to use with all major functionality incorporated which makes it unique and practical.

articleTitle: Youtube Transcript Synthesis
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: YouTube video transcription involves converting the spoken words videotape into written text for a variety of reasons, including providing captions for viewers with hearing impairments, enhancing SEO by providing more textual content, and increasing the video's accessibility to a greater audience. Commonly used for transcription is automated speech recognition software, but due to its tendency to produce inaccurate results, many content creators and businesses prefer human transcription. The finished transcription can be used to create captions or subtitles that improve content accessibility and comprehension, or it can be repurposed for other platforms, such as blog posts and social media updates. In conclusion, YouTube video transcription is a valuable instrument for content creators and businesses seeking to improve the accessibility, reach, and engagement of their video content through the provision of accurate transcriptions and captions.

articleTitle: Machine Learning based Data Traffic Prediction and Classification of Sensor Nodes in Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The lifetime and high throughput are two significant concerns of wireless sensor networks. The lifetime of the network can be increased by the efficient allotment of the slots and efficient utilization by sensor nodes. However, the major challenge is that the data generation by the sensor nodes is primarily random in real-time applications. Therefore, the allotted channel is not utilized efficiently, and most of the time, the channel’s bandwidth is wasted due to a variable rate of data generation. In such cases, few nodes fail to transmit the data, and few nodes waste their slots due to the unavailability of the data. To resolve the issue, a machine learning-based efficient data slot allotment method is proposed for energy-efficient bandwidth utilization in the present work. In the proposed method, the node’s data traffic is predicted based on the previous dataset records. In addition, the prediction helps classify the nodes into event monitoring or periodic/continuous monitoring nodes. The dominance of the proposed protocol is presented by the energy consumption of the presented protocol compared to the energy-efficient bit-map-assisted protocol. The results prove that the proposed protocol saves energy by efficiently allotting data slots based on the machine learning approach.

articleTitle: Review of Efficient Methods for Sentiment Analysis of E-Commerce Customer Review using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The buying behavior on an E-Commerce website is overly influenced by the type of customer reviews the product receives. Increasing volume of online shopping has caused the consumer rely highly on the opinions of the other customers when making purchase decision. Not just the individual review but also the volume of reviews has an impact on the customer. However, it can be challenging for the customer as well as the businesses to analyze all these reviews to make a decision. This problem could be solved by classifying these reviews with the help of various machine learning methods by analyzing their sentiments in three different categories namely, positive, neutral and negative sentiments, which could be done using the subjective text on the web. This research paper explores various predictive models like machine learning, deep learning, transfer learning, etc. and covers the techniques and approaches for sentiment analysis of e-commerce customer review using machine learning, and find out the most efficient one of all whiles finding out the enhancement that could be made into them.

articleTitle: Hybrid machine learning techniques for travel recommendations
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Humans have always had a natural need to travel. Regardless of obstacles like age, gender, color, or geographic restrictions, people aspired to travel for a variety of reasons. Travel and adventure are currently the most popular forms of entertainment. For inexperienced travelers, planning a trip is a laborious and time-consuming effort. Here is where professional advice for creating the ideal travel schedule may be available. In the age of technology, data or information is crucial to completing any activity. A system that pulls relevant and helpful material from the vast informational pool is necessary since people are suffering from information overload because of the Internet’s rapid proliferation. The tourism sector needs a system like this. The many recommendation algorithms and methodologies now used in the industry have been addressed in this paper.

articleTitle: Impact of Covid 19 and advisable Solutions through IT
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The latest coronavirus (COVID-19) epidemic is putting the world’s health-care systems under unprecedented strain. The COVID-19 epidemic has harmed local communities, government, and health. Furthermore, as a consequence of an upsurge in COVID-19 case registrations from additional countries, the WHO Emergency Committee declared a global health emergency on January 21, 2020. Despite having an impact on socioeconomic phenomena and a variety of international phenomena, including trade, tourism, remittances, commodity prices, and the loss of many jobs and significant decreases in pay, the pandemic also had a detrimental impact on a variety of other global phenomena. Telemedicine has benefited from the enhancements in communication, data presentation, and resource management made possible by technological advancements.
