In this study, utilising data from the COVID-19 events, we provide an IT support method for assessing pandemic data behaviors including exponential growth and deviations. This study has also included research on how the COVID-19 epidemic has impacted many aspects of the information technology sector.

Index Terms: Public Health Emergency Of International Concern

articleTitle: Hand Gesture Recognition and Interaction
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The most natural form of effective interaction between humans and computers in a virtual scenario can be seen through gestures. Humans use hand gestures as a form of non- verbal communication and they can be used in a variety of fields such as Human-Computer interaction, robot control and communication between deaf and mute persons (HCI). The aim is to create a Hand Gesture based presentation system through which we will be able to move the slides back and forth with a pointer and sketching abilities. Additionally an erasing gesture will make it more functional.

articleTitle: HR Dashboard Analytics
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Every company wants to get full information and hidden pattern about the rate of hiring and attrition of their employees. Most of the companies have structured or unstructured data related to the hiring and attrition of their employees but there is no easy way to visualize and extract hidden patterns from the data. They need to hire resources for work as simple as visualization. This not only increases their cost but also creates a risk of a data leak.HR dashboard allows users to instantly create a dynamic dashboard full of visualizations instantly without the need of having deep knowledge of programming languages. An HR Dashboard is a visualization dashboard created using R’s Flex Dashboard framework which provides us a way to create dynamic dashboards. The goal of the HR dashboard is to allow visualization and understanding of company data such as Hiring’s, Expenses, Employee leaving rate, etc. The HR dashboard package will allow users to install and visualize any company’s data as long as they match a particular data structure. The HR dashboard consists of different graphs such as line graph, bar graph to visualize temporal (time-related data), and a leaflet map for spatial (Geography related data). The whole dashboard is divided into different tabs for easy navigation and to avoid mixing of different categories of information.

articleTitle: Designing Data Loss Prevention System for The Enhancement of Data Integrity in Cyberspace
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Today data is the biggest asset for the company. Due to increase in cyber attacks it is necessary to protect them from cyber threats. One of the biggest concerns for a company is to maintain data integrity. To maintain the integrity and reliability it is necessary to have an efficient data loss prevention system. Traditional approaches like firewall can’t protect our data anymore which will have a huge impact on the company. To prevent these negative impacts reliable data loss prevention is necessary.Data loss prevention (DLP) systems are critical tools for protecting sensitive data from loss or theft. Traditional DLP solutions have focused on a single approach, such as endpoint DLP or network DLP. However, in today’s complex and rapidly evolving threat landscape, organizations need a more comprehensive approach to data loss prevention. This paper proposes a methodology for combining behaviour-based DLP, machine learning-based DLP, and network-based DLP to enhance data integrity in cyberspace. This approach provides a comprehensive and integrated solution that detects and prevents data loss across the entire network. The proposed methodology includes identifying sensitive data, deploying endpoint DLP, network DLP, and machine learning DLP solutions, integrating the DLP solutions, implementing monitoring and reporting, and continuously improving the system. By combining these DLP approaches, organizations can better protect sensitive data and ensure data integrity in today’s complex and evolving threat landscape [1] [6].

articleTitle: Crowd Density Identification at Cross Section using machine learning and deep learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The estimation of crowd density at cross sections is a significant problem in the crowd analysis. In this study, we provide a novel technique for determining crowd density using Multi-column Convolutional Neural Networks (M-CNN). The proposed approach uses the M-CNN architecture to predict crowd densities at cross sections and learn hierarchical features from input photographs. Moreover, for this analysis ShanghaiTech dataset is utilized as (80-20)% training and testing datasets. The robustness of the M-CNN model is evaluated on the basis of normal error, Mean average error (MAE), Mean squared error (MSE), and growth truth. The findings demonstrate that the proposed model is highly accurate, and performs well after a few initial iterations. Furthermore, it can be incorporated in public places for crowd estimation and recognition.

articleTitle: Combining static BERT embedding and TCN-CNN ensemble for text classification
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The process of classifying articles into predefined categories is known as text classification. Nowadays, the number of documents is increasing exponentially, necessitating the categorization of these documents for a variety of purposes, including spam detection, news classification, text retrieval, and many more. In this study, we present an approach wherein a TCN and 1-D CNN ensemble model are fed static BERT embeddings. We input the BERT embedding into two models, the TCN model and the 1-D CNN model, after transforming the document into sentence embedding using a pre-trained BERT model. The final output is obtained by combining the outputs of the two models and feeding it into a dense layer. We test the performance of the introduced model on multiple datasets and observe that it gives good results as compared to some popular methods of text classification.

articleTitle: Vehicle Detection in Parking Lots
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Following the rapid increase in car ownership, many cities are experiencing a shortage of parking spaces due to an imbalance between the supply and demand for parking, which can be seen as the root cause of city parking issues. This mismatch is partly a result of poor land use planning and incorrect estimates of the amount of space needed in the early stages of development. There are many common parking issues, including a lack of parking spaces, exorbitant parking fees, and traffic backups caused by people looking for parking. Through the course of our research project, convolutional neural networks based on YOLOv5 is used to detect cars in parking lot. The images are taken from different angles and different light settings to ensure the model has been trained accurately. The highest accuracy was for YOLOv5 with an accuracy score of 85.12%.

articleTitle: A Fuzzy inventory model for deteriorating items under inflation with displayed stock dependent demand using Genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: To enhance the precision of an inventory model, it is necessary to define various approaches such as Graded Mean, Signed Distance, and Centroid. These approaches play a crucial role in effectively managing diverse categories of goods, including food, medicine, and clothing. The author highlights the difficulties faced by manufacturing facilities when implementing operational constraints, strategic business policies, profit targets, and other refinements. The article also introduces a comprehensive inventory model that incorporates both clear-cut and fuzzy elements, taking into account scarcity and partial backlog constraints. This model addresses the challenges posed by variable demand rates and irregular deterioration patterns for commodities. By employing fuzzy logic and genetic algorithms, the objective is to minimize conflicting task objectives and enhance the efficiency of optimal inventory models. To estimate the optimal cost, the model employs graded mean representation, signed distance, and centroid techniques. The cost-effectiveness of different methodologies is compared through the use of numerical examples and sensitivity tables. Additionally, a genetic algorithm (GA) is employed to solve the model, which is demonstrated through a numerical example.

articleTitle: Twitter Bot For Consumer Feedback Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: This research presents the development of a Twitter bot for consumer feedback analysis using natural language processing (NLP) techniques. The bot is designed to collect and analyze tweets related to specific products or services, and provide businesses with real-time insights on consumer sentiment and feedback. The bot uses a combination of NLP techniques, including sentiment analysis, topic modeling, and keyword extraction, to identify trends and insights from the tweets. The resulting analysis can be used by businesses to improve their products or services, as well as their customer engagement strategies. The paper also discusses the challenges and opportunities associated with developing and deploying such a bot, including ethical considerations related to privacy and data protection.

articleTitle: Cryptocurrency Trend Predictions through LSTM-Based Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Cryptocurrencies are network-based digital exchange that has turned out to be a commodity with a great future scope which made it gained extreme popularity as it has stock like feature in the financial sector. It has grabbed the attention of various investors and scientists making various earlier cryptocurrencies reach the market high. These cryptocurrencies rely on blockchain technology, means that they have adapted to its various properties such as decentralization, immutability, peer-to-peer transaction and transparency which makes it almost impossible to be controlled by a Central Authority. Cryptocurrency can be considered a confusing commodity to handle for investors to acquire through mining or network user to other user exchange. Various market places have been formed for trading in various cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin(BTC), Ethereum(ETH), XRP(XRP), Polygon(MATIC), ADA and many more. These unique characteristics of cryptocurrency cause daily price fluctuations, making it difficult to forecast their price. In this paper, taking the unique characteristics into consideration, we need a tool for prediction to help the investor learn whether the value of a cryptocurrency will go up or down, these types of prediction tools are common in stock market industry, so we can do the same for the cryptocurrency sector. Long short-term Memory (LSTM) is a complicated neural network based on ANN architecture. This paper studies about crypto currency close-price prediction of various popular cryptocurrencies using the LSTM mode

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of ResNet50, EfficientNetB7, InceptionV3 and VGG16 models in Lung Cancer Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The society is thriving in uncertain times wherein any disease can get hold of the human body at any point of time leading to major consequences, the untimely detection can also lead to an increase of medical expenses at the cost of the life of a human. It is seen that cancer is another menace which haunts the society with lung cancer being the most common because of the smoking habits of the masses, lung cancer effects the air passages of a person inside their lungs leading to the worst-case scenario of a cancer death. To prevent such scenarios, the paper proposes this research to be able to detect the presence of lung cancer in a person with the help of images provided by CT scan of a person, the proposed methodology would work by first refining the images with the help of convolutional neural network (CNN) architecture and then the framework would study the images to detect the nodules of the lung, compare them to be malignant or nonhazardous thus predicting the possibility of lung cancer.

articleTitle: A Robust Sign Language and Hand Gesture Recognition System Using Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Sign language and hand gesture recognition systems have become increasingly important in recent years due to the growing demand for human computer interaction. In this paper, we propose a robust convolutional neural network (CNN)-based system for hand gesture and sign language identification. Using a custom dataset of Indian sign language and hand gestures, our method refines a pre-trained CNN model [1]. On a test set, we assess our system’s performance, and we get a 98.6% accuracy rate. Our research aids in the creation of reliable sign language recognition systems that may be put to practical use in fields like human-computer interaction and assistive technology for deaf and hard-of-hearing people.

articleTitle: Disease Spread Prediction using Sentiment Analysis of Tweets
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The emergence and growth of social media platforms have contributed to the advancement and evolution of new methods for tracking the spread of diseases and analyzing their impact on communities. Sentiment analysis of tweets has shown promising results in understanding the public’s response to global health issues. This report provides a comprehensive analysis of the use of sentiment analysis of tweets in disease spread analysis, including the methods used, training and application of sentiment analysis in disease spread analysis. The study focuses on the prediction analysis of Alzheimer, Cancer, Stroke, Parkinson, Heart Attack, Depression, and Covid-19 in India, revealing that people in different states had different sentiments towards these health conditions. The report highlights the importance of using multiple data sources, including social media, to track disease spread and discusses ethical considerations associated with using social media data for research purposes.

articleTitle: Unfolding Finance 4.0 through Digital Innovation and Financial Automation
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The financial services sector in India has leveraged the power of Industry 4.0 extensively on account of digital innovation and automation of financial processes. The rising competition in the financial services sector has compelled financial institutions to create value for their customers through new service offerings. To participate and prosper in the challenging business environment, traditional banks have to build new value propositions and business models for a leading edge. Digital technologies such as the cloud, the Internet of Things (IoT), analytics, automation, robotics, and artificial intelligence are the enablers of transformation in financial services. Fintech innovations coupled with mass personalisation and product customisation have led financial institutions to embark on the adoption of technology-led change. The paper aims to study the adoption of digital technologies by financial institutions to expand their scope and outreach of personalised services to enhance customer value.

articleTitle: Dynamic analysis based Android Malware Detection using ANN and RFE Feature Selection
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In recent years, extensive usage of mobile phones has led to a drastic rise in malware attacks. The classification of these malware has become extremely challenging as they are hidden in normal applications. However, technological growth in machine learning models makes the task of detecting existing malware and predicting the unknown malware possible. This paper proposes an Artificial Neural Network based dynamic malware analysis technique with CICMalDroid2020 dataset. The performance of ANN is improved in predicting unknown malware by applying different optimizers of ANN which minimize the error to 0.01%. All the input neurons (features of the dataset) of ANN may not contain relevant information. Hence, Recursive Feature Elimination technique is applied to identify features which are capable of classifying and predicting different categories of malware in the dataset. Experiment results show that only 34% of the total features can achieve around 99% accuracy to detect benign and malicious malware.

articleTitle: CUTTA: Canine Utility Trainable Talkative Application
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The prevalence of pet adoption is progressively growing in our modern society. Consequently, this act of embracing pets engenders profound emotional connections with the animals. In these scenarios around 23% of the pets are estimated to be cats and 33% are estimated to be dogs. One common challenge faced by pet owners after adopting a pet is the issue of leaving their pets alone at home when all family members have to be away for various reasons, such as festivals or long day trips. This predicament is more prevalent in dogs, particularly those of medium and large breeds. One major challenge individual encountered when leaving their pets alone was ensuring they were adequately nourished, safeguarding the house against unauthorized access. To address this problem, a specialized system has been developed, which activates once it is turned on. Its primary function is to ensure that a dog is appropriately fed three times a day. In cases where the pet refuses to eat, the user will receive notifications through a Telegram bot. Similarly, if the food dispenser or water dispenser is running low, the system will also send notifications through the Telegram bot. Additionally, the system is equipped with an anti-intrusion monitor, which will promptly inform the user through the Telegram bot in case of any unauthorized access attempts.

articleTitle: “A Mobile Application for Women’s Safety: Myguard”
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: This paper addresses the issue of women’s safety, which is a growing concern in many countries, particularly India. The police often face significant challenges in responding promptly to distress calls due to various constraints, including a lack of information regarding the location and existence of the crime. Additionally, women may find it difficult to discreetly and securely reach out to law enforcement. To address these problems, MyGuard, a revolutionary mobile app, has been developed to assist women in feeling more secure in their everyday lives. The app allows users to trigger a panic alert using a preset word with just a few taps. If the user fails to arrive at their destination on time, the app automatically notifies preselected emergency contacts and the closest police station with their geographic location. This paper provides an overview of the development and technical implementation of MyGuard, which is a game-changer for women’s safety [16].

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Tomato Leaf Disease Detection Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Tomato is the most liberal & significant crops found in the world. Crop production of tomato can be seriously affected due to diseases detected in plant and improper treatments. Climate, weather, natural disasters, the diseases in plant are other calamities that have a significant impact on agricultural productivity and causes economic loss. In this context, this study presents a comparative study of the leaf disease diagnosis in tomato plant using machine learning (ML) techniques. A review of different existing models is done in order to identify which model works better and provides much higher accuracy. A InceptionV3 based ML model has been proposed in order to diagnose leaf disorders in tomatoes at an early stage and further protect the plant from other diseases, the proposed method offers classification accuracy of 81%.

articleTitle: Efficient Support System for Hearing Disabled using CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Objective: In today’s world communication plays a major role in a person’s life in many ways. Communication is a process of conveying or transferring your feelings, knowledge or ideas to the rest of the world. This becomes very difficult for a person who cannot speak or listen. To overcome this problem we aim to develop a sign language system that is able to detect the hand gestures of the Deaf and Dumb from the captured images and convert them into a text format so that a person who does not have any knowledge of the sign language can understand them easily. Scope: This project aims at detecting the hand gestures performed by the deaf and dumb person and translate those signs into readable form so that the communication barrier between the physically challenged and ordinary people can be removed. Method: Deep learning and computer vision for detecting the signs of the sign language performed by the deaf and dumb people have proved to be very efficient. The dataset contains images of different signs in the Indian sign language which is used to train a neural network. Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is used for the classification of the signs for the alphabet and numbers. Findings: This research has immense capability to detect the hand gestures performed by Deaf and Dumb people and to remove the communication gap between deaf and dumb people and the ordinary people. Therefore, our paper will provide a convenient way for ordinary people to understand and easily understand the deaf and dumb people.

articleTitle: Symptom based Clinical Decision Support System using various Machine learning models
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The widespread adoption of computer-based technology in the healthcare industry has resulted in an influx of electronic data. Due to this substantial amount of data sometimes it is difficult for the doctor to accurately diagnose the disease in one go or in the early stages of that disease. The accurate and on-time analysis of any health-related problem is important for on-time accurate treatment. Developing a symptom based clinical decision support system using machine learning can help in prediction of most of the diseases that can help a doctor in discovering some things he did not anticipate and to support his decision while diagnosing a disease. The motive of the given project is to formulate a disease prediction or a clinical decision support system using multiple Machine Learning Algorithms. The dataset used has around 5000 rows in which there are around 130 different types of symptoms and currently 43 different types of prognosis or diseases to classify or predict from. The aim of our diagnosis model is to act as a doctor’s assistant which can help them analyze the patient better and help its prediction give some support to the doctor’s decision. it also increases the accuracy of predicting the disease day by day. A system based clinical support architecture with soul goal of improving the diagnosis report with our patient health information and other parameters to give a close approximation of what the person might be suffering from. A traditional system-based clinic decision is a database that has pre-existing knowledge of clinical procedures, symptoms- disease correlation and other parameters uses this software to match with patients’ condition and recommendation the list of most possible ailment the patient is suffering from.

articleTitle: Detection of Dental Cavity using Wireless Sensor based Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Dental Cavities are most common persistent disorders across the lifespan and are mainly avoidable. Untreated tooth decay can develop in an abscess behind the gums, it’s a type of infection that may be spread in to other regions of the mouth or between tooth and cause catastrophic, occasionally fatal consequences. Now days, dental caries is a common tooth decay issue and the people of all generations may be affected from this problem especially children. Because of its increasing incidence, successful intervention measures are required. To provide best care and early detection of cavities, wireless sensor technology has gained popularity in the dental industry. In an effort to avoid and diagnose dental caries in the first stage of cavity, this article suggests innovative and creative approach based on wireless sensors technology, cloud storage for patient data storage, telemedicine. This paper explain different types of sensors used in detection process of dental cavity. Through this article, we suggest a sensor technology based dental cavity detection model and explain how we detect dental caries based on collected data by sensors.

articleTitle: Real Estate Price Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Predicting property prices in cities like Bengaluru and Pune remains a challenging and intricate task. The sale value of properties in these cities is influenced by numerous factors, including the property’s area, location, and various other variables. This research undertakes an analytical study, utilizing publicly available datasets that encompass diverse features of various properties. The aim is to develop a predictive model for assessing property prices based on the influencing factors. The modeling process involves employing regression techniques such as Linear Regression, Multiple Linear Regression, and various classification algorithms like XG Boost. These methods are utilized to construct predictive models, and the selection of the best-performing model is determined through a comprehensive analysis.

articleTitle: Predicting Diabetes Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Diabetes could create a global health care catastrophe. The International Diabetes Federation, predicted that there are currently 382 million diabetics worldwide and this figure will treble by 2035 to 592 Million Diabetics! Diabetes is increased blood glucose levels are a characteristic. Diabetes is one of the main risk factors for renal failure, heart failure, and stroke., amputations, blindness and kidney failure and its symptoms are frequent urination, increased thirst and appetite. Diabetes also plays a significant role in heart attacks, strokes, heart failure and blindness among many other complications that affect quality of life such as blindness. As we consume food, our bodies convert it to glucose for use as fuel, which then triggers insulin release from our pancreas. [13] Insulin acts like a key that unlocks cells to allow glucose in and fuel us -however diabetes makes this process ineffective - it affects one or both types of individuals in society. There are both typical forms and unusual variations of diabetes, such as gestational diabetes. [6] Machine Learning, which explores how computers learn through experience, was chosen as the focus for this work in order to develop an early diabetes prediction system that more accurately meets patient needs by combining several machine learning methodologies such as K Closest Neighbor Algorithm (KCLNA), Logistic Regression, Decision Tree Support Vector Machine and Random Forest; then compute accuracy scores for each model before selecting those with good accuracy scores for use when making predictions about gestational diabetes diagnosis.

Author Keywords: Support Vector Machine Accuracy Machine Learning Diabetes

articleTitle: Multimodal Sentiment Analysis of Social Media Data for Predicting Box Office Outcome
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The movie industry is growing at an exponential rate and its success ratio is of utmost importance. It would be immensely beneficial if the outcome of a movie can be predicted well in advance. This would also have an impact on the movie marketing strategies owing to the increasing reliance on the social media. Early prediction of a movie’s outcome is not only a challenging but also relevant in today’s era of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML). This paper makes use of Sentiment Analysis (SA) to examine the performance of movies, using Multimodal data obtained from You Tube. We have compared the performance of three (03) ML classifiers i.e., Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Ada Boost to predict the outcome of a movie by curating a data set having sixteen hundred (1600) plus movies and presented the experimental results and observations. The comparative analysis depicts that RF is the most suitable method for prediction of the Box Office (BO) outcome.

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Detection Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Identifying brain tumors and improving patient care are the goals of this project. Brain malignant tumors, which are aberrant cell growths, are known as tumors. Frequently, infectious brain tissues are caught by CT and MRI scans. There are many other methods that are used for the detection of brain tumors and some of them are positive charges imaging and cerebral X-ray photography of blood or lymph vessels and tests at the molecular level. So, this paper will use different MRI images to detect ailment cause like tumors. The main purpose of this research paper is to 1) identify irregular sample images and 2) find the tumor area. The abnormal sections of images will forecast the levels of tumors so that proper treatment can be done. Deep learning is used to find abnormal regions from sample images. This paper will use VGG-16 to segment the abnormal part. The density of the infected region is defined by the number of pixels with malignancy.

articleTitle: Deep Fake in picture using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Deepfake is a system that combines fake pictures and videos with deep learning. Deep learning is the source of Deepfake. The unethical practice of creating falsified photographs and movies is now possible because of neoteric advances in the fields of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. Today, it is very easy to create photo simulative images using generative adversarial networks. These fake images and videos are widely available on the internet and social media. It is difficult to tell which of them is real or not. These images are typically taken with the goal of stirring up social disturbance, political turmoil, or distributing false information among the general public. Viewers will easily comprehend these images because they will look to be real. Deepfake is rapidly harming individuals, communities, companies, security, religion, and democracy, according to recent studies. These videos and photographs are of astounding quality, and they have a huge social media reach. It has far-reaching effects that are destructive beyond comprehension. An extensive overview of the different deep-fake methods is provided in this publication. So, the objective of this paper is to identify these fake images using a conventional neural network. In order to address this issue, we train a model for particular datasets, produce deep fakes, and then use that model to try to identify the deep fake. An authentic and false image is required for the training process in order to train the model.

articleTitle: Drones and Networks: Ensuring safe and secure operations using 5g mobile network
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) i.e., drones have become increasingly popular in recent years for various applications, including surveying, photography, delivery, and even military operations. However, their widespread use raises concerns about safety and security, as drones can invade privacy, and even be used for malicious purposes. To ensure safe and secure drone operations, it is crucial to establish robust drone networks that can effectively monitor, control, and manage drone traffic. An important aspect of ensuring safe and secure drone operations is to establish clear regulations and guidelines for drone use. To accomplish safety and security there is a need of establishing no-fly zones, setting altitude limits, and requiring operators to obtain licenses and certifications. Additionally, drone operators must be trained to operate drones safely, and drones must be equipped with safety features such as collision avoidance systems and emergency landing capabilities. Overall, the safe and secure operation of drones depends on the effective integration of drone networks, regulations, and technologies. By developing and implementing robust drone networks and regulations, it can promote the responsible and beneficial use of drones while minimizing their risks and negative impacts.

articleTitle: Sarcasm Detection of Newspaper Headlines Using LSTM-RNN
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Even for humans, it can be difficult to recognize sarcasm, which is an important part of communication. To attract readers’ attention, sarcasm is frequently used in newspaper headlines. Although headlines usually include irony, readers frequently miss it, misinterpreting the news and spreading misinformation to friends, coworkers, and other people. As a result, it is more important than ever to have a system that can automatically and reliably recognize sarcasm. In order to build sarcasm detectors, employ neural networks, and investigate how a computer may learn sarcastic patterns. The sequences that are fed into our project might be ironic or not. From collections of news headlines, these sequences were created. Classifiers are well evaluated for accuracy. Our approach is effective at identifying the difference between remarks that are sarcastic and those that are not. Sarcasm identification is a method for spotting expressions that mean the exact opposite of what they mean to say. Systems for sentiment analysis that rely on emotion recognition face a substantial barrier due to the metaphorical character of sarcasm. Natural language processing (NLP) is a highly specialised field that focuses on sarcasm identification rather than sentiment analysis across many domains. Sarcasm detection in online forums is one such application

articleTitle: A Performance Evaluation of Glove Bi-LSTM and BERT based Deep Learning Approach for the Detection of Fake News
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: There has been a surge in disseminating disreputable data since the advent of the internet. Even if the internet helps keep us updated on current events, it facilitates the rapid dissemination misleading information and propaganda. Since information influences people’s perceptions everywhere, fighting against this bogus news is crucial. People use the information they gather to do more than form their opinions; they also make essential value judgments. If this data turns out to be inaccurate, it might have catastrophic consequences. It is unrealistic to expect a single person to confirm every news item independently. This paper proposes a hybrid deep learning model that combines LSTM and BERT with Glove. We implement machine learning methods such as naive Bayes, ensemble learning, and XG-boost. Finally, we analyze performance in terms of accuracy and loss and discover that the BERT model produces the optimal results.

articleTitle: Identification of Attributes of the Proposed Ontological based Framework for Corporate Governance using Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The evolution of corporate governance is seen in all aspects of organizational domains. The capacity to evaluate the efficiency of the organization’s developing strategies is available in several countries throughout the world. Initiatives relating to social change and the environment face challenges in the societies of different countries across the world. The methodological aspects may evaluate the corporate governance sectors’ developing aspects as well. This paper focuses on the questions and attributes that must be included in the Indian corporate governance framework. A framework has also been presented to study the aspects of corporate governance in India’s industrial and service industries. The framework is prepared using data mining and ontology in hierarchical fashion.

articleTitle: Land Registration System using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Land administration system is important for the management, allocation, and handling related to land, affecting a wide range of stakeholders. However, one of the biggest challenges in land administration systems is maintaining the accuracy of the data stored within them. Inaccuracies can arise from a variety of factors such as errors in data collection, processing, and misuse. These inaccuracies can lead to issues such as data tampering, lengthy registration times for transactions, and the potential for double-spending, all of which can undermine the integrity of the land administration system. To address these challenges, this research paper proposes the use of blockchain technology, specifically the blockchains contract written in the Solidity programming language. The smart contract is written in the main logic of the implementation. These contracts are logical implementations to determine the owner, seller, and the transfer of the land. The proposed solution uses a distributed ledger system to ensure the accuracy of data in the land administration system. The system verifies the user's record through government officials and assigns a unique hash value to each submitted block of data. When a transaction for the transfer of ownership is initiated, a separate block is created with a unique hash value that is connected to the previous value, creating a sequence of blocks that are chained together. The hashing algorithm employed generates a fixed-size message digest, where each hashed value uniquely represents a complete set of transactions contained in a specific block.

articleTitle: Smart Home Garden Monitoring System Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: A smart home gardening system using IoT cloud technology can greatly enhance the efficiency and convenience of managing garden. It enables the monitor and control various aspects of the garden remotely, making it easier to maintain healthy plants and optimize resource usage. In order to ensure optimum plant development while also using the most amount of irrigation resources, the aim of this effort is to create a prototype for continually managing soil moisture levels and monitoring temperature, humidity, and sun light intensity. The monitoring software blink application has been used, and the sensor data will be available online. Given that water is a need for plant existence, it must not be used excessively. It is possible to program the Arduino Uno to examine some signals from sensors, like moisture and rainfall. With the help of blink user interface has been done which can be used to regulate and monitor the irrigation of water to plants, and an IoT module can be used to display the soil moisture levels and humidity continually on a webpage. The proposed system has various sensors (soil moisture, temperature, humidity, and light depending resistor) for monitoring the garden plants. Controlling and monitoring the water supply and keeping an eye on the plants are the key goals of this work which is envisioned through blink application, where the interfacing between prototype and monitoring environment has been enabled through it. The experimental results shows that the proposed system for garden monitoring is best suitable and economic and accurate in terms of monitoring.

articleTitle: Resilient Rubrix: A Trailblazing Exploration into Sustainable Construction with Rubber
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The 1.5 billion used tires that are now floating around the world are a major environmental danger since they are not biodegradable. Old tires are notorious for emitting harmful compounds into the air, and they are also a major nuisance and a breeding ground for insects and fires. The technological uses, environmental advantages, and commercial feasibility of recycled rubber from old tires have been examined in several publications. This research provides a comprehensive assessment of this literature with a focus on its applicability as construction material for sustainable development and earthworks and infrastructure development, two sectors fundamental to geotechnical engineering. Replacing fine aggregate with different percentages of rubber powder and draw out an investigation. This issue must be researched more and in depth. It is crucial to examine its compressive strength and slump test. If use and conserving natural resources. This study set out to analyze waste tire rubber's the future of recycled tires is to be guaranteed, it is important to keep in mind the three primary goals in the recovery of discarded tires: reducing excessive stockpiles, ensuring productive properties and conduct a thorough evaluation of its applications in pavement and construction materials so that its environmental, economic, and technological impacts could be better understood.

articleTitle: Ensemble-Based Techniques: A review on Sentiment Analysis in Social Network with Boosting Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Sentiment Analysis (SA) falls under the domain of Natural Language Processing (NLP), often known as opinion mining. Its objective is to identify and comprehensively analyze sentiments conveyed in comments. It is commonly recognized that the internet and online social media platforms present significant opportunities for this particular area. The main aim of this paper is to examine the obstacles related to $S A$, along with the most efficient algorithms for automated SA. As a component of our research, we have examined the effectiveness of ensemble techniques utilizing bagging and boosting methodologies for social networks. In addition, we have thoroughly examined the diverse tiers of Sentiment Analysis, along with its practical implementations, and the complexities associated with analyzing different domains utilizing machine algorithms such as Naïve-Bayes (NB), RandomForest (RF), Support Vector Machine (SVM), and K-NearestNeighbor (KNN). These algorithms have been extensively deliberated in numerous scholarly articles, shedding light on their merits and limitations. To conduct a comprehensive review, we have carefully chosen studies published between 2016 and 2023 from esteemed sources such as ACM, Science Direct, Scopus, and IEEE. The purpose of this paper is to present a meticulous analysis of $S A$ in social networks and to provide valuable benchmark information that can serve as a guide for future research endeavors.

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Detection and Classification Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Computational models are powered by numerous deep-learning methodologies at several processing levels that represent the data at different stages of abstraction. Deep learning technique is being used more and more frequently these days in practically every industry, particularly in bioinformatics, image processing in medicine, and image analysis. Resulting in fundamental alteration and enhanced methods for successful recognition, prediction, and diagnosis in many health care domains, including pathology, lung cancer, brain tumor, abdominal, and retina in deep learning. The review was produced by condensing several contributions made to the field of science (such as deep learning).

articleTitle: LiDAR Based Object Detection System for Drones
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The key components for the development of autonomous drones are object detection and tracking in real time. With this, LIDAR (Light System and Ranging) sensors are particularly suitable, as they can function in bad weather conditions while providing precise information. However as opposed to the camera photos, the resolution is very poor. However, Deep Learning methodology is applied to 3D LiDAR sensor with low resolution, for this aim we can develop a LiDAR based system that uses a Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), to perform point wise object detection which estimates the actual position and the velocities of the detected objects. It works as a defence mechanism to protect the drone from birds or other unpredictable objects and avoid them to protect the drone from any harm. It can avoid the object by analysing its height and width and adjusting the fan speed accordingly. It will also have a feature that if the fans stop spinning at all then a notification and the drone’s current location will be sent to the owner of the drone that the drone might be stolen or switched off due to unknown circumstances.

articleTitle: Network Security and Cryptography: A Qualitative Exploration and Recent Advancements
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Network security and cryptography as a concept deal with network and data protection. Data security involves transmission of data securely even over an unreliable network whereas network security involves hardening of the network and thus preventing any unauthorized access. Both public and private networks come under the purview of network security. With increasing penetration of internet, e-commerce and social networking application and others IOT devices, a large amount of data is being generated every instant. Many countries have made ‘Right to be forgotten’ a fundamental right for their citizens the prominent example being GDPR of the European Union. Thus importance of data security has escalated in this modern digital world. In this paper, an attempt has been made to provide a lucid analysis of various terms and technologies involved in state of the art broad range network security and cryptography algorithms. Internet receives a special attention to apprise users with basic security measures.

articleTitle: Weather Prediction with Machine Learning Techniques: A Systematic Mapping
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Weather Prediction techniques are widely used to predict the almost accurate weather at a particular place on a particular time. After getting success in various fields like image processing, sound prediction etc. Machine Learning is doing well in weather prediction as well. In this paper, a survey in the form of systematic mapping was conducted for Weather Prediction with Machine Learning techniques covering the time period of 2011-2022. After compiling a pool of 2394 papers and applying a set of inclusion and exclusion criteria, a final pool of 2227 relevant papers were obtained. These existing publications were downloaded on goggle drive and a systematic analysis was done with the help of Python pyBibx library.

articleTitle: Health Care Data Mining using Intelligent Classification Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Classification models can be learned from complicated multivariate temporal data and this is a topic we investigate in electronic health record systems. The difficulty is to come up with a collection of attributes that accurately reflect the data’s temporal nature. Using temporal abstractions and pattern mining, we extract the classification features from the data. There are frequently a lot of temporal patterns that aren’t related to the classification job that are returned by temporal pattern mining.

articleTitle: Personality Prediction: Ensemble Learning of Logistic Regression and SVM with LightGBM for Automated Personality Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Personality is a significant trait in human beings, which can be defined as an individual’s behavioral patterns and social interactions. The way a person handles and responds to various situations is also considered part of their personality. Traditional methods of predicting personality can be time-consuming. However, by utilizing algorithms for automated personality prediction, we can employ this technology for various purposes. For example, it can aid in recruitment processes and targeted advertising. Our project aims to classify an individual’s personality by administering a survey consisting of a few to categorize personality types and implementing a supervised model to achieve this goal.

articleTitle: ILEACH Based on Bio Inspired Approach to Improve Lifetime for WSN Assisted IoT Network
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The Internet of Things links several capabilities in a broad sensing domain, including sensing, communication, networking, or cloud computing. WSNs are the most appropriate infrastructure for IoT apps to analyze the network. These networks suffer from drawbacks of excessive energy consumption. Energy-efficient clustering algorithms are created with the aim of improving the lifetime of sensor nodes used for sensing. This research paper analyzes clustering protocols namely LEACH along with bio inspired Ant colony optimization and Firefly Optimization and discusses their performance in detail. They have been simulated in MATLAB and their performance was examined following which BI-LEACH was found to be better among the all regarding network lifetime and throughput.

articleTitle: Understanding Factors Affecting Trust And Satisfaction With Banking In India
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The aim of this paper is to explore the opportunity and possibility to understand the importance of user experience and satisfaction which is an important factor in effective trust in mobile banking in India.Mobile Banking has been evolving a lot and has increased it market surprisingly in a larger exponential. The growth of the mobile banking technology has increased a lot due to many factors which are important and crucial to today’s users. We have been keenly noticing that the users are very dilemmatic when they choose a bank or application and tend more towards the ones which have a better, understanding and a clear user experience.

articleTitle: A deep learning approach to identify and classify lung tumor from CT – Scans
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In the world, lung cancer is the primary origin of tumor and a major contributor to mortality. A lung cancer problem is an extremely complex issue. Lung cancer patients are the most exposed to Sars-Covid-19 virus, but premature detection has a high survival rate. In recent years, lung cancer detection with computed tomography (CT) has gained popularity among medical imaging system researchers. In order to diagnose lung cancer accurately, it is necessary to read, detect, classify, and evaluate CT scans rapidly. Therefore, it is crucial to be able to identify, categorize and assess CT scans precisely. An effective method to identify & classify lesions/nodules in lung is presented here in this work. This paper consists of 2 portions: finding lesions and lesion classification (segregating nodules according to whether they are Non-Cancerous or cancerous/Benign). To classify & detect Lung nodules, CT-Scans of the lung are used. CT scans are segmented using the U-Net architecture, whereas 3D-Images from Lidc – Idri & Luna 16 are calculated using the VGG-net.

articleTitle: Heart Disease Prediction Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In old times, we have seen that prediction of heart disease is very complicated and difficult task. At this, one man or one woman dies every minute due to hear disease. Generation of data is playing a very important role in processing large number prediction of heart disease is very complicated work. We must systemize the prediction system for heart disease prediction so, patient can avoid risk and take care of his health by prediction heart disease. In this paper we are using heart disease database positioned in the UCI device reading area. In this study, we suggested a model that uses several classification algorithms, including Decision Tree, Naïve Bays, Random Forest, and Logistic Regression, to predict heart disease. We compare the accuracy gained by several algorithms in this work. When we compared all of the findings, we discovered that Random Forest had the highest accuracy level, at 95.08%, when compared to other algorithms.

articleTitle: Recent Developments in the Quality Evaluation of Rice Disease Detection System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The recent progress in the field of computer vision has facilitated the implementation of diverse applications across several domains of human existence. One notable domain of application pertains to the classification of plant diseases, with a particular focus on rice plants. However, the classification of rice plants has shown itself as a multifaceted challenge, necessitating additional advancements in this field. The classification of rice diseases poses considerable difficulties as a result of similarities between different classes and the irregular characteristics within each class. The careful selection of data acquisition sensors and the adoption of an appropriate feature representation approach are of utmost importance in light of the extensive range of applications in this field. In recent years, there has been a growing utilisation of computer vision techniques for the purpose of evaluating food quality. This paper provides an overview of the current advancements in techniques and their application in conjunction with diverse sensing devices for the purpose of detecting plant problems. The identification and resolution of significant challenges related to defect detection in rice plants entail different technical obstacles. This study provides an overview of the latest developments in computer vision methodologies used for assessing the quality of rice plants. This study showcases the potential of image processing techniques in the assessment of rice plant quality. Additionally, it highlights several unresolved difficulties that require additional investigation to facilitate the widespread implementation of image processing technology for evaluating the quality of rice plants.

articleTitle: A Systematic Review on Social Bots Account Detection Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Online social networking sites are becoming more important in today’s digital age. Cybercriminals are interested in developing dangerous bots due to the large quantity of information available and their open nature. In these systems, malicious bots are computer programs or botnets designed to do harm by imitating human users. Moreover, such bots raise significant public opinion and cyber security issues. They are used for nefarious purposes including spamming, creating phony profiles, disseminating offensive or inaccurate information, engaging in click farming, stealing trending hashtags, and much more. Researchers and cyber criminals are always at odds, with researchers constantly developing new and improved bots to counteract the most up-to-date forms of detection technology. This study examines the most up-to-date breakthroughs in Machine Learning-based algorithms for bot detection and categorization across Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Twitter, and Weibo, the five most prominent social media platforms. Herein, we provide a condensed overview of the many supervised, semi-supervised, and unsupervised methods, as well as details on the datasets used by the researchers. We also give a detailed classification of the features that were extracted. Also, this paper provides a quick summary of the difficulties and gains made in this field, as well as possible future research avenues and intriguing areas to investigate.

articleTitle: Virtual Monitoring System for Student Efficacy
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: This project is based on the concept of providing virtual infrastructure to the faculty/trainer where examining a student’s work is made easy with help of live submissions. To ensure e-learning for the students in the online classes, practical labs are scheduled. But the issue with these labs is there is no transparency as students can just copy and paste the code from various online platforms or websites and gain no knowledge about how to actually perform. They deceive the faculty showing that they did the given task on time. Now to overcome this issue, we are trying to build a platform where the faculty is being provided with a mechanism by which they can view the student’s work anytime when they want. This web-based project has been completed by using front-end languages, with Node js and React.

articleTitle: Earthquake Prediction Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Earthquakes are really dangerous and hard to predict. They can cause a lot of damage to buildings, hurt people, and make life difficult for communities. Right now, we don’t have a great way to know exactly when they will happen. This research uses fancy computer programs called Random Forest and Support Vector Machine to try and guess when earthquakes might occur. They make sure the information used is good and gets rid of any confusing stuff before making predictions. The goal is to make a computer system that can tell us more accurately when earthquakes might happen. This could help us get ready better and reduce the problems they cause.

articleTitle: Brain Controlled Communication system using Machine Learning techniques of Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Nowadays computers have become a necessity for all computers have made a great leap for us and with the help of that we are able to move to a golden age of Artificial Intelligence. Artificial Intelligence or A.I has huge advantages and potentials for making the lives easy and more accessible. However, we as a society have to keep on innovating and developing new innovations and products to help different aspects of the community. The proposed system uses a brain-controlled interface, eye tracking along with a camera and screen for communication and training. The system requires input in the form of an image captured with the help of a camera. After the image is taken as an input, it will be used to perform eye-tracking and eye-blink detection. Both of these actions will be performed by employing a machine learning algorithm. The algorithm will process a morse code entered by the user, and then will enable the speech functionality using built-in speakers. Thus, rendering the system speak out whatever the user wanted to convey. The proposed system follows a coordinated approach for eye pattern detection and mapping. It detects the gazing spot of the eyes, and calculates the midpoint of the eye gaze. As a result, it predicts the eye blink pattern. This eye pattern recognition system is proposed to help out people with disabilities who find it difficult to communicate.

articleTitle: Multiple Disease Prediction Using ML
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Timely precise evaluation of any health concern is critical for the successful prevention and healing process of illnesses. Therefore, the development of a medical diagnostic system based on machine learning (ML) algorithms can lead to more precise diagnoses than traditional methods. We have created a disease prediction system that uses ML to predict illnesses based on data or symptoms entered into the system, providing accurate results. This disease prediction system employs Python and machine learning programming language, with its Flask interface, and utilizes hospital database to predict diseases. By utilizing this predictive disease system using machine learning, we can improve diagnosis accuracy and support effective disease prevention and treatment.

articleTitle: Prediction of House Pricing Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Data mining is increasingly frequently used in the housing market. In order to estimate house prices, important housing qualities, and many other things, data mining is quite helpful since it can extract pertinent knowledge from raw data.According to research, the real estate market and home owners are frequently concerned about price variations in housing. a study analysis of the pertinent characteristics and the best models for predicting property values have been developed. The analysis’s findings demonstrated that, when compared to other models, ANN, can SVM, and XGBoost. After going through the data in this paper we came across that characteristics structures are the deciding factors for predicting house prices. This research will be Finding the most important factors that influence housing prices and identifying the most effective machine learning model to utilise in this project area will be of enormous help, particularly to housing developers and academics.

articleTitle: ADC-Net: Attention-based Dense Convolutional Network for Underwater Image Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: As underwater imagery has numerous applications on its own, the distorted color and obliteration of the fine details due to absorption and scattering of light gives rise to the need of enhancing the pictures obtained underwater. Recently, some attempts have been made using learning-based algorithms to alleviate this problem. Extending the same, we introduce a novel architecture for underwater image enhancement (UIE), called Attention-based Dense Convolutional Network for Underwater Image Enhancement (ADC-Net). It employs dense convolutional networks with channel and pixel attention while upsampling with pixel shuffle to enhance an input image. We also quantify the importance of each component employed by conducting appropriate ablation studies. Owing to its visually satisfying results and reasonable inference times, we posit that our model can be potentially utilized in real-life underwater applications such as in autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs).

articleTitle: AI’s Impact on Cybersecurity
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: As we all knows, that internet became a necessary medium for transferring data throughout the world. With this widespread use of internet cybercrimes are growing day by day in our social lives. However, the growth of artificial intelligences (AI), these crimes are starting to decrease. AI gives valuable inputs in prevention of data or we can say that AI acts like a first line of defense for the cyberattacks by various threats. AI also help our system to detects various vulnerabilities later which can be sort out. This paper discus the various inputs of AI in prevention of data in various fields and check the accuracy by detecting various vulnerabilities. This paper discus the various research conducted on AI and cybersecurity.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Algorithms for Conducting Sentiment Analysis on Product Reviews Derived from Social Media Data
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Sentiment analysis has garnered considerable attention in recent years, primarily on account of the exponential expansion of user-generated content on social media platforms and the escalating demand for businesses to extract valuable insights from this data. This manuscript presents a comprehensive comparative examination of different machine learning algorithms employed in the task of sentiment analysis on product evaluations obtained from social media data. To execute the comparative analysis, a diverse dataset of product evaluations from various social media platforms is assembled and processed. Subsequently, this dataset utilizes a range of varied machine learning algorithms. The effectiveness of each algorithm is assessed through the use of fundamental metrics including F1-score, precision, accuracy and recall. The findings of the investigation uncover the merits and deficiencies of each computational procedure when employed in sentiment analysis tasks involving data derived from social media. This scientific inquiry delivers invaluable perspectives into the selection of machine learning procedures for sentiment analysis on social media-based evaluations of products. It functions as a manual for practitioners and scholars in the process of choosing the most appropriate procedure based on the unique attributes of their data and the goals of their analysis. Furthermore, it contributes to the broader comprehension of sentiment analysis and its significance in utilizing social media data for making business decisions.

articleTitle: A Detailed Review on Intelligent Intrusion Prediction Techniques for Software Defined Internet of Things Clouds Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) and Software Defined Networks (SDN) are growing in popularity due to major application possibilities in various communication-related applications. IoT’s major objective is to connect electronic devices over the Internet, whereas SDN simplifies network configuration for network administration by separating the control layer from the data layer. Because there are so many electronic gadgets connected to the Internet, managing and controlling them is difficult, especially given the vast scattered network. Through The SDN, IoT networks may be flexible and programmable without posing problems for the already established network architecture. It has lately come to light that the IoT and SDN technologies are becoming more and more well-known. IoT’s main goal is to link electronic gadgets to the Internet, whereas SDN separates the control layer from the data layer to make network setup easier for network administration. It is challenging to manage and regulate all electronic devices linked to the Internet, especially considering how widely dispersed the network is. IoT networks may be relatively programmable and adaptable using the SDN without creating issues for the already established network architecture.

articleTitle: Breast Cancer Detection System Using AI/ML
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The most prevalent and rapidly spreading disease in the world is breast cancer. Women are most frequently affected by breast cancer. Breast cancer can be controlled with early detection. Early detection and lower mortality allow for the treatment of many cases. On breast cancer, numerous research projects have been carried out. Machine learning is the approach that researchers employ the most. Machine learning was used in numerous earlier investigations. Decision trees, KNN, SVM, naive bays, and other machine learning algorithms offer improved performance in respective fields. However, a new and better method is now being used to diagnose breast cancer. Indepth learning is the innovative approach that was developed. Machine learning obstacles are surmounted using deep learning. Convolution neural networks, Recurrent neural networks, deep belief networks, etc. are a few examples of in-depth learning techniques used in data science. Machine learning comparisons produce the greatest results when using in-depth learning techniques. It highlights the images’ strongest qualities.

articleTitle: Heart Disease Prediction using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Cardiovascular disease, commonly known as cardiovascular disease (CVD), is currently the most difficult disease to treat in India and elsewhere in the globe. It has long been a primary reason for death worldwide. The bottom of the world. Therefore, reliable, accurate and effective strategies should be used to detect these problems early and initiate appropriate treatment. Many medical databases use machine learning techniques and methods to enable the analysis of large and complex data. Experts and doctors are now better able to diagnose heart disease, thanks to many researchers who have recently started using a lot of machine learning. This study judge the efficacy of various dummy based on these methods. Some modeling techniques include hierarchical models. Many researchers will be interested in academic supervision.

articleTitle: A Review on Automatic Protection System and Risk Mitigation in Railways
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Railway transportation is a vital mode of transit in India, with almost 80% of all transportation carried out by railways. However, to ensure safe and secure train operations, regular maintenance and inspection of railway tracks are critical. The conventional method of manually examining railway tracks using a railway cart for detecting faults and performing maintenance on railway tracks is an outdated method that is inefficient and can lead to errors. The implementation of an automated railway track inspection system that uses sensors and artificial intelligence algorithms is a potential solution to improve railway safety and efficiency. By analysing potential issues in real-time, an automated system could quickly detect and respond to problems, reducing the risk of accidents. More ever one of the main problems in railways is collision of two trains occurs for this we are using Anti-collision system to protect the trains from collision and saving the lives. And Level crossing should be automated to reduce the human error. Lastly, regular maintenance, inspections, and upgrades of railway tracks are essential to prevent accidents and ensure safe and efficient transportation.

articleTitle: A Review of Moving Object Detection Techniques for Night Time
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Moving Object Detection in low light conditions is a challenging task due to limited visibility and the presence of noise and objects in the captured images, low contrast, low brightness, low appearance information, and low Signal to Noise Ratio. The majority of night surveillance models suffer from lack of adaptability for different scenes and separation between detection and tracking. This review paper provides a comprehensive survey of recent advancements in Moving Object Detection Techniques for night-time situations. It presents an overview of various approaches proposed in the literature, including traditional and deep learning-based methods, and discusses their strengths and limitations. Moreover, the paper highlights evaluation metrics commonly used in the literature, the datasets they have been evaluated upon, along with a comparative analysis of the performance metrics & various limitations of different methods. Finally, the paper identifies the key research challenges and future directions for Moving Object Detection in Night Time viz. dim-lit environments, such as the need for more robust and efficient algorithms that can handle diverse environmental conditions and real-time applications.

articleTitle: Automatic Protection System and Risk Mitigation in Railways
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: One of the most inexpensive and energy-efficient modes of transportation is the railroad. In India, the railway network handles around 80% of all transit. An integral component of a tough and secure train operation is routine track inspection. The safe operation of rail transportation is seriously jeopardised by delays in investigations and problem discoveries. The custom of manually inspecting the rail track using a railway cart is ineffective and prone to biases and errors. Accident rates are rising due to negligent maintenance and careless manual handling, demonstrating the urgent necessity for an autonomous system. There is necessity of separate room for autonomous system improvement. About 60% of accidents occur on railroad tracks. The modern railway protection and control system is not fully automated, despite automation playing a significant role in almost all areas. The current rail network protection parameters include automatic gate control, track crack detection and protection from train collision.

articleTitle: Lane Detection and Tracking Algorithms for Driver Assistance System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The majority of fatalities on the roads each year are caused by drivers who are careless and disregard traffic laws. Safety is the system’s primary goal, and lane detection devices help prevent accidents. These systems’ primary function is identifying lane markings and alerting the driver if a vehicle is about to veer off the road. The recent technologies in advanced driver assistance systems lead to the development of various techniques for improving driver safety and automating driving. One such development is the Lane Departure Warning (LDW) system, wherein lane detection techniques are employed for the detection of lanes to avoid road accidents. Accordingly, three methods are discussed for lane detection in the research work. The first method for multiple lane detection is discussed based on image transformation and CSA-based Deep Convolution Neural Network (DCNN). The multiple lane images are initially transformed into Bird’s eye view images. Next, the detection of the lane is carried out by an Earth Worm-Crow Search Algorithm (EW-CSA) based on DCNN. The Earth Worm-Crow Search Algorithm was discussed by merging EWA and CSA. This merged algorithm can be used as the training algorithm in the DCNN. The performance parameters are also discussed to compare the different lane detection techniques.

articleTitle: Decentralized Ledger Systems with Blockchain Technology: Benefits, Challenges, and Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: A decentralized network of nodes (miners) is used by blockchain technology, which is made up of blocks. There are three components to each block: data, hash, and prior block’s hash. It is exceedingly difficult to modify data once it has been saved in order to temper the data. By computing the transaction’s hash function, miners can validate the transaction and earn a small commission. This review paper will provide readers a thorough grasp of blockchain technology and how it may be applied across a wide range of sectors, including finance, healthcare, supply chains, and many more. Prior to recently, Bitcoin was one of the most well-known blockchain applications that the general public was familiar with.
