We will examine some of these research articles and discuss the difficulties encountered in the implementation of these applications as several research papers regarding the novel uses of this technology have been published. Blockchain is a rapidly expanding field of worlds with more recent applications in a variety of industries, including the usage of cryptocurrencies, hospital administration, and other disciplines. These applications are only made feasible by the way blockchain functions and operates.

articleTitle: A Review of Object Detection Algorithms for Autonomous Vehicles: Trends and Developments
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: This review article compares many object detection techniques that are routinely employed in autonomous cars. The study’s goal is to give insights into current trends and advancements regarding the industry as well as to emphasize the virtues of each algorithm. The study evaluates the performance of many cutting-edge algorithms, including YOLO, SSD, RCNN, and Faster R-CNN, on several parameters like accuracy, speed, and robustness. The paper also covers the constraints and restrictions that these algorithms confront in real-world circumstances, as well as recent breakthroughs in this field. Overall, this review gives a thorough overview of the object recognition algorithms utilised in autonomous cars, as well as valuable insights for academics and researchers working in this field.

articleTitle: Teaching Toy Car to Self-drive in a Game Environment using Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: This research paper explores the use of reinforcement learning (RL) to teach a toy car to self-drive in a game environment. The study focuses on the development of an RL-based algorithm that enables the toy car to learn the optimal driving behavior through trial-and-error experience. The game environment provides a simulated environment for the toy car to navigate, and the RL algorithm rewards the car for taking the right actions while penalizing it for taking the wrong ones. The study also examines the effects of different reward structures and hyperparameters on the performance of the RL algorithm. The results of the study demonstrate that the toy car can learn to drive autonomously in the game environment and that the performance of the RL algorithm improves with appropriate reward structures and hyperparameters. The outcomes of this study’s conclusions may have an impact on the creation of autonomous driving systems and robotics.

articleTitle: Enhancing Sign Language Detection using Tensor Flow
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Multimodal sign language detection is a rich and expressive mode of communication predominantly used by the Deaf and Hard of Hearing (DHH) community. In recent years, sign language detection has emerged as a promising field of research. Sign language detection uses cameras, sensors, and machine learning algorithms to interpret and translate sign language. One of the primary directions for future research involves the expansion of recognized vocabulary and gestures.. This entails accommodating new signs, specialized signs, and regional variants, making sign language detection systems more adaptable to diverse signing patterns. Another pivotal avenue is the integration of multimodal recognition, combining visual data from cameras and depth sensors with other sensor inputs like wearable devices. This fusion of data sources will enable more context-rich and accurate recognition, especially in complex signing environments where multiple cues can enhance the understanding of signs. In education, sign language detection can play a pivotal role in enhancing accessibility.. Future applications may encompass sign language interpretation for online courses, sign language learning apps, and interactive educational tools, fostering inclusivity in learning environments. Lastly, the expansion of sign language detection to encompass multiple sign languages from around the world will make these technologies more globally inclusive and accessible.. The future scope of sign language detection projects holds the promise of bridging communication gaps, fostering inclusivity, and empowering sign language users across a wide spectrum of applications and domains.

articleTitle: Digital Fencing – A Solution to Animal-Human Conflict
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Fencing of animals is vital because of several factors such as providing safety and protection to them, containing them, preventing the spread of illness, and avoiding animal-human conflict. However, physical fencing of animals has various challenges such as being time-consuming, expensive, unmaintainable, and in some cases ineffective also. Therefore, in this research paper, we propose a digital fencing mechanism using a Deep Learning algorithm to tackle the abovementioned challenges. To be particular, we design a ready-to-use version of yoloV5, which aims at providing a reliable, secure, and easy-to-implement solution for the animal-human conflict. Moreover, we used an object detection technique for the classification of the animals that come in a certain region covered by the cameras. Thus, our approach does not affect animal rights as they are not being continuously tracked like the GPS and other methods of prevention unless they appear in a restricted area. Hence, this concept of digital fencing can do miraculous work in this field as it can help farmers protect their farms without investing too much effort and time and by also keeping the required safety measures for the animals as well as for themselves. To implement this work, we created our own dataset of 10,000 images belonging to seven different categories of animals. As a result, we achieved classification with a precision of 0.872, recall of 0.858, mAP@0.5 of 0.904, and mAP@0.5:0.95 of 0.584.

articleTitle: E-Commerce for Teak Wood Cabinet Work
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In diurnal actuality, when individualities buy or construct houses for their families, they believe the stylish cabinetwork should make their home look lovely, so they search for the stylish cabinetwork store, which takes a lot of their time, cash, and exertion, and in some cases indeed in the wake of burning through such a lot of cash, individualities cannot get the cabinet work they need. In light of our comprehensions and meetings, we set up that certain individualities express that they can not arrive at the store since it’s exorbitantly far down, that the store just opens during a defined time span of available time, and that certain individualities warrant occasion and restraint to read the supplies and particulars at the store basically. Latterly, this undertaking offers an answer that spotlights on the development of a teak wood cabinetwork and fittings dealing point. This will save people time and exertion while buying cabinetwork for their homes, as well as the client’s and their necessities This site will likewise incorporate norm and tweaked plans, as well as many kinds of teak woods like African teak woods, backwoods teak woods, brilliant teak wood, seasoned, non-seasoned, ivory coast, Togo, Mexico, Uganda, etc. For illustration, chaukhat, entries, tables, seats, sleeping cushions boards, panels for floors, stairs, wall and ceiling and different fittings with different categories of teak woods. There will be a few classes of teak woods and plans open for clients to pick from, and this site will be kept up with the nation over in different areas in view of the requirements of the clients.

articleTitle: Exploring the Impact and Potential of the Internet of Medical Things (IoMT): A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) is a transformative paradigm in healthcare that utilizes interconnected medical devices, wearables, and healthcare systems to revolutionize patient care, enhance clinical outcomes, and improve healthcare efficiency. This review paper provides a comprehensive analysis of the IoMT, encompassing its definition, key technologies, applications, benefits, challenges, and future prospects. Through a synthesis of existing literature, this paper presents a holistic understanding of the IoMT landscape, its implications for healthcare stakeholders, and its potential to transform healthcare delivery. The review highlights various applications of IoMT, including remote patient monitoring, telemedicine, and smart healthcare facilities, emphasizing their impact on improving patient outcomes and advancing medical research. Moreover, it addresses challenges such as data security, interoperability, ethical considerations, and regulatory frameworks. The paper concludes by identifying research gaps and proposing future directions, including the integration of artificial intelligence, personalized medicine, and scalable implementation strategies. This review contributes to the growing body of knowledge on IoMT and provides valuable insights for researchers, clinicians, and policymakers.

articleTitle: An Efficient System for Interconnecting Alumni after Their Studies: A Multipurpose App for Public Assimilation
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Graduate and past students make up an alumni association. Colleges rely on alumni to mentor students, which enables current students to connect with graduates to learn about numerous job prospects including industry trends, industrial events, internships, scholarships, and more. This manuscript manages the freshmen and former graduate students with their unique information so that they can actively participate in signing up, looking for, and managing the alumni in formation to receive additional updates. All alumni and students are encouraged to connect with one another through the Alumni Portal’s chosen Dynamic Design. Through this alumni portal, information on colleges, unique occasions, jobs, and off-campus employment is offered.

articleTitle: Speech Signal-Based Diagnosis System for Parkinson’s Disease: Tuning Decision Tree Classifiers and AdaBoost
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Parkinson’s disease is challenging to diagnose in its early stages because of how it affects the nervous system and how it progresses. The most recent diagnostic techniques include examining a patient’s medical history, performing scans, and observing bodily activity. Recent studies have nonetheless demonstrated the possibility of speech analysis for early detection. A hybrid diagnosis system based on voice signals is suggested in a recent survey. To attain high accuracy, the system combines some categorization methods. Decision tree classifiers were initially used to connect various classes, and then performance was improved by adjusting the parameters. The modified decision tree classifiers were combined with AdaBoost classifiers to create an ensemble model. Performance evaluation was done on a speech dataset with a severely unbalanced distribution from the UCI machine learning library. The synthetic minority oversampling technique (SMOTE) was used to balance the classes to solve this problem. The best performance was shown by the mixture of adjusted decision tree classifiers and AdaBoost classifiers, which had an accuracy of 98.30%. This was more accurate than earlier research. These results indicate that speech signal analysis has the potential to be a reliable and effective early Parkinson’s disease diagnostic tool. Early detection could result in prompt therapeutic measures and better patient results.

articleTitle: Encryption Techniques for Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS)
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS) was created with the express purpose of making the management of large data sets a breeze. The absence of something in data encryption methods in HDFS, however, presents serious security concerns. While the introduction of encryption methods has improved data security, traditional algorithms struggle when processing larger files. This study aims to provide a novel hybrid encryption technique for protecting massive datasets by fusing Cipher-Text Policy Attribute-Based Encryption (CP-ABE) and Advanced Encryption Standard (AES). Java-based open-source project that includes the MapReduce framework for data processing and the HDFS. It modifies many Portable Operating System Interface (POSIX) standards to provide streaming access to file system information. Initiated as a platform for the open-source web crawler Apache Nutch, HDFS has already expanded to include other similar programs. Authors have compared the method to the one that was present in the system, they have implemented it to protect HDFS, and performed experimental research to prove its performance. Further, the authors have tested the suggested HDFS technique by encrypting files of various sizes and compared it to other algorithms, such as AES and AES with One-Time-Pad (OTP). The HDFS method improves performance significantly when it relates to file encryption.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Analysis of Sentiment Analysis: Approaches, Applications, and Classifier Comparisons
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In the present era, an enormous amount of textual content is being generated across various platforms, including messaging apps like Telegram and WhatsApp, social media sites like Instagram and Facebook, news websites, and online search engines like Google. These sources generate an endless stream of text data. Consequently, natural language processing (NLP) has become an indispensable tool for comprehending and analyzing this textual content.This paper specifically focuses on sentiment analysis related to NLP. Sentiment analysis involves the contextual analysis of text to identify and extract subjective information. Sentiment analysis can be used to extract crucial insights from user feedback, helping organizations understand the social sentiment surrounding their brand, product, or service. This paper explores various approaches and classification models used in sentiment analysis, discussing their effectiveness and applicability.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Analysis of Music Genre Classification with Audio Spectrograms using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: This review paper investigates the application of audio spectrograms for categorization of musical genres. The use of feature extraction technique in convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for music genre analysis is highlighted in the discussion of these techniques. The relationship between audio spectrograms and musical subgenres is also observed in this paper, as well as how well audio segmentation methods perform in terms of increasing classification precision. The findings of recent research employing various approaches like CNN, PRCNN, LSTM, SVM, etc are used to conduct a comparative analysis of their effectiveness, highlighting the strengths and weaknesses of each approach. The use of spectrogram for feature extraction and multi-layer CNN proved to be ideal for future researches.

articleTitle: Social Media Fake News Detection Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Nowadays it has become very difficult to tell the legitimacy of news on social media news blogs and online newspaper. Hence there is a need of tools that can check these sources to identify fake news. The automatic detection of false content in news stories is the main topic of this research. We start by introducing a dataset for the false news detection job. To categorize fake news, we applied language processing methods based on logistic regression. Tokenizing, stemming, stopwords removal and data quality checks (i.e., null or missing values), are some of the tasks carried out by the pre-processing algorithms. We have also used SVM algorithm for fake news identification. We also determine which of the two algorithms Logistic Regression or SVM offer greater performance overall.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Security Threats in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Cloud computing (CC) offers on-requirement access of the resources to perform cloud related activities and generates bill as per the use by customer. It minimizes both the cost and the complexity for service suppliers. CC is known to be the foundation of the IT world and becoming an essential part of the organizations. The growing adoption of cloud computing has several drawbacks for businesses. It includes data breaches, data leakage, attacks, unauthorized access. Cloud computing security risks are growing at an alarming rate. The service providers have very strict security policies and their implementation. This study aims to discuss different types of security threats at each service models of the cloud and their mitigation methods that provides a way to ameliorate the threats. To address the security issue separately for each cloud service, a derivative approach based on the spiral model is proposed in this research. The Spiral Model is a powerful tool for mitigating risks associated with each cloud service models. By following its four phases, the spiral model facilitates the constant identification and mitigation of security issues during the development of a cloud-based application. The proposed methodology can be used to guarantee cloud security by reducing vulnerabilities and security threats.

articleTitle: Image Classification Of Material Using CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The classification and detection of a variety of materials that appear to be common in our environment have been the focus of computer vision systems in recent years, which has posed a significant sensory challenge. Application of material categorization is crucial for autonomous visual surveillance systems. Material classification is the process of categorizing a piece of content using its attributes into predetermined and semantically relevant categories. In this study, a brand-new model for material detection and classification is put forth, employing Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) to categorize the discovered materials based on their attributes. Deep Neural Networks can process enormous amounts of data in higher dimensions with billions of parameters, just like the human brain. The simulation results show that the suggested classifier model generates more accurate feature extraction and classification outcomes using CNN.

articleTitle: Enhancing Human Activity Recognition with IMU-based Motion Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In this research, we delve into the domain of Human Activity Recognition (HAR) using deep learning techniques applied to data collected from a single wearable sensor. Our objective was to enhance the results obtained in previous studies and demonstrate the efficacy of automatic feature extraction methods. Employing an 8-layer Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architecture, combined with innovative data augmentation techniques involving rotational and permutational transformations, we achieved notable improvements in classification accuracy. The augmented dataset, which incorporated both rotations and permutations, yielded the most significant enhancements, particularly benefiting underrepresented classes. Comparative analyses of various neural network architectures, including 1D and 2D convolutional networks, ResNets, and stacked denoising autoencoders, revealed that the optimal model featured ID and 2D convolutions capturing cross-sensor correlations. This model achieved an impressive F1-Score of 0.972. Our study emphasizes the potential for further exploration of recurrent neural networks and parameter fine-tuning. Furthermore, we underscore the critical role of data preprocessing and the need for a deep understanding of both machine learning and HAR concepts.

articleTitle: Age Prediction on social media using Machine Learning and AI
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Personalized marketing, age-based demographic analysis, and facial recognition systems are just a few of the many uses for accurate age prediction from facial photos. With the FG-NET dataset, a benchmark dataset frequently used for age estimation tasks, we investigate the usage of deep learning approaches for age prediction in this research. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are used in our method to extract meaningful representations from facial photos and forecast the related age labels. We upgrade the pretrained model on the FG-NET dataset using a cutting-edge architecture, such as VGGNet or ResNet, to enhance age prediction accuracy. We adhere to a strict experimental setup to achieve reliable evaluation. We have divided the FG-NET dataset into training, validation, and test sets, making sure that the age groups in each set were distributed equally. To lessen overfitting and increase generalization, we preprocess the photos by aligning the faces, pixel-value normalization, and data augmentation. We use appropriate loss functions, like mean squared error or cross-entropy loss, during the training phase to optimize the network’s parameters. In order to improve the performance of the model, we additionally investigate the impact of other hyper parameters, including learning rate, batch size, and regularization methods.After the model has been trained, we assess its effectiveness using measures like mean absolute error (MAE) and mean squared error (MSE) on the test set. To confirm the efficacy of our strategy, we compare our findings with those of other cutting-edge approaches for age prediction using the FG-NET dataset. Our tests show that age prediction tasks can be successfully completed by deep learning models trained on the FG-NET dataset. Our method advances facial analysis research by reliably determining an individual’s age from facial photos, and it creates opportunities for real-world applications in numerous fields.

articleTitle: Automated Vehicle Parking System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Parking Management System to manage the records of vehicles entering and leaving the parking lot. With increasing economic performance and rising living standards, the proportion of people owning cars and motorcycles in India has increased recently, leading to an increase in urban transportation. Thus, parking features are much needed these days to insure your car as well as assess the charge structure for each entry and exit of vehicles. The aim of this research is to create an easy-to-use, Dependable, and robotic auto parking system. Indeed if identified, numerous vehicles may seek veritably limited parking spaces to produce severe business traffic. In this composition, we research and apply a prototype smart parking system. Thus, parking issues with the instinctive auto parking system are completely robotic, and the stoner receives a unique identifier corresponding to the auto assigned to him. This type of outfit helps break the problem of limited parking spaces in busy cities. With profitable performance and rising living norms, the proportion of people retaining buses and motorcycles in India has lately increased, which has given a boost to urban transport so, the problem with parking is increasing. The automatic auto parking system is completely automated and the stoner is given a unique identifier corresponding to the auto assigned to him. This type of outfit helps break the problem of limited parking spaces in busy metropolises. The goal of this research is to compare vehicle parking management systems to manage and control the driving time of vehicles through license plate recognition.

articleTitle: Predicting Glaucoma Progression Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Glaucoma is a leading cause of blindness worldwide, affecting an estimated 76 million people. The disease is characterized by damage to the optic nerve, which can lead to loss of peripheral vision. While there is currently no cure for glaucoma, timely detection and appropriate treatment can play a crucial role in slowing down or preventing the loss of vision.Given the current challenge at hand, there is a significant demand for the development of a system that can operate efficiently without requiring excessive equipment and substantial time investment. The objective of this research is to introduce a novel system that utilizes deep learning techniques to enable early prediction of glaucoma.The system was evaluated using the Drishti-GS and Drions datasets, which contain retinal fundus images of patients with and without glaucoma. The proposed deep learning model uses the U-Net on Rim-one v3 architecture for optic cup segmentation, and a random forest algorithm for classification. The model’s goal is to determine whether a patient has glaucoma based on their retinal fundus image. The model’s output is a binary label indicating whether the patient has glaucoma or healthy eye. In order to assess the performance of the model, various metrics were used. The average accuracy of the suggested stacking ensemble stands at 94.43%, and achieved a true positive rate of 92.93% and a true negative rate of 88.54%, indicating its ability to accurately identify both positive and negative cases for the condition being evaluated.. These results demonstrate that the proposed model has superior performance to other glaucoma prediction systems.

articleTitle: Design of Threat Detection Model for IoT-Enabled Smart Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In an era marked by the pervasive integration of Internet of Things (IoT) technology into diverse sectors, safeguarding the security of IoT-enabled smart environments has emerged as a paramount concern. This paper presents a threat detection model specifically designed for IoT-enabled smart environments. A “DS2OS” dataset is utilized for evaluation, and machine learning techniques, including SVM, DT, RFT, and XGBT, are employed. The results show high accuracy, precision, and recall for each technique. Furthermore, a proposed voting classifier achieves exceptional performance with a 99% accuracy rate, contributing to improved security and safety in IoT-enabled environments. By providing an advanced threat detection mechanism, this model contributes to enhancing the security and reliability, ultimately promoting the widespread adoption and utilization of IoT technology for societal benefit.

articleTitle: Detection of Chronic Kidney Disease Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Everyone is aware that the kidneys play a significant part in the body, providing critical functions such as osmoregulation and excretion, amongst other things. To put it another way, the kidneys and the excretion system are responsible for collecting any harmful or unneeded compounds and then flushing them out of the body. Chronic renal disease is the result of an issue originating in the kidneys. Chronic kidney disease (CKD), a non-communicable disorder that has a substantial effect on patient morbidity, mortality, and hospital admission rates worldwide, affects 10-15% of the world’s population. It is believed that making an accurate and early diagnosis of the phases of CKD is essential for reducing the negative effects that the patient’s health problems have. Chronic kidney disease, often known as CKD, is a disorder that is characterised by a continuous decline in kidney function over time. It is indicative of a condition that is harmful to one’s kidneys and has an impact on their overall health. Incorrect diagnosis and management of an illness might potentially result in end-stage renal failure and the death of the patient. Several studies focusing on the early detection of CKD have made use of tools from the field of machine learning. The objective of this study is to design a method based on machine learning that is capable of accurately predicting Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD). The Artificial Neural Network (ANN) is the method that is used in the proposed strategy for the purpose of making a prediction about CKD. Both the training and the testing of the models made use of the Chronic Kidney Disease dataset that was available in the UCI Machine Learning Repository. People will be able to ascertain whether or not they have CKD by inputting information into a web application that was built using the Flask framework. This component of the proposed system is also included. Because of this function, the system is both less complicated and more accessible to all users. The research contributes to the field of medical diagnostics and highlights the ways in which machine learning techniques might be used to improve CKD prediction.

articleTitle: Virtual Assistant with Facial Expession Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In Today’s world, Intelligent Virtual Assistants are used everywhere, and their base working principle is voice commands. And there are numerous technologies available for reading human facial expressions. So, in this paper, we will learn what happens if we combine both technologies. Does it better or create chaos? Artificial intelligence is gaining strength in the modern world. Every industry will soon use AI technology. AI has made great progress in recent years in identifying human emotions through voice, body language, facial expressions, etc. I’s significance stems from the fact that traditional human capabilities can now be studied inexpensively and at scale in the software. Every sector can use me to provide new possibilities and efficiencies. It is significant because it successfully overcomes a well-defined set of technological challenges. The technology enables us to complete competitive tasks with basic controls quickly. Every new voice-interactive technology we adopt deepens our reliance on artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning from our smartphones, computers, televisions, and refrigerators. The connection between machines and humans that we had been seeing and dreaming about a few decades ago has been real thanks to voice assistants like Amazon Echo, Siri, Google Home, and Amazon Lexa. But today, the fact is undeniable and real. Voice search technology is the upcoming digital trend on the market; in certain cases, touch screens have already been replaced.

articleTitle: Drop Count:An Efficient Application To Preserve Water Wastage
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In today’s world of technology, Internet of Things (IoT) has significantly altered several industries. One of the breakthroughs of the Internet of Things (IoT) is the implementation of smart water monitoring devices. In this paper, the design and functionality of an IoT (Internet of Things) based Device called Drop Count is analyzed. This device is put in the overhead tanks which is used to evaluate water levels and water quality efficiently with the help of TDS meters and water flow sensors attached to it. Drop Count combines two widely used platforms, namely Arduino and Firebase, to provide an easy connection and data transmission. The user-friendly application, Drop Count is connected by Arduino, functioning as an intermediary. A reliable Cloud based platform firebase, is a base for transferring data from the device to the user.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on Single Image Dehazing using Deep Learning-Based Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Hazy environments significantly reduce the quality of digital images since haze varies with the scene depth. As a result, removing the haze from the original image is critical. Since deep learning techniques have been introduced, dehazing an image becomes much more efficient. This paper discusses a comparative study of different deep learning-based techniques to dehaze images. The techniques are briefly discussed along with the methodology and loss functions. The techniques have been quantitatively measured using some popular metrics like SSIM and PSNR. The paper provides a discussion of various datasets available for image dehazing. Finally, a quantitative analysis of different dehazing techniques along with the conclusion is provided.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Majority and Weighted Voting Ensemble Techniques for Improving the Accuracy of False Information Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: A method of information dissemination that had never been seen before the digital era has emerged as a result of the use of social media platforms like Facebook, Twitter & Instagram and the development of the World Wide Web. Through these social media sites, a significant quantity of information may be fraudulent. Therefore, it is necessary to monitor this data. By feeding a new article or fact to the model, we may use a technique called machine learning-based fake news identification to determine its veracity. We will preprocess the data (in this example, text) before training the dataset. Preprocessing mostly entails eliminating redundant data. The dataset is then divided into two sections for testing and training. The data will next be vectorized using a variety of vectorization methods, including Countvectorizer, TF-IDF vectorizer, and n-grams. The various machine learning algorithms such as random forest, decision tree, logistic regression etc. are then trained using the vectorized data. The accuracy of cutting-edge false news detection is then increased by incorporating these results into ensemble models. The timeline of a dataset has an impact on how accurate the model is since newer information is not included in older datasets, making it impossible for the model to effectively forecast the veracity of newer information. After training, the model may be quickly tested using the testing dataset, and it will then be ready for usage.

articleTitle: OPNET Insights: Unpacking DDoS Effects on Network Performance
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attempts keep presenting an important danger to network facilities, affecting network performance and causing disruptions that impact businesses and organizations. This review paper delves into the multifaceted realm of DDoS attacks and their consequences on network performance, leveraging the powerful simulation capabilities of OPNET Modeler. The study examines key performance indicators, mitigation techniques, and emerging research areas, providing actionable insights for network administrators and security professionals. Additionally, the paper explores various types of DDoS attacks, the challenges they present, and presents a comprehensive literature survey on DDoS attack detection and mitigation strategies. Understanding the intricate relationship between DDoS attacks and network performance is crucial for enhancing network resilience in an increasingly interconnected world.

articleTitle: Securing Industry 4.0: A Survey of Biometric Traits and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Industry 4.0, the advent of electronic industrial framework, is commonly referred to as the 4th industrial revolution and is progressing at highly growing rate as compared to the three former revolutions. Accessibility forms the fundamental basis for operation when there is a continuous exchange of knowledge between autonomous and efficient robots and business units. Workers play a vital role when utilizing emerging technology and exercising autonomy in decision-making. Employing techniques that separate individuals and their actions and reactions may be required. Enhancing safety measures, limiting access to restricted areas exclusively to approved personnel, and prioritizing employee welfare can yield advantages across the entire production chain. Hence, the collection of biometric data from individuals, whether with their awareness or without it, has the potential to facilitate authentication or monitor their emotions and cognitive states during their routine work-related tasks. After thoroughly examining the data, we have pinpointed three key domains where Industry 4.0 principles are integrated with the characteristics of biometric structures, traits and techniques. This review presents a inclusive overview of the many biometric functions used in the context of Industry 4.0, including their advantages, disadvantages, and practical uses. The study is now exploring new pathways to find innovative solutions.

articleTitle: Driver Drowsiness Detection using Deep Learning; Approach towards Automating Object Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Drowsiness is the state of being so tired that one feels the urge to rest, and it can result in symptoms that significantly affect how well tasks are performed, such as sluggish response times, brief periods of not being conscious, or microsleeps (blinks lasting more than 500 milliseconds), to mention a few. It is one of the major factors in either serious or deadly car accidents. These symptoms are highly dangerous when driving because they greatly increase the likelihood that drivers will miss road signs or exits, drift into other lanes, or even crash their car and cause an accident. Drivers who are drowsy crash their cars more frequently than those who are alert. So, to avoid these kinds of situations a safety system is used that can help reducing fatal accidents by detecting whether the driver is in drowsy state or not. If the driver is found in drowsy state, the system will start to beep. Hence alerting the driver and co-passengers about the situation. So, the overall goal of our project named driver drowsiness detection is to identify the state when driver feel drowsy and alert him so that fatalities can be terminated.

articleTitle: Predictive Meteorology with PySpark: Analyzing and Forecasting Weather Data
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The spread of huge information across numerous realms, including social networks and financial markets, has led to the emergence of big data analytics as a means to gain useful understandings. This study explores using big data analytics in climate forecasting using instruments like Hadoop and Apache Spark. The challenges of predicting complex meteorological situations are talked about, emphasizing the likely benefits of advanced analytics. The paper stresses the importance of Hadoop’s distributed data system(HDFS)and the MapReduce algorithm for productive data handling. Two separate implementations, MapReduce and Spark, are used to analyze data, showing their strengths in managing enormous datasets. Additionally, sequence analysis is exhibited using an Autoregressive Integrated Moving Averages (ARIMA) model to predict future temperatures. The experimental results reveal valuable discoveries, like ordinary temperature variations, extreme temperature stations, and the application of sequence analysis for temperature prediction. The paper ends by stressing the relevance of big data analytics, Hadoop, and Spark in improving weather prediction. This has wide implications for sectors reliant on precise meteorological insights.

articleTitle: A Novel Knowledge Semantic Video game Prototype to treat patients with Absence Epilepsy
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In recent times, children are increasingly experiencing anxiety and depression, nervousness, emotional distress, and a susceptibility to conditions such as Absence Epilepsy, Juvenile Myoclonic Epilepsy (JME), and Migraine. Absence Epilepsy is one of the major challenging issues of current neurological research. Absence Epilepsy is a common form of childhood epilepsy that can have significant impact on children, leading problems to memory loss, lack of cognitive ability, attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD). Recent studies of neurological research highlight that specific video games have positive effects on cognitive and motor functions in children. The proposed research presents a novel approach to create a video game prototype exclusively for children with Absence Epilepsy. Concepts of semantic web are used to build the various relations among depression, anxiety, Absence Epilepsy to understand its cause, impact on human brain and memory. Additionally, the prototype aims to assess the game’s usability to ensure it is accessible and effective for its intended audience. The research methodology involves a multidisciplinary approach, drawing from neurology, pediatrics, Game designers, and Semantic Web technologies. The initial phase involves an in-depth analysis of the cognitive and motor challenges faced by children with Absence Epilepsy, enabling the integration of suitable therapeutic elements into the game mechanics. Subsequently, Semantic Web technologies are utilized to construct an ontology capturing crucial information about the player’s condition, medical history, and game play preferences. In conclusion, the research bridges the gap between pediatric healthcare and therapeutic gaming. The innovative video game prototype promises in enhancing the lives of children with Absence Epilepsy, enhancing their cognitive abilities, memory, and cognitive attention, and paving the way for further exploration of video games as a valuable complement to traditional treatment approaches for epilepsy and other neuro-developmental disorders.

articleTitle: Reviewing Temperature Dependence in Influencing Electrical Properties of Polyaniline
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The temperature dependence on the electrical properties of Polyaniline (PANI) has been extensively investigated, revealing crucial insights into its conductivity behavior. Generally, an increase in temperature is associated with a rise in electrical conductivity, a phenomenon attributed to the heightened mobility of charge carriers within the polymer matrix. The thermal energy supplied at higher temperatures facilitates the movement of electrons and holes, resulting in improved conductivity. Many studies have observed this behavior, with the temperature-conductivity relationship often adhering to the Arrhenius equation, indicating an exponential dependence. However, despite the wealth of research in this area, there are notable limitations in existing works. The temperature range explored in some studies may not cover the full operational spectrum of PANI-based devices, potentially leading to incomplete conclusions regarding its temperature-dependent behavior. Additionally, variations in PANI formulations, such as dopants and processing methods, across different studies can contribute to discrepancies in reported results, making it challenging to establish universal trends. Furthermore, the impact of temperature on other electrical properties, such as charge carrier mobility and trap states, may not be adequately addressed in some investigations. Therefore, while current research provides valuable insights into the temperature influence on PANI’s electrical properties, addressing these limitations will be crucial for a more comprehensive understanding and reliable application in diverse technological contexts.

articleTitle: Comparative study on post-workout meal recommender systems using machine learning algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The abundance of options for post-workout healthy meal recommendations can be overwhelming, it becomes crucial to streamline, prioritize, and effectively provide pertinent information. This is necessary to address the issue of information overload and the consequent development of unhealthy eating habits, which has become a significant concern for numerous Internet users. The discipline of fitness and nutrition has recently seen an increased emphasis on post-workout meal optimisation to improve athletic performance and support muscle recovery. The post-workout meal recommender systems described in this study use machine learning algorithms to offer individualised food recommendations. To provide precise and customised suggestions, the suggested methods include content-based filtering, collaboration-based filtering, and a hybrid approach. The results of this study can be used to inform the development of food recommendation systems, as well as to guide food businesses in making decisions about their offerings. Diets with higher mean occurrence indicate that more people are interested in such diets after a workout. At the same time, macro-nutrients with higher mean occurrence indicate what nutrients are popular after a workout among people with similar health routine. In the future, it would be beneficial to expand the scope of this study to include a more diverse population, as well as to incorporate additional factors such as dietary restrictions and nutritional information.

articleTitle: Exploring the Potential of EfficientNetB7 for Diabetic Retinopathy Classification: A Comprehensive Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Diabetes is currently a highly widespread disease affecting individuals of all ages all around the world. The blood vessels inside the retina may suffer substantial harm from high blood sugar levels, that may occur in vision loss if left untreated. Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) refers to a disorder over excessive glucose levels in retinal blood vessels. DR testing programs, such as retinal fundus image analysis, support ophthalmologists in dealing with certain trouble with vision issues. Early detection can help in the diagnosis and control of visual loss, for such life-threatening diseases. Computer-aided diagnostic technologies are helpful in automating the early diagnosis process since they not only detect diabetes signatures, however offer information about the diabetes grading for the eye doctor to decide a suitable therapy. In the field of research, several deep classification methods have been proposed to overcome the DR classification tasks. However, such techniques frequently not found the ability to add a learning algorithm for more reliable encoding of conceptual dependencies region for and identify the most significant area were improving model performance. Our proposed work depends on the different CNN architectures applied to classify the Diabetic Retinopathy Classes and furthermore via image processing approaches to improve the Accuracy and optimization time of classification.

articleTitle: Feature Extraction from Image Sensing (Remote) : Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In this research paper, an overview of computer methods for segmenting continuous-tone images into meaningful parts and characterizing these parts with “features” is presented. Image segmentation is an essential pre-processing step in computer vision and image processing softwares. This paper discusses various techniques and algorithms used for image segmentation, including both supervised and unsupervised methods. The performance of these techniques is evaluated on different test images, and future research directions are proposed. Feature extraction from image sensing is a critical step in multimedia processing. This paper explores the process of feature extraction from remotely sensed images. With the increasing use of remote sensing technology, it is crucial to have effective and accurate methods for extracting features from remotely sensed data, which are utilized in various applications such as land-use mapping, environmental proctoring, and in natural-disaster management. This paper discusses several techniques for feature extraction, including pixel-based, object-based, and machine learning-based approaches. Additionally, it highlights the difficulties associated with feature extraction from remote sensing data, such as atmospheric effects, radiometric and geometric distortions, and the presence of noise. The paper concludes by discussing future directions in remote sensing feature extraction, including the integration of deep learning methods and the development of more robust methods has the ability of handling large-scale datasets. With the help of deep learning methods and algorithms, especially CNN’s, has tremendously improved the accuracy of image scene classification. In this study, a CNN model which is already trained was utilized to fetch-out deep features from images at various network layers, including the average pooling layer.

articleTitle: The Development of a Job Portal to Facilitate Incampus Placement
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Nowadays, every industrial sector is extremely competitive, and employment market is going through the same. A employment site is a website that provides hiring managers and candidates with details. A job portal aids in discovering the ideal company for employees for both the job candidate and job recruiters. In the case of job searchers, the employment site which is the website displays the distinct list of firms according to their preferences, abilities, and educational-background. And selects the best candidates from within the pool of applications to present to the hiring managers. The main objective of this application is to establish a system that permits communication between job holders and candidates. Communication between interested parties is encouraged in order to speed up the hiring process. The purpose of this study is to create an employment website portal for the students in the university to obtain Incampus placements effectively. As previously stated, the main objectives of this portal are to develop relationships with industry and acts as an online employment tool to aid students in obtaining the appropriate IT job after completion of their graduation. Furthermore, this type of technique enhances college students’ comprehension of the idea and importance of the employment site. An investigation was made into the problems students were having with the faculty’s present site, and to compile a list of their needs that might be integrated into the new site.

articleTitle: Detection and Prevention Mechanism for DDoS Attacks in Cloud Computing:The Role of Software-Defined Networking(SDN)
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Cloud computing has developed as a vital technology for offering on-demand computing resources that meet the changing requirements of modern applications. The cloud environment, on the other hand, is especially vulnerable to Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) assaults, which can interrupt services and cause serious financial and reputational harm. The purpose of this research paper is to investigate the detection and prevention techniques for DDoS attacks in a cloud computing environment, with a special emphasis on the function of Software-Defined Networking (SDN).This paper present an overview of cloud infrastructure, its importance in today’s world, and the inherent weaknesses that make it an appealing target for attackers. Furthermore, it cover numerous sorts of DDoS attacks that might jeopardize cloud service availability and performance. The paper also explores the advantages SDN offers to cloud security by utilizing the dynamic and centralized control it provides. Through flow monitoring and analysis, behavioral anomaly detection, and machine learning-based approaches, the potential of SDN to improve the detection of DDoS attacks is explored. The SDN-enabled preventative techniques, such as traffic engineering, rate limitation, access control, and authentication procedures, as well as the significance of service provider cooperation in effectively mitigating DDoS assaults, are also discussed.

articleTitle: Smart Blockchain Secured Application for Healthcare: SBSAH
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Technology advancements in the Internet of Things (IoT) and Blockchain (BT) have replaced the traditional healthcare system with smart healthcare. This intends to explore the potential benefits of combining blockchain technology with IoT in the healthcare enterprise. IoT consists of those devices that are used to collect data from users and in healthcare, these devices are used to accumulate patient sensory data in real time for processing and analysis. There are various problems associated with collecting data and simply storing them, so to eliminate that Blockchain is used. Blockchain can easily solve these difficulties by delivering decentralized memory and storage for collected information. And a combination of IoT and Blockchain will help in creating secure e-healthcare systems. Along with this, we will also discuss data security with Blockchain and other use cases of these technologies showing some of their key features. Additionally, we will be showcasing a component of MEDIFY, a flutter-based android application that we have created to allow the user and medical institutes to access and update the IoT-collected data. This application is specially designed for users to update medical records, and access them when required, and these records are all secured by Blockchain and stored in our firebase servers.

articleTitle: Covid-19 Vaccine Certificate Verification using Sha Algorithm and IPFS in Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has suddenly arisen as a global health emergency requiring concerted international action. Governments are working to stop the virus from spreading and health organizations rushed to create vaccines that would protect people. Reduce Covid-19 morbidity, reduce strain on healthcare systems, and let economies to expand. The Vaccine Certificate has been adopted as a way forward after the COVID-19 vaccination to assist authorities in formulating policies by restricting cross-border travel. In this work, we employ blockchain technology to construct a safe and verifiable vaccination certificate, which alleviates substantial privacy concerns and eliminates the need for third parties to maintain trust and control the user’s data. Different modern technologies, such as smart contracts, are used in our approach.

articleTitle: Advanced Driving Assistant System: An Approach of Edge Detection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Improving road safety and reducing road accidents, hence saving lives, is a major objective of Advanced Driver Assistance Systems. Detection of road lanes and/or road limits appears to be one of the most difficult and complex tasks of future road vehicles. This is built on vehicle detection, which includes identification of the road, assessment of the car’s position in relation to the road, and analysis of the car’s driving direction. Using the vehicle’s visual system for identifying road limits and lanes is among the most popular ways. Yet, lane recognition is a challenging problem because of the variety of traffic conditions drivers can experience. A vision-based lane recognition approach that can function in real time and is resistant to lighting changes and shadows is presented in this research study. The device acquires the front image with a vehicle-mounted camera and then performs a few steps to recognise the lanes. This device captures the front image of the vehicle using a mounted camera and employs a variety of methods to identify the lanes. Using two fit plots to the lane edges, the Hough transform recovers the lanes. Its proposed lane detection method is adaptable to straight and curved roads, paint and unpainted roadways, and different weather situations. No more information is needed for the suggested method, including lane width, the length of time between lane crossings, or the offset between the centres of the lanes. No coordinate transformation or camera calibration is also necessary. The system was evaluated under a range of conditions, including varying illumination, shadow effects, and varied road kinds, with no speed restrictions. Ultimately, a comprehensive assessment of the methodologies and their prospective deployment prospects were addressed.

articleTitle: Optimized energy expenditure for Wireless Sensor Networks using GLVC Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: “Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) have gained considerable attention for their versatility in diverse applications, from environmental monitoring to healthcare. Nonetheless, effective energy management poses a significant challenge within WSNs due to the limitations of battery resources in their nodes. Addressing this concern, this research presents an energy optimization methodology for WSNs by leveraging the Greedy Low-energy Adaptive Clustering (GLVC) technique. The proposed method aims to determine an optimal parameter configuration that minimizes energy consumption while maintaining the desired network performance. Through experimental simulations conducted on a network model, this approach demonstrates its effectiveness in substantially reducing energy usage without compromising the network’s efficiency.”

articleTitle: Efficient Edge Preserving Image Denoising using Non-Local Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Image denoising is an integral part of many image processing applications because of its ability to filter out background noise without affecting the quality of the original image. Numerous denoising approaches, from time-tested staples like Gaussian smoothing to cutting-edge tools built on deep neural networks, have been created throughout the years. Non-Local Means (NLM) denoising algorithms, which have been shown to significantly enhance image quality, are the topic of this research. The idea behind Non-Local Means algorithms is that neighboring areas of an image should have equivalent pixel values. NLM algorithms show remarkable improvement in denoising by taking advantage of the redundancy in natural images. The ability to do non-local comparisons based on patches and to adaptively weigh the contributions of related patches is the source of this strength. This means they are great at filtering out unwanted noise without sacrificing structural clarity. In this paper, the theoretical underpinnings and practical applications of Non-Local Means algorithms are examined, presenting a comprehensive review of the field. Different types of noise are addressed, as well as the many NLM variants and extensions, such as fast and adaptable methods. The experiment was conducted at varying noise levels, specifically $\sigma=30, \sigma=40, ~\text{and} ~\sigma=50$, to comprehensively evaluate the performance of the Non-Local Means (NLM) filter under different challenging noise conditions. These varying noise levels allowed for a robust assessment of the denoising algorithm’s adaptability and effectiveness across a range of practical scenarios. Furthermore, there is a discussion of some computational considerations for using NLM in the real world.

articleTitle: Building A Student Knowledge Based Ontology Approach Using Web Ontology Language
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Education is rapidly progressing and it is very important to have a bridge between innovative skills and conceptual learning. Education will provide learning abilities through various modes in sense of cognitive abilities and applying knowledge to gain optimality. Apart from these skills it is very important to have good behaviour to enhance the quality of life. Currently children are facing a lot of issues with academics, emotional imbalance, anxiety and depression, mental illness and lack of physical fitness. To overcome the above issues a knowledge-based ontology approach is presented and proposed using Web Ontology Language (OWL). To achieve this, survey was conducted among students of age group 1823 to analyse their SWOT analysis, emotional stability of a student, intelligent quotient by understanding their personas, habitat in schooling, intermediate, graduation, sports and curricular activities. Surveys were circulated through google forms, face to face interaction were conducted and responses were noted. Based on the responses from the survey analysis, entities and objects are identified and relationships between them were inter linked. Ontologies are predominantly used to identify the relations between entities and objects, using OWL on platform protégé editor, for the identified entities relations were build. The generated output which are in the form of graphs are termed as knowledge-base are stored in the inference engine. SWRL was used to validate the proposed ontology to provide the optimal results.

articleTitle: Secure Digital Payments System Using Blockchain Technology: A Survey-Based Study
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The era of digital payment systems leads to dynamic changes in economic growth. The trend of digital innovation is where business transactions change from cash to electronic-based transactions. The digital payment system is not introduced to replace cash but it is used as a quick and secure alternative for payments. Motivated by recent trends in payment systems this study intends to review the available digital payment modes to highlight the scope of scan and pay method of digital payments and the methodology used by previous researchers to identify the gap between the scan and pay transactions and study for further developments. Besides enhancing the utility of the digital payment system, the major focus is on enhancing user experience and minimizing transaction failure, the privacy of the user is also a concern in this digital era, and the suggestion of using specially designed blockchain technology and cryptographic methods we can secure digital payments to a greater extent.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Approach Towards a Movie Recommendation System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Online streaming media platforms are booming these days. They provide online services that cater specifically to their users and provide them with some much-needed entertainment. But when it’s time for a short break just to freshen up the mind, everyone prefers choosing from the options that are just a click away, what could be better than a user being recommended their favorite songs to play, movies to watch during a break. This is where highly advanced and convenient recommendation systems come into play. Recommendation systems solve this problem by analyzing the bulk of dynamically generated data to provide customized suggestions to the users. With the day-to-day increasing popularity and demand of such services, and with increasing competition in this massive service-oriented sector, a highly functional and effective recommendation system could provide a significant marketing edge to a company over its competitors, as a wide range of products, services and their substantial amount of information are available on the service provider company’s website and as a result, the users struggle to find relevant information matching their preferences. Thus, we have tried to design a framework for a movie recommendation system by using and testing various classical machine learning models like Content-Based Filtering and Collaborative Filtering to recommend the best movies based on user ratings, user watch history, movie data, etc., that are more likely to be watched by the customer. We have also combined these models to create a Hybrid model which provides better recommendations. This could help in improving the revenue earned by the media platforms, which in turn is the main purpose of any recommendation system.

articleTitle: A Review on Emotion Detection of Contextual Text
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In recent years, emotion detection in text has become increasingly popular due to its potential applications in marketing, political science, psychology, human-computer interaction, artificial intelligence, and more. Access to vast amounts of textual data, especially unique and self-printing texts, has also played a special role in attracting attention to the field. This article reviews the research that has been done to identify emotional or sentimental expressions in text, and many techniques, methods, and models have been developed to identify sentiment in text. There is a great improvement in the design and architecture of models in past decade. This article covers current developments in emotion identification in texts and offers useful insights for academics and practitioners working in this field.

articleTitle: Early Forest Fire Prediction using Machine Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: With the huge increment in the occurrence and severity of forest fires have necessitated the need for early prediction systems. Machine learning approaches have been employed in recent years for early forest fire prediction. Every fire mostly depends on variables such as oxygen levels, temperature, relative humidity, FFMC, DMC, and so forth. This study seeks to let us understand the likelihood of a forest catching fire earlier using the oxygen, humidity, temperature, etc. as the content of a particular location. This paper provides an overview of some of the most promising techniques for machine-learning used for early forest fire prediction, including Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machines, and Convolutional Neural Networks. The data sources used in training the models, such as meteorological data, topographical data, and remote sensing data, are also discussed. The paper concludes by highlighting the benefits of using machine learning approaches for early forest fire prediction, including improved accuracy and speed, which can aid in the prevention of disastrous forest fires.

articleTitle: Cloud Privacy and Security-A Review Paper
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
