articleTitle: Blockchain: The Future of Secure Health Record Management
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The emerging sector of blockchain functions based on a digitally distributed ledger and consensus algorithm, eliminating the requirement for intermediaries and augmenting security. In healthcare, the idea of blockchain technology has the potential to be a significant benefit. Multiple stakeholders such as healthcare providers, patients, payers, research organizations, and supply chain participants necessitate interoperability, security, authenticity, transparency, and seamless transactions. By implementing a patient-centric approach, blockchain technology can transform healthcare data into an interoperable format among individuals by eliminating third-party involvement. This technology can be utilized to develop applications that aim to minimize systematic fraud by ensuring transparency at all stages. This study will aim to pinpoint the primary challenges encountered by healthcare stakeholders and examine how blockchain technology can overcome them.

articleTitle: Deepfake Detection Techniques and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: As we are in the 21st century there we are sharing our data on the public domain. Sometime our data (our images or videos) can alter and used in other ways. Deepfake is a technology that can create the fake images and videos with the help of deep learning that is a sect of the artificial intelligence. In this paper we are presenting that how we can detect the fake videos that are afloat on the public domain. We are proposing and presenting a new detection method as the comparative product of different types of deepfake detection algorithm that is implementable and scalable to higher volumes with the use of cutting-edge hardware under special conditions. We use MTCNNs and Inception ResNet models to do so.

articleTitle: Facial Detection and the Effect of Ageing
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In computer vision, generating images of faces that appear to age is a challenging challenge. This is known as a conditional image generation problem because the generated image is dependent on a specified face image. Until recently, generative models were incapable of producing realistic, high-resolution photo simulations. Nevertheless, a generative model known as a generative adversarial network (GAN) has demonstrated remarkable abilities both in absolute and constrained contexts for generating realistic images. Despite this, generating images that display the aging process while preserving The true identity of the individual in the image source is a difficult task due to two contradictory constraints: The image that is produced must maintain the person’s identification from the primary image. while also possessing all the characteristics of age targeted. Regarding this study, the authors used a GAN in a conditional setting in conjunction with a custom loss function designed to strike a balance between preserving the individual’s identity and generating characteristics of the target age.

articleTitle: Use of Machine Learning In Smart Health Care System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The Smart Health Care System is designed to facilitate seamless communication between users and doctors. This application allows users to search for symptoms of diseases and communicate with doctors from any place at any time. The system uses Symptom Checker to automate the existing healthcare system by dividing the application into several modules that provide complete solutions for different departments. In most cases, the diagnosis of the disease the acquisition of comprehensive clinical and pathological data is essential for accurate analysis, which often Results in exorbitant healthcare expenses and Impacts the standard of healthcare services provided. A smart healthcare system helps patients by providing a preliminary diagnosis based on their symptoms and enables communication with doctors based on the diagnostic report. Based on symptoms and corresponding diseases, the system ensures error-free, safe, reliable and fast treatment. The system detects the disease based on the specified symptoms, extracts information from the data collection by comparing the symptoms provided by the user with all the diseases in the database, decodes the relationship between the symptoms and the diseases, and finally presents the classified information to the user.

articleTitle: Crop Recommendation System Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Crop recommendation is an important part of precision agriculture for crop productivity improvement. Machine learning techniques have been used many times in this domain to analyze agricultural data and provide recommendations based on various factors such as soil parameters, climate, and other environmental conditions. In this research paper, we recommend a crop recommendation system based on Machine Learning methods that evaluates climatic variables like temperature, humidity, and rainfall as well as soil characteristics like nitrogen, potassium, and pH levels. We have used a dataset consisting of soil parameters and climate data along with corresponding crop yield information we’re going to train and test our models. We have explored and compared the performance of several ML algorithms in providing crop recommendations. Our suggested crop suggestion system, which is based on machine learning, may help farmers and agricultural specialists choose and manage crops intelligently, ultimately improving crop yields and productivity.

articleTitle: Impact of Conductivity and Doping over Electrical Properties of Polyaniline
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Polyaniline (PANI) has garnered substantial interest in the field of conductive polymers due to its unique electrical and electronic properties, making it suitable for a range of applications. The impact of conductivity and doping on the electrical properties of PANI has been extensively studied, with researchers exploring various doping agents and strategies to enhance its performance. However, conventional research on this topic is not without its challenges. One significant aspect of the impact is the role of doping in modulating the electrical conductivity of PANI. The choice of dopant and its concentration play a crucial role in determining the overall electrical behavior of PANI. While these studies have provided valuable insights, there is often a lack of standardization in reporting methodologies, making it challenging to compare results across different studies. Conventional research has also grappled with issues related to the reproducibility of electrical properties in doped PANI. Variations in synthesis methods, environmental conditions, and impurities in the starting materials can lead to inconsistencies in the electrical performance of the polymer. This lack of reproducibility hinders the development of robust and reliable applications based on PANI. Efforts to standardize synthesis protocols and characterization techniques are necessary to address these challenges. Furthermore, the understanding of the long-term stability of doped PANI in real-world applications is often overlooked in conventional research. Environmental factors, such as exposure to moisture, temperature variations, and oxidative stress, can impact the conductivity and structural integrity of PANI over time. Comprehensive studies evaluating the stability of doped PANI under various conditions are crucial for assessing its practical utility. While the impact of conductivity and doping on the electrical properties of PANI is well-established, there are challenges in conventional research that need to be addressed. Standardization of synthesis and characterization methods, improved reproducibility, and a focus on long-term stability are essential for advancing the practical applications of PANI-based materials in electronic devices and other emerging technologies. Overcoming these challenges will contribute to a more robust understanding of the electrical properties of PANI and accelerate its adoption in real-world applications.

articleTitle: Dental Disease Detection and Classification in Radiograph Images using Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Dental illnesses are common global health disorders that, if neglected, can have serious consequences for your oral health. Radiographs, which may prove expensive and time-consuming, are a major component of traditional methods for diagnosing and classifying dental diseases. The goal of this study is to suggest a model based on deep learning for dental illness identification and classification sans the use of radiographs, offering an effective and affordable substitute for early detection and care. The Deep Neural Network that has been pre-trained by applying a vast collection of radiograph pictures can be fine-tuned, which is a popular alternative. Radiography picture classification in the database was done using five different levels. The anatomical position, ancillary features, radiodensity, impact on the surrounding framework, and the category of abnormality were all classified here. By making this information available, we hope to improve your capacity to translate radiologist models, automate anomaly identification and categorization in dentistry panoramic radiographs, and progress teeth segmentation algorithms.

articleTitle: Classification of Musical Genres Using Audio Spectrograms
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The classification of music into distinct genres is a valuable undertaking in the realm of multimedia study, as it enables artists, albums, and songs to be categorized based on shared musical characteristics. This study aims to contribute to the field of music genre categorization by proposing an approach that can more accurately classify musical genres compared to existing methodologies. Our approach leverages the attributes extracted from the MK2 audio dataset, which is a compilation of musical genre data that has been collected and processed to facilitate the prediction of song genres. The proposed method employs convolutional neural networks (CNN) and utilizes audio spectrograms as input features. Additionally, this study presents a comparative analysis of our proposed approach with previous research papers, providing insights into the effectiveness of our proposed model.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Prediction of Drought using Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Low rainfall over a period can lead to insufficient soil moisture and result in drought. This condition can last for weeks to months, depending on the extent of soil moisture depletion. Evapotranspiration, the process of water loss through evaporation and transpiration, plays a critical role in this phenomenon. The intensity of rainfall, temperature, sunshine, wind, amount of rainfall, and water vapor all impact soil moisture. Drought can have a significant impact on society’s functioning, including environmental, economic, and social well-being. With the changing climate, there is a need to adapt to cope with altered weather patterns. This study proposes a hybrid model for drought prediction using Artificial Intelligence and machine learning algorithms. The model is based on a combination of Support Vector Regression (SVR) and Extreme Gradient Boosting (XG Boost) algorithms, and uses historical rainfall and temperature data to predict future drought conditions. The proposed model was tested using data from a region in India, and was found to outperform traditional statistical models in terms of accuracy and predictive power. The results of this study suggest that the proposed hybrid model has the potential to be a valuable tool for predicting drought conditions and helping farmers and policymakers make more informed decisions about agricultural planning and water resource management. Future research directions include improving data quality, refining the model in real-world settings, and exploring potential applications of the model beyond agriculture.

articleTitle: Harnessing Artificial Intelligence for Preventing and Detecting Addiction in Digital Healthcare and social media among students of age group 12 to 18
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The comprehensive review explores the application of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning techniques in studying and addressing social media addiction in the context of digital healthcare. The review covers a wide range of topics, including the use of affective expressions, like insecurity or withdrawal symptoms and AI to detect mental distress. AI plays a vital role in detecting and preventing mental disorders related to social media usage, AI-based approaches for identifying individuals at risk of developing addictive behaviors on social media platforms, and the utilization of AI for detecting mental illness through social media data. It highlights how AI algorithms can analyze user-generated content on social media platforms to identify signs of mental distress, allowing for timely interventions and support. By detecting early warning signs, AI can facilitate personalized interventions and real-time monitoring to mitigate social media addiction. It showcases the potential of AI algorithms to analyze social media content and identify indicators of mental health conditions, providing valuable insights for early detection and intervention. Additionally, the review emphasizes the integration of AI as a preventive measure for social media addiction. By exploring the application of AI, particularly deep learning algorithms, in detecting depression among Twitter users, highlighting the potential of AI to identify individuals in need of support. Moreover, the review discusses the expanding field of digital psychiatry, the promotion of digital well-being, and the impact of social media addiction. It also examines the role of psychiatric symptoms in predicting internet addiction among adolescents and the importance of understanding contributing factors for the development of preventive measures.

articleTitle: Multi-Grade Brain Tumor Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Brain tumors pose a significant challenge to radiologists engaged in automated diagnosis and health monitoring due to the intricate nature of tumor grading. The literature has suggested a number of machine learning-based strategies to help radiologists in achieving more precise and dependable diagnostic assessments. This paper leverages convolutional neural networks (CNN) in conjunction with MRI detection technology to grow a particular model for the finding of brain tumor’s, facilitating the integration of computer-aided detection technologies in the medical domain. The research introduces an innovative DCNN architecture and delineates a three step preprocessing methodology designed to enhance MRI image quality and enable efficient brain tumor diagnosis. Key contributions of this work include addressing the challenge of limited datasets through the implementation of the Augmentation Technique. Advanced signal processing and image processing techniques are employed for improved feature extraction and selection. Additionally, the utilization of Multigrain offers a novel method to assess the aggressiveness of brain tumors. This research thus presents a comprehensive framework that not only enhances the correctness of brain tumor detection but also addresses data scarcity issues and incorporates state of the art systems for robust feature analysis and tumor characterization.

articleTitle: Cyborg Intelligence-Current study and challenges
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Cyborg Intelligence is a major component in replacing lost body part functions in the twenty-first century by incorporating cyborg technology; a human body will be able to function even if it loses one or more of its functioning parts, such as its arms or legs, which would significantly benefit society. The study of cyborgs and the creation of humanoid robots from them Cyborgs, as the title implies, are hybrids of humans and robots. The study examines cyborg technology that is cybernetic. An artificial intelligence is referred to as a cyborg in this context. Artificial intelligence, sometimes referred to as machine intelligence, is the ability of a computer to create software and act and think like a human. Cybernetics is a branch of science that focuses on the fundamentals of communication and control in both machines and biological things. The discussion of how cybernetics and artificial intelligence interact will be the main focus of this article. Additionally, this article will assess cyborg technology in the real world, examining its benefits and drawbacks as well as the ways in which cyborgs and robots are different. Cyborgs are conceivable in today’s world. A cyborg is a humanoid robot or, more accurately, a hybrid of humans and robots. Robots are mechanical humans that depend on the intellect offered by people. With the use of artificial intelligence, cyborgs may now create their own algorithms. The fusion of logic and technology is a key aspect in the creation of a cyborg.

articleTitle: Twitter Sentiment Analysis for Polarity Detection: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Sentiment analysis is the method of automatically determining how people feel about other people, things, ideas, topics, and events. A large volume of user-generated information, in the form of comments and reviews, is being continually formed as a result of the recent spectacular growth of Social Networking Services (SNS), so the need to determine the user’s viewpoint. This paper aids in comprehending the domain’s complexity, the techniques and datasets employed, and the current level of accuracy attained by various techniques. The drawbacks of traditional research include its accuracy and time requirements. It is believed that combining traditional and a machine learning approach might resolve the performance and accuracy problems. The goal of this survey is to give a succinct, almost complete overview of Sentiment Analysis (SA) methods and associated areas. The survey’s main contributions are the thorough categorizations of multiple recent studies and the portrayal of the current state of SA research.

articleTitle: Chat messenger app using Flutter
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: By allowing users to stay connected to one another, chat applications provide a simple platform for bringing people together. Today’s messaging apps have a larger global user base than traditional social networks, which means they will become increasingly important in the spread of digital information over time. This is accomplished using Flutter, a powerful framework constructed using the Dart programming language. Instead of using a native framework, it provides high UI right in the operating system workspace. Backend-as-Service is offered by Firebase, a modern app development platform on the Google Cloud.This real-time database allows the storage of a list of objects as a treelike data structure. The purpose of this research project is to create a chat room for Android smartphones utilising the Flutter framework. Google is used to generate the database in order to give the customer security. The project’s model is the recent rise in importance of communication over the internet. Users of internet communication can communicate with others quickly and conveniently. In light of this, the web communication tool should allow users to send texts or photos or the other files more quickly, with little to no wait, or without any delay. One of the platforms that offers time-based information cloud services and enables developers to create these applications with simplicity is Firebase. Instantaneous electronic communication is going to be viewed as a platform for maintaining communication. Compared to other platforms like iOS, mechanical man offers a better environment for the development of a variety of applications for instant electronic communication. The main objective of this paper is to present a package application for initiating real-time communication between users and operators. With the assistance of the internet, users of the mechanical man-based system can text each other. Every device must be online for the system to function.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Techniques for Retinopathy Detection and Diagnosis: A Comprehensive Survey
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Retinopathy, a condition that can lead to vision impairment or blindness, has received significant research attention in recent decades, particularly in the development of machine learning techniques for its detection and diagnosis. This survey paper aims to provide a comprehensive overview of the applications of deep learning methods in various retinopathy disorders, including diabetic retinopathy, glaucoma, age-related macular degeneration, and retinopathy of prematurity. The paper begins by exploring the prevalence of retinopathy, along with associated risk factors, highlighting the importance of early detection and intervention in preventing vision loss. We discuss the role of machine learning techniques, specifically deep learning, in addressing the challenges posed by retinopathy. A major focus of this paper is the extensive examination of techniques and algorithms specifically designed for diagnosing retinal abnormalities in retinal fundus images. Through a thorough analysis, categorization, and comparison of previously proposed algorithms and techniques, we aim to enhance the development of more efficient and superior algorithms for retinopathy detection. By thoroughly exploring existing methods employed for analyzing retinal images, the paper addresses the challenges associated with detecting eye disease and provides comprehensive recommendations for potential future advancements in this field.

articleTitle: CNN-RNN Based Hybrid Deep Learning Model for Predicting Fluctuations in the Stock Market
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: To enhance predicting performance, particularly in temporal data processing, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) play a significant role in learning while using ANNs. According to past research works, some time-series may exhibit similar properties over time. Consequently, the relationship between various temporal data must be considered in modeling to generate accurate predictions. Nevertheless, general RNN models have significant limitations in achieving the required target. This research study proposes a new kind of architecture known as HNNs (Hybrid Neural Networks), which combines the hidden state transfer method of the RNN with the convolution layer of a CNN. Multiple RNN models’ concurrency characteristics are extracted by running RNNs along time steps with CNN integration. In addition to possessing the size of the number of time-oriented data, this innovative architecture also possesses the extent in the time dimension in RNN. This paper examines several DNN (Deep Neural Network) models and the theory underlying the DNN model. For our experiment, we utilize National Stock Exchange data. The results indicate that the Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) calculated for the RNN model is 1.005831265 and the MAPE value for CNN-RNN model is 0.902297821. This shows that the hybrid CNN-RNN model performs slightly better than the RNN model.

articleTitle: Network Intrusion Detection Using GAN and Resnet Optimized with Glowworm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: With the increasing complexity and sophistication of cyber-attacks, the development of effective Intrusion Detection System (IDS), has become crucial for ensuring Network Security. In the current era of information technology, organizations have become heavily dependent on computer networks as a means of sharing digital information, including files, data, and programs. As a result, the need to protect a network against intrusion and malicious attacks have become a viable requirement. Network Intrusion Detection Systems (NIDS) are placed within a network strategically to passively examine the traffic traversing the devices on which they are installed and report any suspicious activities. In this research, we present a novel intrusion detection system based on deep learning, employing Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) with Resnet and Glowworm optimization (GRGSO) to detect and prevent both internal and external threats. The proposed approach has undergone experimental evaluation, resulting in exceptional outcomes on KDDcup 99 dataset with an accuracy surpassing 99.2.

articleTitle: Synergistic Multi-Sensor Fusion for Enhanced Vehicle Safety and Security-Integrating Advanced Technologies and Intelligent Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The integration of multiple sensors and advanced technologies in the field of vehicle safety and security has emerged as a promising approach to enhance overall road safety and protect vehicles from potential threats. This paper presents a comprehensive study on the concept of synergistic multi-sensor fusion for advanced vehicle safety and security, focusing on the integration of cutting-edge technologies and intelligent systems. The proposed framework involves fusing data from various sensors to obtain a comprehensive and accurate perception of the vehicle’s surroundings and safety of the driver. By combining the strengths of each sensor, the system overcomes individual limitations and provides robust detection and recognition capabilities. Firstly, it enables accurate and timely detection of potential hazardous gas, infront nearest obstacle detection, accident identification this allowing the vehicle to take proactive measures to avoid collisions. Secondly, it enhances security by detecting and mitigating threats, such as fingerprint-based security system, theft alert. Additionally, the integration of intelligent systems enables driver safety measure based on driver heart rate monitoring, fire detection, current location detection and prone zone vehicle control. This paper highlights the significance of synergistic multi-sensor fusion in advancing vehicle safety and security. The integration of advanced technologies and intelligent systems enables robust detection, recognition, and decision-making capabilities, contributing to a safer and more secure driving experience.

articleTitle: Weapon Detection System for the Prevention of any Potential Crime Using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: To ensure the protection and security of the general public, infrastructure elements like security cameras and video monitoring systems are essential. Due to the rising demand for safety and security, video surveillance systems that can recognize and understand the scene and transmit the appropriate response are required. This idea was proposed because it is time-consuming to physically locate dangerous objects. This enables us to locate any potentially harmful weapons and alert the relevant authorities so they can take the appropriate action. This research aims to develop a low-cost, efficient, AI-based method for recognizing weapons in surveillance videos in real-time and in different environments. The system is verified and makes use of Tensor Flow technology. Two different dataset types are used in this application. In one dataset, the pictures are already labeled, while in the other, the labels were added by hand. This is applicable everywhere in the globe.

articleTitle: A Review of Cyber Security Challenges and Mitigation Strategies in Industry 4.0 Technologies
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The 4th Industrial Revolution, also known as or the Industry 4.0, has been characterized by the emergence of revolutionary technologies like robotics, computer vision, big data the analysis, and the Internet of Things, or IoT for short, directly into the operations of industries. As these technologies become increasingly widespread, they also introduce new cybersecurity risks that need to be addressed. This paper provides a comprehensive review of the current literature on cyber security challenges and mitigation strategies in Industry 4.0. The research approach involved a systematic literature review of academic journals, conference proceedings, and relevant reports and studies. The review’s findings emphasize the most significant cyber security concerns impacting the Industry 4.0 movement, including data privacy and security, network security, and system integrity. The paper also identifies and evaluates the strategies used to mitigate these challenges, including encryption, access control, and network segmentation. The analysis section interprets the findings, draws meaningful conclusions and offers valuable recommendations for future research and practical applications. The research paper delivers an input to the topic of cyber security within Industry 4.0 by offering an in-depth review regarding the domain’s present circumstances and presenting prospective directions for additional research and advancement.

articleTitle: Machine learning-Based Prediction of Home Prices
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In the past few years, machine learning has played an effective part in product orders and recommendations in the medical industry and every day. In return, we offer great customer support and safer automotive systems. As a result of all that has been illustrated, ML may be a innovation that’s getting to be increasingly prevalent over a wide range of businesses. People are endeavouring to buy a modern domestic by considering their budgets and showcase procedure. However, the essential blemish within the existing framework is that it decides the cost of a house without making the fundamental expectations around future advertise patterns, which leads to an increment in cost. Our project’s essential objective is to precisely expect the cost of a house without causing any misfortunes. A few components must be taken into consideration in arrange to accurately anticipate domestic costs and to supply customers with compelling house estimating that’s in line with their inclinations and budget. So, we are creating a show to assess lodging costs. using machine learning advances such as K-Means, Irregular Woodland, Choice Tree, and Direct Relapse. This strategy allows consumers to finance real estate without going through a broker. Research results show that random forest regression has the highest accuracy.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Smartphone Addiction among College Students in Chennai
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Today’s college students almost universally rely on their Smartphone for a variety of duties, including internet surfing, messaging, talking, calling, e-mailing, document creating, computation, playing video games, and music listening. Teenagers worldwide engage in compulsive behaviors, including Smartphone addiction. The purpose of this study is to determine whether there is an association between this addictive behavior and Loyola College-Chennai undergraduate and postgraduate, male and female, urban and rural students. It employs a non-experimental descriptive study design to determine the pattern and addictive behavior. A standardized questionnaire with 30 items was sent to 200 randomly selected college students aged 18 to 24. The primary data came from their responses. The hypotheses were investigated using descriptive and inferential statistics. The study demonstrates the mixed impact of smartphone use on social interaction and behavior. The results show that college students are very addicted to their smartphones. The study’s conclusions might be utilized to alert academics, officials, and college management about which student groups are more at risk. By focusing on these students, the right interventions can be created to raise their academic performance. According to the study, it could be one of the most important references in future research linking Smartphone addiction to other characteristics. It could also be used to identify technological addiction. The study’s findings could assist college students in overcoming their addiction. It might also create a suitable module to help them make the greatest use of their Smartphone

articleTitle: A Machine Learning Based Approach To Detect Fake News In Social Media
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The News available on online resources such as social media applications like facebook, twitter etc. are propagating fast that too in a uncontrolled way and is a matter of high concern in its capability to endure a lot of social and national damage. This damage can prove to be destructive. A lot of researchers are working on detecting this unreliable and falsified information. In this paper, we will be making a short analysis on research related work done till now on fake news detection, using supervised ML algorithms which can catgorize news as true or false by utilising python modules such as sci-kit learn and NLP module for literal analysis. This paper is more focused towards NLP rather than the machine learning domain. This textual analysis process will include processes like feature extraction and vectorization which will be performed using python sci-kit module to carry out feature extraction and pre-processing of text from the dataset, as this library deliver helpful tools like implementation of vectorizer for feature extraction process. Then we will evaluate the performance of different ML algorithms based on several performance factors like accuracy, F1 score, precision and recall. Also, we will work on selecting the best features for the machine learning model to give high precision in detecting fake news. Today the majority of the people have a phone with them and are connected to people around the world through the means of social networking sites. These sites gave everyone the power to keep their opinions but today people are using this power to spread mis-information. This is causing mistrust among people and society. Today fake news is the major reason for the communal riots, government distrust, and a lot more.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Text based Emotion Detection on GoEmotions Dataset
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Today’s environment relies heavily on social media, blogs with customer reviews, tweets, and comments for important communication. Understanding the feelings conveyed through these tweets and comments is crucial for improving a variety of fields, such as the detection of harmful online behavior (hate speech and the use of abusive language), a better understanding of customer review content, the development of chatbots with empathy, and many others. As a result, we introduce Go Emotions, the biggest humanly annotated dataset of 58k English Reddit comments that have been classified as either neutral or one of 27 emotion categories. The GoEmotions dataset’s distinguishing feature is its emphasis on capturing a broad spectrum of emotions. GoEmotions includes a more varied and nuanced set of 27 emotion categories, in contrast to many other emotion datasets that often concentrate on few basic emotions (such as happy, sadness, rage, etc.). Not only do these categories cover fundamental emotions, but also more subtle ones like appreciation, amusement, gratitude, love, and others. Due to a wide range of categories, on the GoEmotions dataset for emotion classification, basic models like SVM (Support Vector Machines) and Naive Bayes might do worse than advanced models like CNNs, RNNs, and Transformers. Thus, applying the methodology from the base paper (BERT) and other advanced models, we present a comparative analysis of the same.

articleTitle: Extractive Text Summarization
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The fields of artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and data science have grown significantly over the past ten years, opening up a wide range of opportunities in sectors as varied as healthcare, banking, and transportation. Notably, there have been substantial developments in the field of Natural Language Processing (NLP), which is a subfield of AI and ML. NLP involves the machine-based processing and understanding of human language. Among its various applications, text summarization holds prominence as it enables machines to condense lengthy texts into concise summaries. This project highlights the utilization of multiple extractive text summarization techniques, including Word Frequency, Lex, Luhn, Kl Summarizer, GPT-2 and BERT. The resultant extractive summaries are then evaluated against human-generated summaries using three distinct scoring methods: Rouge Score, BERT Score, and Mover Score. Through this project, we demonstrate the efficacy of these techniques in generating summaries and assess their quality by comparing them against summaries produced by humans using the specified scoring metrics.

articleTitle: Implementation of Semantic-Based Approach Against Frequency & Graph-Based Approach for Concise Human Summarization
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The volume of data generating by organizations and individuals is significantly increasing daily. The surge in data generation is by technological advancements, widespread usage of Social Media platforms, and the increasing Digitization of various industries incorporating the healthcare, corporate, and business sectors. However, this data explosion has left both organizations and individuals challenged in the consumption of time for searching relevant information over the internet. To address this problem, advanced technologies such as Natural Language Processing (NLP) have emerged, focusing on facilitating seamless human interaction with Computers in natural language by leveraging sophisticated algorithms and techniques. The proposed study of this research paper focuses on comparisons of NLP-Frequency and Graph-based Extractive Text Summarization algorithms with Sematic approaches results. To generate an automated system capable of generating human-like concise summaries from various web pages/ Research papers/ entertainment & educational blogs. The primary data source/dataset required for this model is the Web URLs obtained from a search engine such as Google, Bing, etc. This system streamlines and automates the process by simply clicking on a URL, offering a standardized and efficient approach to accessing the summarized information. It caters to a wide range of users like research scholars, students, news article readers, and general internet users. To further enhance the user experience, the summarized information is read by the Speech Assistor to reduce the manual efforts/dependencies for searching over the internet, visiting webpages, excessive clicks, and multiple scrolling of webpages. It also standardizes/automates the processes by displaying the top links of the Google search engine by the speech assistor.

articleTitle: Cognitive Science: Towards a Multi-Disciplinary Sense for solving a complex mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Cognitive Science is a complex mechanism of solving a problem based on the impact of behavior, analysis of interpretation, studying mental representations functioning of the neurons at the level of brain, perceiving and sensing an object: a living: nature & nurture, a deeper understanding of psychological aspects, relating mind to the brain, handling emotional sense with Intelligent quotient, a meta-analysis study of automation, handling the issues dealing with biasedness due to lack of optimal Hypothesis, correlating to develop ontological representations and illustrating the language of thought on empirical evidence, observational phenomena and applying technologies of Deep learning, machine learning, statistics subset to Artificial Intelligence for optimality. This comprehensive literature study navigates through the historical evolution and interdisciplinary dimensions of cognitive science, spanning from ancient Greek philosophy to its contemporary amalgamation with neuroscience, psychology, linguistics, and artificial intelligence. Examining theoretical paradigms like formal logic, rules, concepts, analogies, images, and connectionism, the study elucidates their pivotal roles in deciphering the mind's intricate representations and computations. Focused on the challenges encountered by cognitive science, the study underscores the integration of analytics, foundational concepts, and diverse methodologies such as statistical tools, machine learning, and prescriptive analytics. A Structured outlined working procedure showcases the application of cognitive science principles to enhance student performance, conducting and evaluating surveys, statistical analysis, machine learning models, and association rule mining. The methodology progresses systematically from data collection and persona analysis to prediction hypothesis formulation, mismatch analysis, marks prediction, rule-based classification, association rule mining, data analytics, and exploratory data analysis. Signifying the importance of big data, the study recommends cognitive computing concepts for intervention measures, encompassing cognitive behavioral therapy, gaming approaches, and neurological interventions, thereby contributing to the practical implementation of cognitive science in student performance analysis and intervention.

articleTitle: Precision Agriculture: Rice Leaf Disease Detection By Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Many plant diseases constitute a severe threat to the world’s food security and reduce agricultural output because it directly or indirectly impacts the quality and quantity of grains and other plant products. To determine whether a leaf is infected, farmers must watch and rely on their senses. This approach is unstable, unpredictable, and error-prone. In a variety of papers, DL techniques for diagnosing leaf diseases have been suggested. The majority of them used convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to build their models. Some models are the most effective in terms of efficiency, but they are either slow or computationally difficult, or unable to function on devices with constrained resources, such as smartphones. Using image classification, rice leaf illnesses such as Bacterial Leaf Blight (BLB), Brown Spot Rice Disease (BSR), and hispa and healthy are categorised. This paper aims to do a comprehensive study of research papers that are published in this field and evaluate their work. In our proposed work, we have taken two types of datasets: a high-resolution image dataset and a low-resolution dataset, each having the four classes mentioned above and containing approx. 3500 and 2000 images, respectively, and then trained the model first on the high-resolution dataset and then on the low-resolution dataset. It increases the accuracy of Resnet 50 from 83.49 percent to 91.64 percent and from 81.90 percent to 91.04 percent for Inception_V3.

articleTitle: A Reliable V2V Communication: An Autonomous Perspective
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The focus of the future of automobiles is the accuracy of input data provided to the driver, or sporadically, the vehicle itself. The upcoming generation of cars will have autonomous capabilities that will let them take you places without requiring any contact from a person. This, however, raises concerns about how reliable the data sent to the vehicle for autonomous driving is and whether it would result in accidents. In this work, the V2V (vehicle-to-vehicle) format for data communication between cars is investigated. The data will be analyzed based on several variables, including the topography, traffic, travel time, vehicle communication latency, and package delivery ratio, which is a dire need for the autonomous system.

articleTitle: Hybrid Feature Selection and Ensemble Classifier with Optimization for Sentiment Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: This paper presents a Hybrid Feature Selection Technique and an Ensemble Classifier with Optimization approach for Sentiment Classification in IMDB dataset. Firstly, Recursive Feature Elimination with Cross-Validation (RFECV) is employed using two classifiers: Random Forest and Logistic Regression. RFECV allows us to identify the most informative features by iteratively eliminating less relevant ones. Subsequently, the selected features from both classifiers are merged using Union set operation and further filtered based on mutual information scores to produce final feature set. The final feature set is utilized to train an ensemble model using a Voting Classifier which combines the strengths of Random Forest and Logistic Regression. The ensemble model is optimized using Bayesian Optimization, which automatically tunes hyperparameters to achieve the best performance. Experimental results showed that the Ensemble Model trained on the selected features achieves significant improvements in classification accuracy. The classification report reveals high precision, recall, and F1-score values across sentiment classes.

articleTitle: Detection of Brain Tumour using CNN in Federated Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Brain tumours are a deadly illness that kills many people. The earlier a brain tumour is detected, the better the treatment, and the longer the patient lives. Artificial intelligence (AI), which has recently emerged as a promising strategy for the early identification of cancers, is a crucial subject of research in the diagnosis of brain tumours. The implementation of brain tumour makes advantage of federated machine learning. It’s a method for building AI models without allowing anybody else to view or access your data, acting as a conduit for making data accessible to new AI applications. Federated learning, which is comparable to a group presentation or report, allows for remote data sharing by several persons in order to cooperatively and iteratively train a single deep learning model. Each participant downloads the model, which is typically a foundation model that has already been trained, from a cloud datacenter. CNN is the algorithm in use. Convolutional neural networks are a specific class of multi-layered neural networks. It evaluates data that is laid out in a grid-like pattern and then draws out important traits. The significant advantage of CNN use is that it requires less photo preprocessing. The suggested technique yields rapid and exact tumour site identification in addition to accurate tumour detection in the brain. This process has allowed us to attain 96% accuracy.

articleTitle: Prediction and Analysis of Conjunctivitis in the Human Eye Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Pink eye, commonly referred to as conjunctivitis, is a widespread eye infection that affects millions of people worldwide. Unquestionably, one of the most important organs in the human body are the eyes. They enable us to view and understand our surroundings. Yet, there are a number of disorders that can seriously impair the function of the eyes and even cause life-threatening problems. Conjunctivitis is one such illness that, if neglected, can seriously impair the eyes and general health. Vulnerable populations, such as young children, the elderly, and those with compromised immune systems, are particularly at risk from conjunctivitis. To stop its spread and the difficulties that go along with it, early detection and treatment are essential. The ability of deep learning (DL) systems to forecast different diseases has shown considerable promise. Our goal in this project is to create a conjunctivitis prediction model based on machine learning. To train and evaluate our algorithms, we will use information gathered from patients with and without conjunctivitis. In our study, we will assess how well the support vector machine (SVM), logistic regression, decision tree, random forest, and neural network (NN) perform at predicting conjunctivitis. The findings of our work will shed light on how well ML models predict conjunctivitis, and they could aid in the creation of a precise and reliable.

articleTitle: A Review on Machine Learning Techniques for Secure IOT Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) is a game-changing development of the Fourth Industrial Revolution because it paves the way for previously inconceivable levels of connectivity and collaboration amongst many types of intelligent, autonomous things. The impact of the Internet of Things on our professional, financial, and social lives seems to be considerable. The Internet of Things is allowing “smart” buildings and “smart” people to give way to “smart” communities and even “smart” planets. Yet, the massive number of interconnected devices poses a challenge to IoT network security because of the many protocols they use. The inability to improve the security of IoT devices is related to their limited computing power. Thus, novel techniques are required to safeguard IoT networks. In the field of security research, ML models have been in the forefront for the last several years. Machine learning (ML) algorithms may provide a practical solution for securing IoT infrastructure considering the massive amounts of data created daily by IoT devices. The major goal of this study is to provide a thorough review of the many studies that have been conducted about ML deployment and IoT security. We briefly covered how security holes in IoT networks might compromise the confidentiality of private data. The advantages, disadvantages, and applications of various ML methods and models on the Internet of Things were then explained. Existing IoT networks’ use of machine learning models for user security is also examined. The challenges of using ML models to secure IoT networks were also covered, since they may suggest new research directions.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning based Approach to Detect Phishing Attack
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Phishing is a well-known cybercrime that is increasing rapidly day by day. Phishing involves sending emails with suspicious links or their attachments that can accomplish a number of tasks and includes credentials or personal account information of the individual who experienced harm. These emails hurt the recipients, result in financial loss, and steal identities. Most fraudulent websites design the exact interface and universal resource locator (URL) as the legitimate websites. As anti-hacking persons are now in search for trustworthy and stable phishing detection methods in URLs. In this paper, the focus is on utilizing machine learning technology to identify phishing URLs. The approach involves analyzing a range of features present in both legitimate and phishing URLs. In order to identify phishing websites URLs, we use Decision Tree, random forest, Support vector machine and other useful machine learning algorithms. The conclusion of the studies shows that the considered methods perform more effectively in detecting suspicious URLs than more recent methods.

articleTitle: Book Recommendation System using KNN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: As the measures of online books are dramatically expanding because of Coronavirus pandemic, finding important books from an immense digital book space turns into a huge test for online clients. Individual suggestion frameworks have been arisen to direct viable hunt which mine connected books in view of client assessment and interest. The majority of the current frameworks are client base evaluations where content-based and cooperative based learning strategies are utilized. This paper proposes a powerful framework for recommending books to online customers who evaluated a book using the grouping technique and then found a similar book to recommend another [1]. The K-implies Cosine Distance capability was used in the proposed framework to measure distance and the Cosine Likeness capability was used to determine similitude between the book groups. articleTitle: Patient-mediated Health Data Exchange using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: A significant resource for advertising is medical data for the study. To improve medical research and create novel therapies for a range of medical diseases, medical data is an invaluable resource. However, the gathering and use of health data for research also raises significant ethical and legal issues, such as data privacy, security, and consent. This is because health data is typically handled by hospitals or some type of centralized data management company, which can easily sell this data to researchers without the patient’s consent and even though the patient receives no financial benefit from it and is unaware of where his or her data is being used, violating the patient’s right to privacy. No innovation now gives patients complete access to their data. As a result, this article suggests patient-mediated health data exchange, a comprehensive framework that uses blockchain-based technology to manage an individual patient’s Electronic Health Record (EHR) and offers a marketplace where a patient may simply monetize their data with their permission. The suggested framework outlines a healthcare system that aspires to make the patient the legitimate owner of data and makes it simple for researchers to get data through the market. If a patient chooses to sell their data on the open market, the data will be anonymized to preserve their privacy before being shared with researchers and will be made available to the buyer on a subscription basis. This strategy can give patients more control over their private health data and enable them to monetize it if they so want. Smart contracts are also used to uphold data-sharing agreements and guarantee that the data is only utilized for that purpose. Additionally, data will be submitted by qualified doctors during the patient’s visit, when the patient will give the doctor permission to view and amend the EHR’s health information area by giving them the key to assure data veracity. Finally, we provide an EHR that is unchangeable to demonstrate the usefulness of our solution. In addition to lowering the chance of mistakes and fraud, this can enhance data security and privacy.

articleTitle: Disease prediction using machine learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: As disease can’t be detected by the naked eye and strikes quickly when its borders are crossed, it is one of the largest difficulties. It demands a precise diagnosis at a certain time as a result. The healthcare sector generates large amounts of data each day regarding diseases and their symptoms. Nevertheless, neither academics nor professionals effectively utilise this knowledge. The medical sector is currently knowledge-poor but statistics. Machine learning techniques and technologies may efficiently extract information from databases and use this knowledge to produce more accurate diagnoses and judgements. Examining the glaringly inadequate body of work is crucial in light of the expanding body of research on disease prediction systems. This study’s major objective is to analyse the most recent findings in disease prediction research and summarise, evaluate, and draw analytical conclusions from them. The paper suggests us that the accuracy of the disease prediction system can be better if we use more appropriate algorithm like Naïve bayes, random forest, Decision tree.

articleTitle: Steganography Techniques a Review
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Steganography refers to a process employed for concealing information, with the purpose of either maintaining the secrecy of the information or making it less conspicuous. Its objective is to conceal information in such a manner that the only people who are aware of its presence are those who were responsible for embedding it. The goal of security authentication, on the other hand, is to give a verification that is unalterable, and it often entails changing the media file. In this article, we will carry out an in-depth investigation of a variety of steganographic approaches and carry out an extensive comparison and study of the efficiency of each of thoseapproaches.

articleTitle: Parts Super-Resolution Fine-Grained Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Intricate nuances and subtle visual signals that might not be clearly seen in low-resolution photos are frequently used in fine-grained image identification. This paper tries to approach the problem using super-resolution to recover finer details, such as textures, patterns, or minor differentiating traits. These details are essential for the categorization or localization of fine-grained categories. Usually, accurate localization of objects or particular regions of interest within an image is necessary, which is performed by specialised feature detection.

articleTitle: BERT: Extractive Text Summarization
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In the last ten years, the disciplines of artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data science have experienced substantial growth. Artificial Intelligence is a crucial area of research that enables us to obtain accurate and concise information through Text Summarization Techniques. This project demonstrates the practical application of extractive text summarization technique, using the BERT model. The process involves obtaining a single sentence through extractive summarization and comparing it with the human-generated summarized text. The Rouge value, which represents the Precision, Recall, and accuracy between the two summaries, is calculated.

articleTitle: Breast Cancer Detection using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Breast Cancer is the major cancer among all other type of cancer in women around the world and it is increasing day by day in most of the developing countries and the cases are diagnosed in the last stage in most cases. articleTitle: Implementation of Customer Segmentation Using Machine Learning

articleTitle: A Review on Machine Learning for Nail Diseases Prediction from Ayurvedic Perspective
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The work provides an elaboration on the primary method of illness detection within the human body, which involves analyzing nail images of human fingers and extracting data based on nail color. In the Traditional System, practitioners possessed the ability to forecast ailments by examining the condition of an individual’s nails. However, this method was characterized by a prolonged diagnostic process and yielded unsatisfactory outcomes. The purpose of this review is to provide a thorough and inclusive analysis of the present status of nail disease identification through the utilization of machine learning techniques. This paper elucidates the progress, obstacles, and prospective avenues in this pioneering and vital field of medical investigation. The detection of nail diseases has conventionally depended on the manual observations conducted by healthcare practitioners. Recent breakthroughs in the area of machine learning have brought about a significant transformation by offering automated and impartial methods for identifying problems associated to nails. This review paper provides a comprehensive examination of the research and advancements in the identification of disorders of nail through the utilization of machine learning approaches. This study investigates the diverse approaches, datasets, difficulties, and future prospects within the realm of this nascent discipline.

articleTitle: Automating Dermatological Diagnosis - A Comparative Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Evolving and adapting healthcare along with growing technology is an urgent need of an hour using machine learning is an addition to classify health data for the large aspect of identifying dermatological illness. Convolution Neural Network (CNN) can accurately classify a variety of skin illnesses by extracting complex information from images. CNN do away with the requirement for manual feature engineering because they are able to learn from large amounts of data. They are resistant to noise and changes in lighting, ensuring accurate analysis every time. CNN help in early detection, increasing the efficacy of treatment, and lowering the possibility of a false positive. Their combination has the potential to greatly improve patient care and change dermatological procedures. Objective: The goal of this study is to determine the best effective algorithm, whether it comes from deep learning or machine learning, based on a thorough comparative analysis that considers elements like accuracy, interpret ability, and scalability. Methodology: This study uses a comparative analysis methodology to decide which machine learning and deep learning algorithms are the most effective. It entails a review of the literature, the gathering of data, the design and execution of experiments, statistical analysis, and result interpretation. Findings: This study’s findings shows that deep learning approaches are more effective than machine learning ones. In contrast to machine learning, which depends on manual, subjective techniques, deep learning allows for automatic and objective feature extraction. Deep learning achieves greater prediction accuracy and generalization ability despite requiring more training time and computational resources, demonstrating its superior learning powers.

articleTitle: Machine learning for detecting fake news
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: With the development of communication technologies and social media, the fake news phenomena is expanding quickly. A new field of research that is receiving a lot of attention is fake news detection. Due to the restricted resources, including datasets, processing, and analysis methods, it does, nevertheless, confront some difficulties. In this paper, we presented a mode for identifying bogus news based on machine learning. We used Support Vector Machine (SVM) as a classifier and term frequency-inverse document frequency (TF-IDF) of a set of words and n-grams as a feature extraction approach. We also propose a dataset of authentic and fake news for the training of the proposed system. The outcomes show how efficient the system is.

Author Keywords: TF-IDF are all used in fake news

articleTitle: Heart Disease Prediction Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Due to the increase in the lavish lifestyle of people. The comfort and its by products are also increasing. Comfort do give a sense of pleasant lifestyle but in the long run, it results in something negative. As the lifestyle of the human being is changing be it in relaxing domain or the eating habits domain. Not eating regular healthy foods and eating junk directly affects the organ of our body, in this case heart is what we will discuss. We are trying to develop an algorithm in the machine learning domain which will help to detect any disease if there is in the heart due to any of the unfavorable reason. Our model will try to compare an unhealthy heart cell with a healthy heart cell and it will try to differ in both. If the model finds that the cells of the particular heart is not favorable as compared to a healthy heart then it will give us the report accordingly. Data Collection and Preprocessing One of the key challenges in heart disease prediction using ML is the availability and quality of data. Typically, datasets include various demographic, lifestyle, and medical factors such as sex, age, smoker or not, different aspects of heart like family history etc. To ensure accurate predictions, it is important to preprocess the data, which involves cleaning, normalization, and feature selection. This helps to eliminate outliers, reduce noise, and identify the most relevant features for the prediction model. Algorithm Selection and Training Once the data is pre-processed, we move forward to selecting ML different algorithms for the prediction task. Commonly used algorithms include decision trees, random forests, logistic regression, and support vector machines. The selected algorithm is then trained on a portion of the dataset, with the remaining data used for testing and validation. The performance of the algorithm is evaluated based on metrics just like the accuracy, precision.

articleTitle: Image Classification using CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Binary neural networks and mobile networks are the most often used approaches for sophisticated deep learning models to carry out a variety of tasks on embedded devices. The deep learning pre-trained model Mobile Net for Single Shot Multi box Detector (SSD) is used in this research work to provide a method for item identification. This approach is used for real-time detection and to find objects in webcam video streams. By employing new phrase patterns and rephra sing the original material without changing its content, our method prevents plagiarism. To develop a quick and effective deep learning-based system for object identification, we combined the Mobile Net with the SSD framework. Increasing the object detecting system’s accuracy is our top priority. Our main objective is to improve the object identification system SSD’s accuracy by utilizing the advantages of the already trained deep learning model Mobile Net. Our tests show that, for items like cars, humans, and cats, respectively, our algorithm obta ins an Average Precision (AP) of $ 97.45\%,\ 95.67\%$, and $ 85.59\%$. The improvement in accuracy is essential for both indoor and outdoor real-time detection and monitoring. In order to avoid plagiarism, our work has been rewritten while maintaining its original meaning. When considering neuronal activity and the strength of the connections between each pair of neurons, a feed-forward neural network, or FFNN, may be thought of.

articleTitle: Drinking Water Quality Prediction using Different Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Water must be tested before drinking. If Water Quality (WQ) is poor then it can lead to serious health problems. 3,575,000 people die annually around the globe because of water diseases. Mostly children (Approx. 2.2 million) are affected due to this [1]. Some major diseases caused by drinking contaminated water are typhoid, dysentery, cholera, diarrhea and polio [2]. To avoid the death of these innocent lives we must check the standard of the water. Water Quality(WQ) not only depends on pH but there are others factors also which impact the standard of the water, like hardness of the water, solid particles, chloramines, sulfate, organic carbon, turbidity, trihalomethane, conductivity, etc. In this paper we have made a Machine Learning (ML) model to check whether the water is fit for drinking or not. We have used various algorithms to predict the suitability of the water like Decision Tree(DT), Random Forest Algorithm(RFA), Support Vector Machine, Logistic Regression, K – nearest neighbour(KNN) Algorithm, XGBoost algorithm, Ada Boost Algorithm. By using these algorithms we will find the quality of the water and then by comparing the results of all algorithms the best result is considered.

articleTitle: FAG-Net: Feature Attention Generative Network for Single Image Dehazing
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Image dehazing remains an open challenge in computer vision. In this paper, we proposed a new feature attention generative network (FAG-Net) for image dehazing. We also proposed a new generator architecture which consists of a dense block, a transition block and a new feature attention (FA) block at each layer which enhance the realistic nature of the haze-free image. FA block consists one channel attention (CA) block and one pixel attention (PA) block. Channel attention aims to enhance the relevant information in different color channels of the input image, while pixel attention aims to selectively emphasize or suppress certain pixels in the image, which helps the models to concentrate on the most affected areas of an image by haze. Perceptual loss and reconstruction loss are used along with adversarial loss to give more attention to the pixel which contains more haze and to maintain the realistic nature of the generated haze-free image. Our FAG-Net is trained on O-HAZE, I-HAZE and RESIDE (ITS) datasets to conduct the experimental analysis. Extensive experimental study demonstrates that our FAG-Net outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis using SVM, Naïve Bayes, and LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Many websites such as Twitter, blogs, and ecommerce sites are popular nowadays, which display a tremendous amount of information about various topics, such as reviews and discussions on events. To manually try to understand the essential opinion regarding something is very time-consuming. Opinion mining or sentiment analysis is used, which automatically analyzes text using machine learning approaches and tries to give the idea of people’s sentiments regarding a topic or product. Nykaa is one of the leading online shopping websites, where a large amount of information is available. The paper uses sentiment analysis on the Nykaa dataset, where we train the machine to generate the ability to define the overall opinion about a particular context, such as negative or positive. The input data undergoes pre-processing before being transformed into a vector space, as machines only understand numbers, not text, using sentiment scores. Then machine learning algorithms like SVM, Naïve Bayes, and LSTM are applied, and results are evaluated and compared where LSTM performs better.

articleTitle: Automated Attendance Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: the manual process of recording and managing attendance in educational institutions and organizations is often time-consuming, prone to errors, and inefficient. To address these challenges, there is a growing need for automated attendance management systems. This research paper presents the design and implementation of an Automated Attendance Management System (AAMS) using modern technologies. The AAMS utilizes various technologies such as biometric recognition, RFID (Radio Frequency Identification), and computer vision to accurately and efficiently track attendance. The system aims to simplify the attendance recording process for both students and instructors, reduce administrative burden, and improve overall efficiency. The proposed AAMS incorporates biometric recognition techniques, such as fingerprint scanning or facial recognition, to identify and verify the identity of individuals.

articleTitle: Evidence Collection Application
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The objective is to create an application that makes it easier for citizens to expose Bribery. The program is based on the idea that any electronic device can be utilized to acquire evidence, such as cell phones, tablets, smartwatches, and so on. articleTitle: Hands Sign Language and Gesture Recognition Using CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: One of the non-verbal communication techniques utilised in sign language is the hand gesture. People with speech or hearing impairments use it most frequently to converse with one another and with nondisabled persons. Several makers around the world have created various sign language systems, but they are neither adaptable nor cost-effective for end users. So, the “Hand sign and gesture recognition system software” presented in this proposal offers a system prototype that can automatically understand sign language to aid deaf and dumb individuals in communicating with each other and other people more efficiently. This system can also be used in platforms like “YouTube” videos where there is currently no feature for auto-text generation on the basic of gestures and sign languages. Research on gesture recognition is still in its early stages. Hand gestures play a crucial role in nonverbal communication and are essential to daily living. The software aims to present a real-time system for hand gesture and sign recognition on the basis of detection of some shape-based features like orientation, Center of Mass centroid, fingers status, and thumb in positions of raised or folded fingers of hand, although these feature extraction part will be totally resolved by Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). For the purpose user has used ISL(Indian Sign Language) for case study. The back projection histogram approach was employed in this model to set the image’s histogram. For training and testing, used CNNs and as a result, the test accuracy was 99.89%. This model’s independence from external hardware or devices is one of its benefits.

articleTitle: Secure File Sharing System Using Big Data in the Cloud
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: With the use of Cloud Technology, Big Data and its visualization now become an essential elements of information technology. Over the past few decades, protecting sensitive data from hackers has been a struggle. To preserve the data,numerous researchers created technologies and approaches. In this paper, new solution to create and secure data is categorized into structured, semi-structured, and unstructured forms. As all traditional technologies are only relevant to structured data. In this paper, we examined numerous security and privacy techniques that have been put out by different researchers and analyzed that using MongoDB and cloud-based securities, problems like data breaches and other security measures can be resolved. It is expensive to store data on servers and then retrieve it again, only paying customers are eligible to use it. As a result, this research will lower the cost of data retrieval and storage, that will be advantageous to regular consumers. This survey reveals that while such websites exist, they are not practical or accessible to regular consumers. Therefore, we have identified this significant flaw and are working to develop a solution. In addition to security and dependability, the system is built on secure data retrieval. The key characteristic is the necessity of a key for each user to receive data from the system, that raises security level.The main idea of this file-sharing application is to provide an online platform where documents, images, or other data can be shared without any size limitation.
