There are various platforms like Gmail, WhatsApp, etc where files having large sizes cannot be sent. There are no such limitations in this app user can easily upload files up to 1GB, and also they do not have to use personal drives like Google Drive, or Dropbox as the data get stored on public storage. This paper also overcomes the problem of unnecessary data gathering in the backend so that the data storing process can get optimized.

articleTitle: A Systematic Survey of Recommendation Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Recommendation systems are like intelligent filters which process a huge amount of information with respect to the preferences of the user and then provide suggestions to them in the form of recommendations such as recommending movies to watch, items to purchase on an e-commerce store, places to visit, etc. These systems use a variety of algorithms which can be broadly divided into content-based filtering algorithms and collaboration-filtering-based algorithms. Another category of hybrid algorithms has also come up that combines the benefits of content-based and collaborative-filtering-based algorithms. This survey paper is intended to critically analyze various methods of recommendation systems. The phases of a recommendation system, various algorithms used in recommendation systems such as content-based filtering, collaborative filtering, hybrid techniques, etc. as well as their benefits, their challenges, their use-cases, and metrics used to compare various algorithms have been discussed. Also, an experimental analysis has been performed to compare various recommendation algorithms on a dataset to do a comparative analysis of their performance.

articleTitle: Nature Prognosis and CV Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The introduction of the Job Characteristics Model appeared to be useful and to create new possibilities human resource management is built around the concept of current job design. The human resource management has been led in the proper direction and is made more applicable because of advancements in digital technologies, information systems, electronic technology and the accessibility of the internet. In order to provide a new template for an effective HR management solution in the Internet Age, the proposed system aims to build a strategy for integrating the model of Job characteristics into the E-HR system. Whenever there is an apparent increase in employment searchers but a drop in the total of open positions, it is challenging to manually choose the ideal applicant for an appropriate job by reviewing the CV. Here, the suggested system aids in hiring the best candidates by analyzing the information contained in resume and administering personality quizzes. The model that will analyze the data is constructed using logistic regression. It also makes use of Pyresparser to extract data out of a resume. In this approach, the model aids in identifying the personality and other information about the candidate, such as their qualifications and background. Organizations can use this approach to locate qualified candidates and streamline the job of the hiring team consideration

articleTitle: A Review on Wearable Antennas
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Wearable antennas plays a major role in Body Area Networks (BAN). WBAN agrees the users to sense, analyse and communicate data to a connected server with the help of modern technologies. The power consumption and the miniaturized size antenna, as major consideration for a wearable device. The majority of wearable antennas are built into the user’s clothing or, in rare circumstances, under their skin. This paper’s goal is to examine the technological foundations for wearable antenna design and its applicability in diverse industries. The report also identifies the research need in the area of wearable antenna design.

articleTitle: Face Recognition Based Attendance System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In today’s corporate world, recording attendance is a crucial aspect for monitoring an individual’s presence within a company. Traditionally, attendance has been manually tracked through signatures or individual acknowledgments. However, in the digital age, there is a need for a more efficient and time-effective solution. One such solution is the implementation of face recognition technology, which utilizes various algorithms, including machine learning and deep learning, to analyze and capture facial images. By leveraging these algorithms, the system can accurately identify individuals and automate the attendance recording process, leading to enhanced efficiency.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Free Space Optical Link for Multi Impairments
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Free space optics (FSO) is viewed as a promising contender to enhance and combine with next-generation technologies like 5 G networks. FSO uses light signals to travel through free space. Light signals are modulated by the data signal. Although FSO have numerous benefits but it is adversely affected by weather conditions. This paper presents a brief review on FSO system and the attenuation in response to wavelength and range fluctuations. Effectiveness of FSO has been evaluated under different weather situations like fog, clouds, and rain.

articleTitle: Android Malware Detection based on Feature-pair Bonding: A Hybrid Detection Model
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Android has emerged as the dominant operating system over the past decade, enjoying widespread usage. However, its popularity has also made it an attractive target for malware proliferation. One reason behind this vulnerability is Android’s acceptance of app installations from unauthorized sources, which gives a window to malicious code writers to disseminate applications malicious in nature which in turn compromise the Android device. To tackle this issue, much research in the literature tried to develop malware analysis and detection systems that employ both static and dynamic analysis techniques. These approaches aim to identify and mitigate malware threats. However, existing research in this field still faces challenges in terms of efficiently and accurately detecting malware. Moreover, achieving accurate malware detection often requires significant resources, which can be a concern on resource-limited mobile devices. Despite advancements, the current state of research struggles to strike a balance between detection accuracy and resource utilization, particularly in the context of mobile devices with limited capabilities. In the current research paper, we present a new methodology for constructing a hybrid malware detection model that operates independently without relying on a pre-existing Machine Learning classifier. Our proposed model operates by leveraging the concept of feature-pairs, where pairs of features that exhibit strong correlations are identified. By calculating the feature-pair scores, we determine whether an application is benign or malicious based on these scores. This self-sufficient model eliminates the need for an external classifier, offering a unique approach to malware detection.

articleTitle: Navigating the Sentiment Analysis Landscape: Methodologies and Use Cases in Social Media Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Sentiment analysis has grown in popularity as a tool for businesses to classify customer perceptions of their goods, services, or viewpoints. However, it can also be used to locate extremist groups who promote terrorism on websites like Twitter. Using Twitter data connected to the spread of terrorism, we study and compare various algorithms for sentiment analysis in this review paper. The advantages, methodologies, and limitation of each algorithm will be covered in the paper. The benefits of integrating emoticons in the sentiment analysis process will also be emphasised. Emoticons can offer insightful data that can help increase categorization accuracy. The classification of emotions or sentiments may yield better results if emoticons are incorporated into the opinion mining process. Additionally, it is possible to track such groups by including login and location data. The overall goal of this review paper is to give a general overview of several sentiment analysis algorithms for Twitter data relevant to the spread of terrorism as well as the benefits of incorporating emoticons into the sentiment analysis process.

articleTitle: Hand Gesture Controlled Whiteboard Using OpenCv
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The study introduces the so-called Virtual Whiteboard, which might be a viable alternative to existing electronic whiteboards that use electronic pens and sensors. The program allows the user to write, draw, and manipulate whiteboard contents just with his or her hands. There is no need for extra equipment such as infrared diodes, infrared cameras, or cyber gloves. Dynamic hand gesture recognition is used to interact with the Virtual Whiteboard computer program. In the process of analysing video stream collected from a webcam connected with a multimedia projector displaying whiteboard information, gestures are identified. The results of system efficiency testing are also. It will allow user to draw freely on a canvas. Must have ability to erase entire canvas with erase button and a toggle button for brush size to draw with. whiteboard apps will allow for load/ save on drawings, move/ edit of drawing elements, grid snapping, alignment and distribution, copy/paste, free-hand and line drawing, text (with fonts and sizes) so there’s a lot you can do.

articleTitle: Impact Of Virtual Reality In Education
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Virtual reality as a teaching tool has become prominent in recent years. It offers a practical component that is necessary for preparing students for the business setting. Simply learning facts can be boring for students, which is where virtual reality comes in to help them develop the appropriate skills to become experts. This has a purpose to analyze the impact of virtual reality on contemporary education. The study employed both theoretical and quantitative approaches to understand the effects of virtual reality in the educational field. According to the research, employing virtual reality can be quite beneficial for pupils who require special education services and facilitates skill acquisition. Moreover, virtual reality helps students feel more confident in their abilities, which can lead to better learning outcomes [1]

articleTitle: Object Detection Using SSD
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Object identification in computer vision is a crucial task with applications in many areas, including robotics, surveillance, and self-driving cars. Deep learning architecture called Single Shot Multibox Detector (SSD) has shown to be effective for computer vision tasks. An SSD is a type of neural network-based object detection technique. The bounding boxes and class labels of the items in a picture are predicted using a single convolutional neural network (CNN). This paper presents a thorough analysis of SSD-based object detection, including its architecture, training procedure, and assessment metrics. We also talk about how the SSD framework may be expanded and modified to perform better on diverse datasets. Our results show that SSD is an effective and efficient object detection algorithm with excellent performance on several benchmark datasets.

articleTitle: Early Diabetic Retinopathy Detection using Data Augmentation Techniques and DenseNet - 121
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: A medical condition that affects the eyes and is often associated with diabetes is known as Diabetic Retinopathy. It may lead to surgery and can cause blindness. The success of the treatment depends on the early detection of the disease. The correct identification of the retinopathy stage, however, is challenging and necessitates competent human interpretation of human fundus pictures. Therefore, in this research paper, we propose a new detection mechanism that can effectively and efficiently detect the 4 stages of retinopathy. To implement this, we considered the fundus images dataset available on the Kaggle website. Moreover, our approach involves Ben Graham’s preprocessing and modern data augmentation techniques. Furthermore, we employ the DenseNet-121 model, a hybrid artificial neural network (ANN) and convolutional neural network (CNN) architecture, for the classification of the four stages of retinopathy. As a result, we were able to surpass the current state-of-the-art with an accuracy of 99.04%, a quadratic weighted kappa of 0.922, and a macro-average specificity of 0.9496.

articleTitle: Semantic Segmentation Of Medical Images Using CNN : (Chest X-Rays)
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Semantic segmentation plays a crucial role in the accurate detection of diseases in medical imaging. In this research, we focused on the application of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for semantic segmentation of chest X-ray images. Using the NIH chest X-ray dataset, consisting of 13 distinct diseases, we trained and tested various pre-existing CNN models including VGG19, NasNet-Mobile, DenseNet121, MobileNetV2, ResNet50V2, EfficientNetB0, and InceptionV3. A subset of 1000 and 10,000 images were used for training, while 100 and 1000 images were reserved for testing to assess the accuracy of disease detection. Our experimental results revealed varying performance across the different CNN models. Overall, DenseNet 121 demonstrated the highest accuracy in disease detection, closely followed by EfficientNetB0 and InceptionV3. These models showcased promising capabilities for semantic segmentation, while others showed comparatively lower accuracy. The findings underscore the potential of deep learning and CNN models in improving disease detection in chest X-rays. The outcomes of this research contribute to the growing body of knowledge on semantic segmentation in medical image analysis. They provide valuable insights into the strengths and weaknesses of different CNN models for detecting a wide range of chest X-ray abnormalities. The results have implications for clinical practice, as accurate disease detection can facilitate early diagnosis and effective treatment planning. Future research efforts can focus on refining and optimizing CNN architectures for improved disease detection accuracy in chest X-ray analysis.

Author Keywords: National Institutes Of Health(NIH) true positive (TP)

articleTitle: A Teacher-Student Framework For Training Audio Spectrogram Transformer To Classify Lung Diseases Using Respiratory Sounds
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In this study, we explore the potential of utilizing transformers in a limited data setting. We propose a teacher-student framework to train transformers for classifying lung diseases using respiratory sounds. Our proposed framework combines the attributes of both Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Transformer i.e., the translation equivariance and inductive biases of CNNs with the ability of transformers to handle long range dependencies. We have used Wavegram- Logmel-CNN as the teacher and Audio Spectrogram Transformer (AST) as the student model. The results show that our proposed framework improves the accuracy of the Transformer model. We also discuss the future scope for further improvements.

articleTitle: Identification of novel biomarkers in Glioblastoma multiforme therapeutic through explainable artificial intelligence (XAI)
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Glioblastoma multiforme (GBM) is a multifactorial disease with a low survival rate and poor prognosis. Currently, standard treatment, such as surgical resection, chemotherapy, and radiation therapy. However, there is a growing need for novel biomarkers and drugs to enhance the survival rate. Machine learning (ML) algorithms, namely XGBoost and others lead to the identification of novel biomarkers that lead to increase the survival rate. In this work, I applied XGBoost binary classification with SHAP on GBM dataset through Python to identify biomarkers in GBM etiology. Afterwards, I validated the expression of novel biomarkers and performed functional enrichment analysis to extract the post-transcriptional regulators of novel biomarkers through ML-based online tool.

articleTitle: Literature Review: Metamaterials in RF and Microwave Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: A metamaterial is a structure that has been artificially created and has negative refractive index properties that are not present in nature or are difficult to achieve. This property makes the Metamaterials as very popular in the microwave to optical research areas. Now a days many researchers focusing metamaterials to improve the performance of antennas or antenna arrays like improving antenna gain, bandwidth, compactness, etc. Also, metamaterials play major role on developing the novel optical devices for new applications like optical super lenses, perfect absorber, invisible cloaks, etc. This paper focusses the properties of metamaterial, metamaterial structure and the metamaterial applications in RF and microwave areas.

articleTitle: Performance Investigation of Radio over Free Space Optics under Fog Weather Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The radio over free space optics (Ro-FSO) system is an emerging technology that eliminates the requirement for fiber cables. As the communication is point to point through light pulses, lesser hardware expenses are required. The channel can be atmosphere, vacuum, or air, and its properties determine the transmission characteristics for propagation of optical signals for reliable transmission. Different information channels are transmitted via free space, thus allowing optical connectivity. It may provide fast-growing broadband services at data rates which is faster in comparison to optical fibre reaching up to hundreds of Gbit/s. Although, the transmission may face difficulties due to atmospheric effects such as attenuation, turbulence and scattering effects, communication may be achieved with an acceptable bit error rate (BER) for a given transmission range. In this paper we predict the quality of transmission of Ro-FSO link by incorporating quadrature amplitude modulation (QAM) under real-time fog weather conditions and other factors that contribute to the attenuation and absorption.

articleTitle: Web Development Using ReactJS
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In recent years, there have been considerable developments in web development, and ReactJS has become a potent tool for creating effective and engaging web apps. This abstract offers a succinct synopsis of the study’s research paper on ReactJS-based web development. [1] The purpose of the study article is to examine ReactJS’s main characteristics, benefits, and potential uses in web development. It explores subjects including ReactJS’ component-based architecture, virtual DOM, reconciliation method, and advantages of React Hooks. The paper also covers ReactJS’s support for server-side rendering and its interoperability with the creation of mobile apps using React Native [14]. The research paper also emphasises the benefits of adopting ReactJS in online development, including better performance with the virtual DOM, reusable code, increased user interface creation, and SEO friendly web applications. As well investigates the strong ReactJS ecosystem and developer support available. The construction of a real-time chat application and a data visualisation dashboard are showcased as case studies in the article to explain the practical applications of ReactJS. Additionally, it contrasts ReactJS with two other well-known web development frameworks, Angular and Vue.js, in order to assist readers, grasp the unique qualities and applications of each framework.

articleTitle: Stock Price Prediction using LSTM and Sentiment Analysis on Tweets
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: This research paper aims to explore various methods for effectively predicting stock prices, as accurate prediction systems can provide valuable insights for traders regarding future trends. While traditional methods such as artificial neural networks, regression, and SVM have been used by researchers to solve this problem, this paper proposes a novel approach for forecasting stock market prices. Specifically, the study employs machine learning architectures, Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Sentiment Analysis, and a hybrid approach combining both methods for price forecasting and comparing the performance of various listed companies.

articleTitle: Use of Artificial Intelligence in Voice Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) allows machine systems to act like human intelligence, permitting them to learn from data and make decisions based on analysis. the technology known as voice recognition, which translates spoken words into text or other formats that are desired. First, voice signals are recorded using audio input devices. Then, pre-processing is done to remove unnecessary information and background noise. Next, feature extraction converts the pre-processed signals into a set of features for recognition. Acoustic modeling involves creating statistical models mapping these features to phonetic units, often utilizing Hidden Markov Models. Language modeling constructs statistical models of spoken language to aid in recognizing words and phrases in context. Decoding matches the acoustic and language models to identify spoken words or phrases. Finally, recognized words or phrases are outputted in the desired format. The accuracy of the system hinges on the quality of audio input, effectiveness of pre-processing, accuracy of models, and system optimization.

Author Keywords: Hidden Markov Models and Statistical models.

articleTitle: Advance Approaches Towards Invariant Face Recognition: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Identity verification of an individual is a principal task associated with recognition systems. These tasks are accomplished using biostatistics analysis of an individual’s distinct features. Face Recognition poses as a solution for the above task but it concedes with its own challenges. As face is a constantly changing attribute of a person as it changes with age and its acclimatization makes it difficult to be captured in the same fixing each time. In this paper, we try to summarize various techniques which are developed to overcome these challenges and their progression towards tackling emerging problems associated with facial recognition.

articleTitle: The development of a new edge computing device based on deep learning YOLOv8 algorithm for diabetic retinopathy Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Diabetic retinopathy is a prevalent eye disorder that occurs in individuals with diabetes. The condition is caused by damage to the retinal blood vessels caused by elevated blood sugar levels. The retina is the tissue behind the eye that is sensitive to light. Among the leading causes of blindness worldwide is diabetic retinopathy. However, early detection and prompt treatment can effectively prevent or minimize vision loss. Deep learning algorithms, such as “You Only Look Once” (YOLO) Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), have demonstrated state-of-the-art performance on benchmark datasets and computer vision competitions. YOLO is a single end-to-end model that enables real-time object identification with high accuracy. Our proposed YOLOv8-based model integrated with Jetson Nano Developer Kit with CSI camera module shows the highest top1 accuracy of 93.77 on the training dataset and validation dataset with all given classes its measured accuracy top1 accuracy is 72.6 with 2.6ms inference time.

articleTitle: Digitising Land Acquisition in India
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: For support, a great level of scalability is needed to support the real world and practical use case when it comes to the land acquisition system. For every individual, land acquisition is a major decision as land acquisition is a type of thing that needs a lot of research and effort on the part of the individual and land is getting expensive day by day in our modern day and age. Due to this our conventional method of land acquisition is not enough to ensure data integrity and transparency at the same time. To solve these issues this paper purposes blockchain technology but still, the blockchain approach has encountered some of the issues for which this paper proposed the nested blockchain framework which is used to optimize the storage and scalability issues in the normal blockchain approach.

articleTitle: Exploratory and statistical data analysis of Indian economy
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Exploratory Data Analysis provides visual exploration of data and also allows for the identification of trends and relationships between variables. The aim of this research is to study about different factors involved in the economy of India. The dataset has been collected from year 1960 to 2020 and is analyzed by looking at the factors such as GDP, import and export value of goods and services, total reserves(include gold, current US Dollar) and health status of nation’s citizens. Thus, it suggests that all factors are important for a stable economy and it also provides different ways to improve these factors.

articleTitle: Virtual Reality Therapy for Chronic Pain Treatment
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Managing and reducing pain is essential for survival because it is a warning signal informing people of possible danger. With certain restrictions, several approaches, such as drugs, physical therapy, and alternative therapies, have been established. An advancement in pain management is Virtual Reality (VR), which simulates a world and offers an engaging and participatory experience. Many experts think VR offers potential as a diversion tool. It is becoming more widely accepted as a technique to assist patients in managing discomfort caused by medical procedures or illnesses, even if its effectiveness has not been scientifically tested. The possibility of employing VR as a pain treatment aid is getting increasingly exciting as por table VR devices become more reasonably priced and of greater quality. But for VR to become broad. This research involves various study designs and collecting patient reports and data to develop customized interventions for different patient groups. By doing so, a team can better understand the usefulness of VR as a chronic pain treatment/management tool and improve patient outcomes.

Author Keywords: PICO (Patient or Population Intervention Comparison and Outcome)

articleTitle: Execution of Reconfiguration System on Chip Design for Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: To address the demand for additional resources on the DPR stands for dynamic partial reconfiguration and field programmable gate array. was introduced. PDR can alter the system’s efficiency and functioning to make room for additional hardware modules, reduce power consumption, and conserve fabric area. PDR entails designing modules that are self-contained and able to be sequentially loaded in the same fabric region. The authors of this work modify a small portion of the FPGA at runtime to add new functionality, leaving the other portions of the device unchanged. A tool developed by XILINX called PLANAHEAD, which can construct systems that are changeable for every VIRTEX field programmable gate array during runtime, can help simplify the complications of this process. The first graphical environment for partial reconfiguration, PLANAHEAD offers the freedom to adapt a design in the field, save power consumption, and save board area.

articleTitle: Analysis of Key loggers in Cybersecurity
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The project referred to as “Key Logger System” involves the process of recording keystrokes on a keyboard, often surreptitiously, without the knowledge of the user. This process is known as keystroke logging, also referred to as key logging or keyboard capturing. The person running the logging program can then access the captured information, which is often used to obtain passwords and other sensitive data. Even Microsoft has included a feature in the latest version of Windows 10 that explicitly allows for certain types of key logging, in order to enhance its predictive capabilities. Therefore, utilizing this software can provide additional benefits.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Approach to Emotion Recognition by Facial Expressions: A Review Paper
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Emotion recognition by facial expression is a challenging task that has gotten much attention in recent years. Deep neural networks are used to extract pertinent information from facial photographs and categorise them into various emotional categories in deep learning approaches, which have proven their potential in this area The article examines the most recent advances in deep learning for recognising emotions from facial expressions. The model architecture and training methods are explored, and their effectiveness on benchmark datasets is assessed. Also discuss the challenges and prospects for this field, including the need for large and diverse datasets, the interpretability of models, and the requirement to eliminate any bias in training data. Overall, deep learning algorithms for emotion recognition using facial expressions have shown considerable promise and can be applied in a variety of applications, such as virtual assistants, entertainment, and healthcare.

articleTitle: Blockchain Technology: A new way to Secure Voter Anonymity
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Blockchain technology is an emerging technology that has been widely used in the field of voting systems. In this paper, we propose a blockchain-based voting system for electronic voting. The proposed voting system provides a scalable, trustworthy, and reachable way to guarantee the integrity of democratic voting by utilizing the most recent blockchain technology. Moreover, a chain security mechanism is used to strengthen the security of voting transactions. Finally, the proposed system presents a viable solution to the problems that both traditional and electronic voting systems face. Blockchain technology offers several advantages for voting systems, but it also presents several challenges and limitations that need to be carefully considered and addressed to ensure the success of blockchain technology for boosting the security and transparency of the voting system. The implementation of voting methods based on blockchain technology can aid in safeguarding voters' privacy, preventing fraud, and promoting free and fair elections by using the technology's distinctive properties, such as encryption mechanisms and a decentralized network of computers. It also has substantial advantages, including the chance to modernize democracy and boost voter trust in the political process.

articleTitle: Sentimental Analysis Using Twitter Data Using LSTM, CNN and Extra Tree Classifier Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Twitter can be said as a Microblogging. One of the most popular microblogging computer sites. Tweets of Twitter can be considered as emotion of users, this is the reason why it is the easiest ways of poignant study. Sentiment analysis can be stated as the process of analysing different opinions and classifying them in types. Opinions are broadly distributed in four groups: neutral, constructive, unhealthy, undesirable. Basically, information mining is used to find pertinent information from websites, particularly from social networking websites. Using an approach that combines several disciplines, such as text mining, human language processing, and device intelligence. This study mainly has highlights that how the tweets are stated emotionally, according to info congregated through Twitter. Earlier the Researchers used device mastering procedures that were already in place aimed at sentimentality assessment, unfortunately it came to know that the outcomes of these methods were not successful in providing superior sentiment category results. As a result, improving them finally lead to sentiment evaluation, where we tend to use collective mechanism knowledge methods to increase the effectiveness and quality of the projected strategy. Tentative fallouts proves that proposed technique offers higher type outcomes in terms of accurateness compared to character classifier.

articleTitle: Exploring the Effectiveness of different abstractive text summarization models – A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In the past ten years, advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data science have been significant. These businesses, which include transportation, banking, healthcare, and others, have shown tremendous potential in these sectors. One area where AI and ML have made significant development is Natural Language interpreting (NLP), which includes machines interpreting and comprehending human language. One NLP application that uses machines to summarize massive amounts of text into shorter, more succinct summaries is text summarization. This study illustrates a straightforward yet efficient use of the abstractive text summarizing methodology. To show the abstractive text summarizing method, we will employ GPT-2, BART, T5, and PEGASUS on the CNN/Dailymail, Xsum, and MultiNews Datasets and examine each algorithm’s performance separately.

articleTitle: Music Sharing and Streaming Application using Django and Python
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The society we live in is sometimes referred to as "the busy world" since we witness people constantly rushing to their companies, schools, and universities. The only cure for such hectic schedules and exhausting days is Music! People used to have to buy/download tracks from a few websites and listen to them on the device that they had downloaded them on in order to enjoy music. Thankfully, we now have a plethora of music player apps that allow us to listen to a selection of over millions of songs. However, there is a cost, and we do not have the flexibility to download them into our devices in order to stream our tunes without going online.

articleTitle: Enhanced IoT-Based Weather Forecasting and Field Monitoring System Utilizing Multiple CNN Classification Models
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The rapid development of the Internet of Things (IoT) has revolutionized various domains, including weather forecasting and field monitoring. This research paper presents a novel approach to weather forecasting and field monitoring by leveraging the power of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) in an IoT-based system. The proposed system collects real-time weather data from multiple IoT sensors deployed in different geographical locations. These sensor nodes capture various meteorological parameters, such as temperature, humidity, wind speed, and precipitation. The collected data is then transmitted to a central server for analysis and prediction using various CNN models trained on historical weather data. The system’s architecture integrates the CNN models with the IoT infrastructure, enabling accurate weather forecasting and efficient field monitoring. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed system, showcasing its ability to predict weather patterns with high accuracy and provide timely information for field monitoring activities.

articleTitle: Facial Emotion Recognition System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The current face expression Stages, Methods, and Reconnaissance Data Sets are described in this document (CER). The scenarios are being used to evaluate the viability of implementing emotional recognition. It also underlines the problems. Humans may perform hundreds of different facial expressions during conversation, varying in difficulty, complexity, and importance. This article examines the shortcomings of the current approach for recognizing emotions via brain activity. In this document use my existing simulator. The system has been made with a new one at the conclusion of the document Comparisons of Identifying Human Emotions.

articleTitle: A Review of Attendance by Facerecognition
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Face recognition software is used to match computer images to human faces. Face recognition is one of the most useful image-processing applications, and it is crucial in the technological world. For verification purposes, the recognition of a human face is a hot topic, notably in the context of school attendance. In a face recognition-based attendance system, children are recognized using face biostatistics based on high-definition surveillance and other computer technologies. In this project, we will learn how to perform high-accuracy facial recognition. We’ll start by reviewing the theory and learning how to apply it. Then we’ll develop an Attendance project that uses a webcam to recognize faces and record attendance in an excel sheet automatically. The proposed concept intends to automate attendance in a variety of businesses. Face recognition can be accomplished using a variety of methods. Face identification, face encoding, CNN and face comparison are just a few of the strategies the programme employs to do its responsibilities. Together, these algorithms can successfully recognize students. And will perform the task on a large database and record the attendance in Excel Sheet with the student’s name, time, and date along with their attendance. The facial recognition attendance system has proven to be effective in various settings and variations. However, there is room for improvement in the future as it sometimes struggles to recognize students from a distance. Additionally, there may be processing limitations, and the use of a high-processing system could potentially improve the accuracy and performance of the system..

articleTitle: Arduino Based Smart Cart
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Weekends and holidays generally bring a big rush, especially in the major cities. Markets are busier when there are great offers and discounts. In shopping centers, we typically receive a trolley into which we place all the products we plan to buy from various shelves. After placing everything in the cart, we proceed to the desk for billing, where there are huge lines. This project offers an answer to these lengthy lines. The carts is equipped with a barcode reader and an LCD screen to execute this. When we place the item in the carts, the barcode on the product is automatically detected, and a screen will reveal the item’s details. In this manner, the item’s cost is added to the bill. By using this method, the trolley will do all the bills by itself, and the issue of long lines at the counters will be resolved.

articleTitle: Crop Prediction Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Agriculture is a crucial occupation in India, serving as a cornerstone of the country’s development. In fact, approximately 60 nation’s land is devoted to agriculture in order to meet the needs of its vast population of 1.2 billion individuals, wherefore further developing yield creation is thus considered a critical part of agribusiness. Essentially assuming we have a portion of land, we want to realize what sort of crops are beneficial to grow here. Farming relies upon the different soil properties. A good yield of crops is a troublesome assignment since it includes different variables like soil type, temperature, humidity and so on. Be that as it may, in the present time, food production and expectations of yield is getting hampered because of unwanted weather changes, that will unfavorably influence the economy of the people involved in the farming business, especially the farmers, by getting a destitute yield and furthermore causing the farmers to stay less recognizable in determining the future harvests. In the event that it is feasible to track down the It would be incredibly helpful for farmers and others to know the expected yield before planting their crops decide and take decisions which are beneficial for their business. The proposed project would take care of agricultural issues by considering the farming region based on soil properties and suggesting the most fitting crops to grow to the farmers, subsequently assisting them with fundamentally increasing the yield and diminishing the chance of a misfortune. Our proposal is a framework which utilizes diverse machine learning methods like unsupervised learning, K-Means clustering, Predictive Modelling, Logistic Regression, and so on with the end goal being that it suggests the most reasonable crop to grow according to the given soil conditions. The data required for seed of the crop are gathered here, with the other suitable conditions such as temperature, moisture content (humidity) and rainfall, which assist an effective yield. This framework subsequently reduces the monetary misfortunes that a farmer can face brought about by taking a baseless decision to grow a crop without analyzing the conditions on a microscopic level. Furthermore, this framework also assists the farmers by letting them explore future prospects and educating them on what other kinds of crops are more suitable to grow in their region

articleTitle: Approaches in Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Software engineering and artificial intelligence are involved in natural language handling, which controls communication between humans and scripts. The investigation of numerical and computational displays of diverse linguistic components and the NLP is the development of a broad range of frameworks. The usual language prepares conveys its interest in a remarkably broad range of applications. NLP is performed with the database of words, pattern restructuring, and corpus. These include the structure of communication using normal language and discourse coordination. Because many areas of the field are connected to phonetic features of figures, NLP plays a role in software engineering. Numerous NLP developments encompass a variety of research areas, including machine interpretation, text encoding, and representation in normal language, user interfaces, cross-linguistic and multilingual data recovery, discourse recognition, artificial intelligence (AI), and master frameworks.

articleTitle: Role Of Artificial Intelligence In Art
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: It is the 21st century now, and the world has been introduced to many new miraculous technologies. In such technologies "Artificial Intelligence (AI)" is one of the highest standard technologies involving a great number of stunning techniques. AI has already run into every domain present, like education-machine learning, deep learning; healthcare, agriculture, gaming etc. Art is one such domain that has been embraced by AI techniques. This new technology of artificial intelligence in art merges the artist's imagination and technical experts, robotic intelligence together to express the beautiful creativity and emotions [1]. AIART is the technical term to signify the application of one of the most revolutionary technologies-Artificial Intelligence into Arts. This paper reviews the recent developments of how AI is associated in creating an art form and conveys the uniqueness of AIART. It briefly describes the way in which AIART is distinguished from other traditional arts like Paintings, Sculptures and Digital Arts. It also describes in what way AIART is more beneficial than other art forms. This paper analyses the necessity of AIART to help the creative minds. This paper draws a conclusion that the modern way of expression and simplicity are the key factors that distinguish AIART from other traditional arts. [1]

articleTitle: Sentimental Analysis of Customer’s Reviews Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: One of the research fields with the quickest growth is sentimental analysis, which aids customers in improving decision-making by accurately interpreting and evaluating the public’s feelings as expressed on the internet and on social media. By understanding how the customer feels about the product or related events, businesses may assess the performance of their social marketing activities. The majority of the study conducted up to this moment has focused on separating characteristics based on syntactic which is linguistic and lexical that were formally expressed by emoticons, recognizable symbols, and sentiment words. Today’s businesses are working to emphasize product quality more and make it easy for customers to share their thoughts or criticisms of their goods. It aids businesses in refining a certain product based on client input for more consumers. For this project’s sentiment analysis, we collected data from the Amazon website, which contained 80,000 product reviews from a variety of categories (books, medicines, fitness equipment, etc.). In this project, we’ll apply a method for performing machine learning-based sentiment analysis on customer evaluations. The major goal of this research is to train and discriminate the class of sentiment of product reviews using a range of machine-learning approaches. With the help of this integrated algorithm model, the sentiment of recent product reviews may be anticipated.

articleTitle: ALAN-AI News Application with Automatic Voice Control using React JS
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The highly appealing idea of a new web application service that combines the innovative ALAN Studio and react is presented in this paper. The voice-controlled web application concept is suggested and offers a user-friendly interface and an effortless approach. The application includes all the features that allow an individual to be able to make use of voice and speech as a tool to search for news concerning their topic of choice, as well as the opportunity to browse news items in a very simple or in-depth manner. System provides a feature to the user to search their regional news which will be also related to their area, origin, subject matter, and interest. The system will provide a more engaging way to obtain information while reducing the level of human effort previously required by the user. The solution gives the user the ability to use one of the most trending technology that is currently most in demand worldwide while also being informed and up-to-date.

articleTitle: Identification of Buyer-Supplier Relationship Variables of an Organization using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The establishment of efficient buyer-supplier partnerships can facilitate the handling of unpredictability and enhance the efficacy of the supply chain for all parties involved. Achieving enhanced supply chain performance, which entails augmenting sales while reducing inventory levels across the system and aligning supply with demand, necessitates collaborative efforts between buyers and suppliers. Neglecting to adhere to this requirement could potentially lead to both shipment delays and inferior quality of the disseminated merchandise. The maintenance of low expenditures is associated with enhanced organizational performance, prompt and adaptable response to consumer demands, enduring customer allegiance, and a favorable corporate reputation.Through an examination of existing research on the subject of buyers and suppliers, this study provides insight into buyer-supplier interactions’ significance in regard to organisational performance. Specifically, the study focuses on identifying interactions between buyers and suppliers with the help of machine learning by construction of ontologies.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on Deep Learning Techniques Using Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Sentiment Analysis is a process of analyzing the opinion of the people into various categories i.e., positive, negative and neutral. Nowadays sentimental analysis has found a stable position and the most used technique for the analysis of people’s sentiment and opinion and predict based on the past review. It is implemented using various machine learning algorithm and approach to generate the sentiment as positive, negative, and neutral. The classification of review and expression into different categories based on the analysis helps in predicting the opinion of the audience.In this research paper we focus our task of sentimental analysis on IMDB movie review dataset. We have used different machine learning and deep learning algorithm to generate the sentiment as positive or negative. By using BERT algorithm, we find the best accuracy of 90.92%.

articleTitle: Performance analysis and gain spectrum estimation of DWDM system by employing ANN
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Using modified duo-binary return to zero (MDRZ) and differential phase shift keying (DPSK) modulation formats for a wavelength range of 1550 to 1556.4 nm and a channel spacing and data rate of 0.2 nm and 40 Gb/s, respectively, this paper assesses the performance of a 32-channel dense wavelength division multiplexing (DWDM) system. Machine learning (ML) techniques and regression modelling have been employed by exploiting the data set obtained from optical performance monitoring tools. Gain spectrum estimate using various ANN approaches has been done depending on input variables including channel spacing, channel count, and wavelength. ML approaches on the DWDM system have been analyzed in terms of fit-model analysis. The performance of the predicted model has been estimated in terms of R-value by attributing synthetic data retrieved from the ML regression approaches.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Approach Towards Image Steganography Using LSB and Shannon – Fano Encoding Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Steganography is a method that may be used to conceal sensitive information within an image or in some other multimedia. Both steganography and cryptography offer communication an additional layer of protection. Steganography is utilized in certain sectors, but cryptography may be applied to various situations to hide information. The purpose of this work is to discuss an approach of data concealing with the idea of increasing the payload capacity by compressing the secret data using Shannon-Fano Encoding (SFE) without affecting the imperceptibility of the image.

articleTitle: Deep Dive: Music Genre Classification with Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: With the emergence of digital music resources like Spotify, SoundCloud, YouTube, iTunes, and Shazam, the face of streaming music has changed. Accessing various songs by artists and creating playlists has become a less tedious task since these applications have found ways to personalize the recommendations and improve the way users find and listen to music. Determining music genres happens to be the very first step towards building a strong and efficient recommendation system. Therefore, the need for an efficient and accurate music genre classification system is vital, as it will allow for the automatic structuring and organization of huge music archives. The goal of automating this procedure is to make song selection quick and easier because manually categorizing music is a laborious and time-consuming operation. The major goal of this project is to investigate the potential of CNNs for genre categorization and to create an effective model utilizing convolutional neural networks, deep learning method. To train and analyze the model performance, 9990 music samples have been collected from the Kaggle repository (GTZAN dataset features_3_sec), which are then used to extract MFCCs from the respective samples which are then further used to train and test the model. In result analysis, the model with the help of Adam optimizer gives an accuracy of 77.97%.

articleTitle: Smart Health Monitoring System – A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Coronary heart disease is the prime cause of death worldwide. In the field of human work, there is a lot of information available, and specialized techniques are used to process this information. One of the methods that is frequently used is handling or processing. The strategy anticipates a range of future events and cardiovascular issues. A previous cardiovascular disease prediction was made using this technique. For manageable IoT, a pulse sensor for observing pulses is used. Sensor readings are transferred into CSV-looking data via IFTTT, which are viewed on Google Sheets. To prepare, and test the treated datasets, facts were used to organize the datasets. The method uses a mechanism for information preparation to evaluate these criteria in stages. Artificial intelligence is used for computation and categorizing tasks. The dataset is initially dissected, examined, and filtered. The input is then analysed using Python programming and machine learning techniques, including KNN algorithms and XG boost outlying classifier approaches. In terms of accuracy, MLP (Multilayer promotion) showed higher results for detecting heart disease. The proposed system then showed its capability to predict past heart issues with high accuracy. Thanks to the suggested hardware and software solution, patients can anticipate cardiac sickness before it becomes serious enough. Because of this, mass screening programs will be more practical in areas lacking hospitals (i.e., rural areas).

articleTitle: Code Analysis to Prioritize and Fix Bugs Using Top-K Pruning Approach with help of Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The Empirical Study of Bug fixing is a critical and time-consuming task in software development. With the increasing complexity of software systems, identifying and resolving bugs has become even more challenging. To address this issue, automated bug detection and correction tools have been developed to assist developers in detecting and fixing bugs quickly and efficiently. In this paper, we present Bug Fixer, a tool for automated bug detection and correction. Bug Fixer utilizes machine learning algorithms to identify and prioritize bugs, and it also provides developers with automated fixes for the detected bugs. We evaluate the effectiveness of Bug Fixer by conducting experiments on open-source software projects. Our results show that Bug Fixer is effective in detecting and fixing bugs, and it significantly reduces the time and effort required for bug fixing compared to manual approaches. We also discuss the limitations and future directions of Bug Fixer and conclude that automated bug detection and correction tools like Bug Fixer have the potential to improve software quality and accelerate the software development process.

articleTitle: A Survey on Energy efficiency in Cloud Computing Frameworks at Different Platforms
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Cloud computing is a paradigm that offers a restricted set of virtualized resources that may be accessed as needed. It is crucial to allocate these resources on target machines in a manner that minimizes both inadequate utilization and excess utilization, as these conditions can result in substantial consumption of energy. The term “nano data centers” refers to a network of widely dispersed computers that have the capability to both host and distribute material and solicitations in a peer-to-peer manner. The investigation of energy usage in nano servers has not been extensively explored, despite their increasing popularity. Several findings have been derived from our study, which highlight the aspects within the system design that enable nDCs to achieve lower energy consumption compared to their centralized counterparts. This paper presents a comprehensive definition of Cloud Frameworks, encompassing many platforms such as edge computing, green computing, parallel computing, distributed computing, and fog computing. In conclusion, this study highlights a number of obstacles and potential within the realm of cloud computing. It is our intention that this work will attract the interest of the academic community and serve as a catalyst for further investigation in this domain.

articleTitle: Human Routine Analyzer Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: This project aims to develop a ML model which will have the ability to analyze and interpret the human body gestures and movements with the help of several sensors like - Gyro Sensor, Accelerometer, etc. and will be able to present all the data collected by it graphically for an easier understanding of the user.This model will take the readings provided by the sensors into account and that data will be provided by through the user’s smart phone. All that data will be passed onto the model which will then process the data using several ML models like - Random Forest Classifier, KNN Classifier, SVM, and Logistic Regression. Afterward the data processing the model will provide the accuracy score. The final output of the model will lay out the outcome of data processing through graphs like - Bar Chart, Pie Chart, etc.The model’s scope will range from medical to human computer interaction. The model will be making the user aware of their health by keeping track of their running, sleeping, walking, etc. activities and that data can be used by dietitian, or doctors to help them come up with a better remedy if the user is suffering from any kind of disease.

articleTitle: Unveiling Fake News: A Machine and Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The internet has made it simpler for people to obtain and share news and information from a variety of sources, but it also promotes the spread of false information. This paper presents a technique for identifying bogus news that employs deep learning and machine learning and is implemented in Python. Four separate models—Naive Bayes, Decision Tree, Random Forest, and Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory—are used in the research for this aim. The method is based on disentangling false news from actual news by examining the linguistic characteristics of news pieces. The results emphasize the value of DL approaches in detecting false news by showing that the BILSTM model is the most successful in doing so with an accuracy rate of 93%. The suggested strategy has important ramifications for boosting news source trustworthiness and fostering media literacy.

articleTitle: Advance Image Captioning Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: This study proposes a model for picture captioning that uses both convolutional neural networks (CNN) architecture and long-short-term memory (LSTM). This can serve the use in generating the descriptions of the visual content present in e-learning platforms or online tutorials, so for the better comprehension and the support of the individuals. Also, our model can serve its uses in social-media platforms for better experience. The suggested model employs a pre-trained CNN Dense Net architecture to extract characteristics from the input image before utilizing an LSTM to provide a descriptive caption. These extracted characteristics are inserted into an LSTM network to produce descriptive captions. To improve the accuracy and fluency of the generated captions, we also incorporate a semantic attention mechanism that allows the model in order to emphasize on key aspects of the image during the captioning process. We test our model on a benchmark dataset, Flickr8k, and assess its performance compared to other cutting-edge methods. The experimental findings show that the suggested model performs competitively on both datasets and outperforms current models regarding caption quality and diversity.

articleTitle: CardioSage: A Machine Learning-Based Cardiovascular Disease Prediction System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Cardiovascular diseases have emerged as a significant global health concern, affecting a large portion of the population. Early detection and accurate prediction of such diseases are crucial for providing dedicated care and minimizing the associated risks. To address this need, researchers have turned to machine learning algorithms and tools to analyze vast and complex datasets in the medical domain. In recent years, there has been a surge in the utilization of various machine learning techniques to assist in the intricate task of identifying heart-related issues.This study aims to explore and evaluate different models based on machine learning algorithms, namely Random Forest, KNN, Extra tree classifier, and XG boost, for the prediction of cardiovascular diseases. These models leverage the power of machine learning to analyze intricate patterns within the datasets, enabling the identification of potential risk factors and accurate disease prediction.

articleTitle: MAPIFY: Map Your Day-to-Day Activities using Web Application
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Nowadays, everyone has become so busy in their life that they sometimes forget their meetings, events, and many day-to-day activities. We are dependent on others for information to get somewhere which we often forget. Many of the people face problem of depending on others to get anywhere on the planet for their crucial activities such as important meetings, sport activities, or kind of event that is to be happen in future. Some of them also don’t remember all the activities and places to visit on. So, we have come up with the solution. The proposed solution to the existing problem is MAPIFY, a front-end web application developed by us which is an excellent example that one should include in their lifestyle. This application will keep the record of your various events in the local storage API of the web browser. This will make sure their location to be mapped on a map so that one can easily track it down, making life easier. It will keep record of all the activities that one should want to schedule along with location of that venue on the map. Also, there is no limit to these records, so one should not fear of storage run out, Since, we have used local storage Web API to solve the problem users face in case of weak internet connection which often leads to refresh of the web page which in turn leads to data losing. This mapify project will make sure to keep the record of the events with the location so that one can easily follow this to keep their day-to-day activities well-arranged and manage their time easily.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Sign Language Recognition System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: This research paper represents a sign language recognition system that uses computer vision and machine learning algorithms to translate sign language into written or spoken language. The system can recognize and analyse hand and body movements from video footage, and can associate them with corresponding words or phrases in the target language. The system is trained on large datasets of sign language videos, and can be customized to recognize different sign languages and dialects as well as it also converts text into speech. The paper also discusses the various technologies involved in implementing the system, including depth sensors, cameras, and microphones. The research paper presents the results of experiments conducted to evaluate the performance of the system, including its accuracy and speed of translation. The paper also explores the potential applications of the system, including improving communication between the deaf and hearing communities, and enabling deaf people to access a wider range of information and services. Overall, the research paper demonstrates the potential of sign language recognition systems to improve accessibility and inclusivity for the deaf and hard-of-hearing communities and highlights the importance of ongoing research and development in this area.

articleTitle: Voice Feature Extraction Method Analysis for Speaker Recognition with Degraded Human Voice
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The human brain possesses millions of neurons that enable easy identification of different speaker voices. However, when a speaker’s voice is accompanied by significant background noise, recognizing the speaker becomes challenging. In our experiment, we are focusing on an efficient approach for extracting features that support speaker recognition even with degraded human voice. Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficient (MFCC) is a commonly used method for extracting human speech features and is widely utilized in speaker recognition systems. The process of extracting features from MFCC involves dividing the audio into frames and calculating cepstral coefficients for each frame. Each frame in the MFCC exhibits similar spectral power, representing the distinct and shared vocal characteristics of each speaker. The MFCC provides numerical values for these vocal properties, which are effectively employed in identifying the speaker, whether through a Machine Learning (ML) or Artificial Intelligence (AI) enabled system for speaker identification. In this article, we employ a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) for speaker classification in scenarios where there is high background noise. Additionally, the experiment investigates the impact of sampling rate on human voice in situations where the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) is low throughout the speaker recognition process

articleTitle: Hybrid Extraction Methodologies to Reduce Dimensionality
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Feature extraction (EF) is universally regarded as the most effective technique for the various data processing phases that constitute a classification system. In real-world situations, high-dimensional noise and redundancy can considerably reduce the accuracy of a classifier. It is essential to extract relevant data to increase the classification system’s efficacy and reduce its dimensionality. The present study places emphasis on the utilisation of feature extraction methods as a means of reducing dimensionality. In this study, a variety of hybrid feature extraction techniques were proposed to reduce the dimensionality of datasets related to chronic kidney disease, including principal component analysis (PCA), independent component analysis (ICA), linear discriminant analysis (LDA), and singular value decomposition (SVD). This work presents a comparative analysis of three approaches: a full feature set, existing feature extraction techniques that reduce the feature set to seven out of twenty-four, and hybrid feature extraction strategies. The application of these techniques has been observed to improve the accuracy and decrease the root mean square error (RMSE) of eleven distinct machine learning classifiers. Furthermore, hybrid techniques for feature extraction have been utilised, resulting in a 15% reduction in dimensionality and enhanced efficiency of the classification system. Most of the classifiers attained an accuracy rate of 98.75% at their peak performance.

articleTitle: Study of Image Forgery Detection Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: After the evolution and wide spread use of internet digital images plays important role in many forms and digital images are like all over the globe via world wide web. Image forgery means manipulation of the digital image to protect the meaningful and important information related to that particular image. In this study we are going to learn about image forgery techniques.

articleTitle: Designing a framework to detect face mask using machine learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: We are aware of the pandemic scenario in our surroundings, and many people are taking precautions to be safe. Medical advancements and technological advancements are about to avert the crisis. The suggested method is based on the idea that, at the very least, it is our responsibility as technocrats to offer the appropriate answer. The system’s primary goal is to raise awareness of the need of maintaining personal hygiene. Using the detecting system and implementing according to its state is the primary goal. When using hand sanitizer and washing hands, the mask played a crucial role. The device has a camera that is integrated with a sanitizing machine and can identify the wearer of a mask. Additionally, there is a system at the gate that uses an Arduino to recognize a person’s image as they enter the property. If the individual is wearing a mask, the gate will only open and disinfectant will fall into their hand; if not, the system fails to open the gate.

articleTitle: A Survey of Session-Based Recommender Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Session-based recommender systems have gained significant attention in recent years due to their ability to capture user preferences and provide personalized recommendations based on sequential interactions. These systems consider user sessions as a unit of analysis, taking into account the temporal dynamics and context of user behavior. This paper presents an overview of session-based recommender systems, discussing their key components and methodologies. The focus is on capturing the short-term interests and preferences of users by analyzing their recent session history. Various approaches, including collaborative filtering, recurrent neural networks, and hybrid models, are explored to model the session-context and make accurate recommendations. Additionally, the paper examines the challenges and opportunities associated with session-based recommender systems. These challenges include data sparsity, cold start problem, session representation, and scalability. Solutions and techniques to address these challenges are discussed, such as session encoding methods, session-based evaluation metrics, and data augmentation techniques. The evaluation of session-based recommender systems is also addressed, highlighting the metrics used to assess the effectiveness of recommendations, including precision, recall, and diversity. Furthermore, real-world applications and case studies of session-based recommender systems across various domains, such as e-commerce, online streaming, and news recommendation, are presented to showcase their practicality and impact. An experiment is also conducted to do a comparative analyses of many well-known techniques that are in use for making recommendations in sessions.

articleTitle: Ad Hoc Network based Android Messaging Apps
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In areas with weak internet and cellular connectivity, mobile communication can become unreliable or even impossible. Even though there are numerous Android chat messenger applications available for this purpose, connectivity issues caused by external factors like physical link breakdowns or congestion in the network are significant obstructions that disrupt the process. In this paper, various existing chat applications have been analyzed and it has been intended to analyze the existing hurdles in communication due to various factors. Overall, the study suggests that the Bluetooth-based chat messenger application may offer a better user experience and lower memory requirements as compared to existing internet- based chat applications. This paper would also provide insights to other scholars, researchers & academicians to work further in the area.

articleTitle: Virtual Board based Data Sharing Application Using Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The concept of cloud computing becomes the more popular solution for managing data in recent years. Cloud computing provides several other advantages over traditional on-premises databases along with the ability to store and access data through the internet. This review is about the Virtual Board System, which is a cloud-based Android application that aims to enhance data management and file handling. In today’s fast-paced world, managing and tracing data is a tedious task that consumes a lot of time. Thus, this paper presents the Virtual Board System, which offers an easy-to-use platform with a predefined process for logging and searching through old files. Virtual Board was developed to address the challenges faced by students and professionals in managing large volumes of data efficiently. By utilizing skills in computer engineering and combining them with consulting services, a user-friendly application has been created that stores records safely in a cloud database. The system is designed to minimize threats of data loss and record misplacement by providing encrypted data to both sides in a more organized form under privacy policies. Hence, this research paper focuses on developing and optimizing the Virtual Board System, which provides a reliable and efficient way to handle and manage data.

articleTitle: Development and Implementation of Bicata
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Bicata is a bike pooling android application. It is also commonly known as bike-sharing, ridesharing and lift sharing. It connects travellers to nearby escort for short-distance and long-distance travelling. It is sharing of bike journey so that one person can travel on bike. Many office people and college students use to travel public transport or walk long distance. There are problems like public transport can be slow and it is not available everywhere. It may be hard to reach their destination on the specific time and place and it can spoil precious time. our project solves this problem from providing bike ride pooling application for institutes and office.
