This is beneficial for both the people want to reach their destination in swiftly and inexpensive rate and the people want to provide bike pooling. There is also an option for girls and women who want to provide the bike pooling and riding for female. In this research paper, we will discuss about development and implementation of Bicata bike pooling android application using Kotlin, SQL for managing database, Global positioning system (GPS), A* algorithm and Dijkstra’s algorithm for finding the shortest route.

articleTitle: Upscaling Productive of Crop by Identifying Malignant Leaf Using Cyber Physical System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The Indian agriculture sector, a major contributor to the country’s economy, faces significant challenges in the areas of technology, processing, and marketing. Farmers often lack the necessary awareness and resources to effectively identify and address plant diseases, which can lead to significant losses in crop yields.We used ResNet, a deep learning algorithm, to predict the early symptoms of diseases in various crops, including tomato, grape, orange, soybean, squash, potato, corn, strawberry, peach, apple, blueberry, cherry, pepper, and raspberry. By detecting diseases early on, farmers can take proactive measures to reduce the damage caused and increase the quality and quantity of production. This innovative approach to farming offers farmers an opportunity to mitigate the impact of plant diseases and boost crop yields. By leveraging the power of machine learning, farmers can benefit from a more efficient and effective way of detecting and diagnosing plant diseases. This research offers a promising solution to the challenges facing the agriculture sector and has the potential to drive significant improvements in crop production in India and beyond.

articleTitle: A Study and Analysis of Timetable Generation using a Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: A system of manually creating timetables is tedious in terms of time and resources for educators in universities with large numbers of students, and usually results in conflicting classes and multiple lectures assigned to the same professor. It will result in supplying an automated timetable maker can help you create exams and timetables. the system helps auto-generate and saves time. Avoid complex manual processes to set up and manage timetables. Here, the goal is to create a user-friendly, effective, and straightforward application that facilitates the process of creating and distributing timetables. The main algorithm used to generate timetables is the genetic algorithm. Organizing all the rules will help you create the optimal schedule. Teachers don’t have to worry about time conflicts. The system’s user interface is simple, interactive, and allows for inputs such the teacher’s name, the date of the classroom, the date of the lab, and the date of the topic. the programme features a well-designed database to keep track of all the data submitted. The system uses algorithms to handle all of the data in the database while taking both hard and soft limitations into consideration. A schedule generating method that use a genetic algorithm to find the best option. Instead of cumbersome paperwork, students and instructors may examine timetables immediately. The technique is simple to use and will assist you in creating an effective timetable.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis Using Text Feedback
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Sentiment analysis, commonly referred to as opinion mining, is one of the main features of NL (Natural Language Processing). Emotional analysis has received a lot of attention lately. One of the core problems with emotional analysis is the classification difficulty, which we wish to discuss in this post. Survey reviews and replies, communication channels, and health care instruments used in anything from advertising to customer service to clinical medicine commonly make use of emotional analysis. In this project, we want to analyses text comments for sentiment. The information gathered for this project comes from internet product reviews found in “Restaurant Reviews.” We are eager to investigate the encouraging review statistics. Your assessment of the sentence quality and review quality was finished with positive results. Finally, we provide some information about our upcoming research on emotion analysis.

articleTitle: Covid-19 Outbreak Data Analysis and Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Resolving the crucial issue of identifying patients requiring ICU admissions in the early stages of COVID-19 management, specially when medical resources are limited, is of paramount importance. Delayed ICU admissions can lead to unfavorable outcomes such as increased mortality and higher costs. identification of patients at failure is essential to prevent complications, improve risk stratification, and enhance the outcomes of severely ill hospitalized individuals. This research paper presents a developed model that accurately predicts the need for ICU admissions using patient characteristics and information collected upon admission and during the initial hospitalization period. The model utilizes data organized in a window-based format, as provided by the hospital team and published on Kaggle. Preprocessing techniques, including imputation, cleaning, and feature selection, are applied to the data. In the cleaning process, features with zero variance, unnecessary features, and highly correlated features are removed to streamline the dataset. Various algorithms, such as K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and Decision Tree Classifier with early stopping, are employed as predictors in the developed model. It is observed that the Decision Tree Classifier yields the highest accuracy among the algorithms. The results obtained from the developed model demonstrate a sensitivity of 92.5%, specificity of 93.44%, and an AUC score of 80%. These performance metrics highlight the model's capability to effectively identify patients who will require ICU admissions, contributing to improved decision-making and resource allocation in the early stages of COVID-19 management.

articleTitle: Movie & Song Recommender System Based on Emotion Detection using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Emotions play a great role in human lives. Our mind unconsciously notices the emotions of people we meet every day. It interprets the signals people emit through these emotions. It also tries to determine how to respond to and deal with people around us. Facial expressions can reveal emotions like happiness, anger, sadness, surprise, fear, excitement, desire, contempt, disgust, confusion and many more. This paper proposes an emotion-based movie and song recommender system that utilizes deep learning techniques for user’s emotion detection. It also provides recommendation of movies and songs that match user’s emotional state at that time.The emotion detection based movie and song recommender system is a revolutionary system that aims to come up with customized suggestions formed on basis of user’s emotional state at that time. It uses advanced techniques of artificial intelligence for emotion detection of user. It then suggests movies and songs that align with their mood. Also, it can help users find latest items that they may not have found by themselves. It leads to a more enjoyable and fulfilling entertainment experience. Additionally, the system has the potential to improve mental health outcomes by providing users with content that can positively impact their emotional state. Overall, the movie and song recommender system using emotion detection is a valuable tool for anyone seeking personalized entertainment recommendations. Our research work focused on using facial expressions for movies and song recommendation to the user. Depending on the expression user reveals at particular moment we can best recommend movies that suit his current mood.

articleTitle: An Empirical Approach of Movie Recommendation System Using Machine Learning (NLP)
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Recommendation systems play a significant role in helping users make informed automated decisions. These systems facilitate users in discovering valuable information from a vast pool of available data. In the context of movie recommendation systems, recommendations are generated based on user similarities (Collaborative Filtering) or by taking into account an individual user’s interests (Content-Based Filtering). To address the limitations of both collaborative and content-based filtering, a hybrid approach is often employed to create a more effective recommendation system. Additionally, various similarity measures are used to determine user similarities for recommendations. This paper provides an overview of state-of-the-art techniques in Content-Based Filtering, Collaborative Filtering, Hybrid Approaches, and Deep Learning-Based Methods for movie recommendations. Furthermore, we discuss different similarity measures [1] [2].Various organizations, such as Instagram, LinkedIn, Spotify, Disney + Hotstar, and Amazon, utilize recommendation systems to enhance their profits and cater to their customers’ needs. This paper primarily focuses on a concise review of diverse techniques and their methods for movie recommendations, thereby encouraging further research in the domain of recommendation systems.

articleTitle: Robust Ad-hoc Security Measures In Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Due to the integration of cloud computing with ad hoc networks and the growing use of wireless networks, ad hoc security in cloud computing has emerged as a critical issue. Specially appointed networks are remote organizations made on the fly with next to no decent framework, and they are powerless against different security assaults. Authentication and access control, encryption and confidentiality, intrusion detection, scalability, privacy, and energy efficiency are just a few of the robust security measures that must be put into place when ad hoc networks and cloud computing are combined. Access control policies control who can access network resources, while authentication and access control ensure that only authorized users can do so. Data transmitted over a network can be kept confidential using encryption algorithms like AES, RSA, and ECC. In the event of a security breach, intrusion detection systems (IDS) can be used to monitor the network for suspicious activity and notify the network administrator. The network’s scalability, privacy, and energy efficiency can all be ensured by employing lightweight encryption algorithms, privacy-preserving mechanisms, and energy-efficient security mechanisms.

articleTitle: Using LSTM to Predict BSE Sensex Index
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: This paper aims to predict the prices of BSE Sensex Index. The BSE Sensex is a free-float market-weighted stock market index of 30 well-established and financially sound companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange. The Data set for this study is obtained from the publicly available data provided by the Bombay Stock Exchange. It consists of historical prices of the BSE Sensex ranging from 3-April-1979 to 13-January-2022. This study explores three different models to predict the prices of BSE Sensex based on the historical data - Support Vector Regression, Bayesian Regression and Long Short-Term Memory. The focus is on using LSTM to predict the prices of BSE Sensex Index since LSTM works best for time series data which is what we have.

articleTitle: CNN based Sign Language Recognition System with Multi-format Output
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Despite being one of the oldest and most natural forms of communication, sign language is challenging to comprehend since very few people are conversant in it. In this article a real time method for sign recognition using neural networks for finger spelling based on American sign language is presented. The purpose is to recognize hand gestures of human task activities from a camera image. The position of hand and orientation are applied to obtain the training and testing data for the CNN after applying several image processing techniques. The hand is first put through a filter, and once that has been done, it is put through a classifier, which determines what class the hand movements belong to. Then the calibrated images are used to train CNN. Further various performance parameters such as accuracy, precision, recall and f1 score are calculated to analyze the proposed model. Using the DenseNet-169 CNN model the proposed system showed excellent performance with an accuracy of 99%. Moreover, the output is obtained in both text as well as audio format for ease of communication.

articleTitle: Predicting Crime Rate in Toronto
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Predicting rates of criminal activity is a critical domain of study that has captured substantial interest in contemporary times. Various statistical, deep learning as well as machine learning techniques are being used to predict occurrence of crimes based on different factors such as time, location, and socioeconomic conditions. The use of big data analytics and predictive models are capable of assisting law agencies by taking premptive actions to avoid crimes and improve the safety of public. Several studies have shown that predictive models based on algorithms of machine learning like Decision tree, Neural Networks, and Random forest can provide accurate crime rate predictions. The efficiency of such models is mainly reliant on the quality of the information and the features used in analysis. In this project, A Random Forest classifier is used to create a classification model to predict the kind of major crime that has taken place based on various factors along with neighbourhood, division, time of crime, month, year and so on. In Toronto between 2014-2019, a detailed information including where and when the crime is committed and various other factors are included in our dataset, containing categorical data. The process involves in testing the data using both OneHot and numeric encoding. Despite the uneven distribution of instances, where assault records are in the majority, the model delivers satisfactory results on F1-score when dealing with the five class classification problem.Model’s performance doesn’t get affected while balancing the class weights. The model that uses Random Forest Classifier and One Hot Encoder shows a slight increase in accuracy, as indicated by an F1-score.

articleTitle: Cloud Computing: Issues and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Cloud computing is what people are talking about today. It is an emerging technology in computer science and on-demand in the future. In our research paper we will discuss the issues of cloud computing that are really a matter of concern and need more research and development. We will use previous technologies that were used before cloud computing like grid computing etc. and focus on the major challenges of cloud computing. We will focus on the private cloud that is related to the privacy and security of data of the client. So, in our research paper we try to figure out the major issues. Cloud computing is now considered as a very popular technology among IT companies, but we will try to focus on the issues that are in cloud computing and that should be resolved for better growth

articleTitle: The Power of Data: A Study on the Role of Analytics in E-Commerce Management through an Admin Panel App
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The advent of e-commerce has revolutionized business operations, creating new opportunities for entrepreneurs and established brands. However, managing an online business can be difficult, especially when it comes to making data-driven decisions that can promote development and enhance the customer experience. The purpose of this research paper is to investigate the role of analytics in ecommerce administration, specifically through the use of an admin panel application. This study seeks to identify the benefits and challenges of using data in e-commerce management by conducting a literature review and case studies of businesses that have implemented analytics through an admin panel app. The findings suggest that analytics can provide valuable insights into customer behavior, sales trends, and inventory management, resulting in better-informed decisions and enhanced business performance. However, the success of analytics implementation is contingent on a number of factors, including data quality, technical expertise, and the accurate interpretation of data insights. This study's findings contribute to the expanding body of knowledge on e-commerce management and provide businesses contemplating the adoption of an admin panel app with analytics capabilities with valuable information.
